cases.title: Latch：一行脚本让站点在 AI 浏览器里可被操作（WebMCP）
cases.titleEn: Latch: one script so AI browsers can operate your site (WebMCP)
cases.hook: 把搜索、加购、表单挂成 WebMCP 工具，agent 不用瞎点。
cases.hookEn: Expose search, cart, and form actions as WebMCP tools so agents stop guessing clicks.
cases.summary: Latch（https://latch.tools/ ，仓库 r0bertini/latch，MIT）是一段约 6KB、零依赖的前端脚本：只读检查 DOM，把搜索框、加购/立即购买、联系/预约表单、导航等登记成 WebMCP 工具（如 search_site、add_to_cart、submit_form、navigate），供 ChatGPT Atlas、Perplexity Comet、Chrome WebMCP origin trial、Edge 等 agentic 浏览器直接调用。无 WebMCP 时静默降级、不改坏页面。安装：`<script src="https://latch.tools/latch.js" defer></script>`。脚本本身免费开源；站点另售 Pro 托管分析（当日标价约 €19/项目/月），本条只写开源脚本路径。Show HN https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50218601（2026-10-24）。本库没有在真实站点嵌入，也没有用 AI 浏览器实测工具调用。
cases.summaryEn: Latch (https://latch.tools/ , repo r0bertini/latch, MIT) is a ~6KB zero-dependency front-end script: it read-only inspects the DOM and registers search, add-to-cart/buy-now, contact/booking forms, and nav as WebMCP tools (search_site, add_to_cart, submit_form, navigate) for agentic browsers such as ChatGPT Atlas, Perplexity Comet, Chrome’s WebMCP origin trial, and Edge. Without WebMCP it no-ops and does not break the host page. Install: `<script src="https://latch.tools/latch.js" defer></script>`. The script is free/open source; the site also sells Pro hosted analytics (~€19/project/month on check day)—this entry covers the open script path only. Show HN https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50218601 (2026-10-24). This library did not embed it on a real site or exercise tool calls from an AI browser.
cases.approvalBoundary: 把第三方脚本挂进生产站前先审内容安全与隐私；Pro 分析按项目付费。本库没有代为嵌入。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Review security/privacy before dropping a third-party script on production; Pro analytics bills per project. This library did not embed it.
cases.qualityNote: 收录是因为 MIT 单行脚本 + WebMCP 工具表清晰，且与 AI 浏览器可操作站点直接相关。仓库很新、尚无社区积累，但落地页与 README 可核对。本库未嵌入、未用 AI 浏览器实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listed because the MIT one-line script and WebMCP tool table are concrete and relevant to AI-operable sites. The repo is brand new with no community traction yet; landing page and README were readable. Not embedded; AI-browser tool calls not exercised.

cases.title: fx0：Vercel Labs 开源 AI 设计代理，一页写成单个 HTML
cases.titleEn: fx0: Vercel Labs open-source AI design agent that writes one HTML page
cases.hook: 用对话出单页 HTML，预览边生成边更新，还能按 turn 回看版本。
cases.hookEn: Chat out a single-page HTML design with a live preview and per-turn versions.
cases.summary: fx0 是 Vercel Labs 用 libfx 做的开源设计代理（Apache-2.0）。你描述页面，它写成一个完整 HTML 文件，预览跟着流式更新；每一轮对话保留一版，可重新打开、复制或下载。可选十套来自 VoltAgent awesome-design-md 的 design.md 风格，也可上传自己的 design.md 或参考图；还能搜索网页、抓公开页作参考。线上试用在 https://fx0.vercel.dev ：未登录可有每 IP 5 次免费 Opus 提示（BotID 保护，由服务端 Gateway key 出资），登录后走 Vercel AI Gateway 记到你的团队。自建需要 Node.js 24、Sign in with Vercel、Neon Postgres、Upstash Redis。fx0 不是 v0（全栈产品），也不是终端里的 Vercel fx（Zig 编程代理）。本库没有登录生成页面，也没有自建部署。
cases.summaryEn: fx0 is Vercel Labs’ open-source design agent built with libfx (Apache-2.0). You describe a page; it writes one complete HTML file while a live preview streams. Each chat turn keeps its own version you can reopen, copy, or download. It ships ten design.md styles from VoltAgent’s awesome-design-md, and you can upload your own design.md or reference images; it can also search the web and fetch public pages. The hosted trial is at https://fx0.vercel.dev : unsigned visitors get five free Opus prompts per IP (BotID-gated, funded by a server Gateway key); signed-in chats bill through Vercel AI Gateway to your team. Self-hosting needs Node.js 24, Sign in with Vercel, Neon Postgres, and Upstash Redis. fx0 is not v0 (the full-stack product) and not the terminal Vercel fx Zig coding agent. This library did not sign in to generate a page and did not self-host.
cases.qualityNote: 收录是因为输出是可下载的单文件 HTML，有 live preview 与按 turn 版本，并开源 Apache-2.0。免费试用写明每 IP 5 次；续用靠 AI Gateway 计费或自建。本库没有登录出页，也没有跑本地栈。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listed because it outputs downloadable single-file HTML with a live preview and per-turn versions, under Apache-2.0. The free trial is five prompts per IP; continued use bills through AI Gateway or a self-hosted stack. This library did not sign in or run the local stack.

cases.title: OpenStitch：本机跑的开源 AI UI 设计（文字/截图/线框 → 可交互 HTML）
cases.titleEn: OpenStitch: local open-source AI UI design (text/screenshot/wireframe → interactive HTML)
cases.hook: 本机无限画布上出多屏 HTML，还能串成可点的原型。
cases.hookEn: Generate multi-screen HTML on a local infinite canvas and wire clickable prototypes.
cases.summary: OpenStitch 是本机可跑的开源 AI UI 设计工具（MIT）。用自然语言、截图或手绘线框生成可渲染的交互前端代码，排在无限画布上，用边连接导航，再进 Play Mode 全屏点原型。支持一次 Generate 多屏并共享 DESIGN.md，可从 50+ 品牌设计系统里选，或让模型现写一套；可导出 ZIP（DESIGN.md + 各屏 HTML）。README 写受 Google Stitch、screenshot-to-code、draw-a-ui 启发，默认走本机 Ollama（需 Docker Compose），可选云端 API。仓库主页是 https://github.com/heldernoid/openstitch ；https://github.com/iohelder/openstitch 301 到同一仓库。安全说明：无登录，只适合本机/私网，勿把 3000/7001 暴露公网。本库没有 Docker 拉起，也没有接模型生成。与仍打开的 #87 里的 google-stitch（云端产品）不是同一条。
cases.summaryEn: OpenStitch is a local open-source AI UI design tool (MIT). Describe a screen, drop a screenshot, or sketch a wireframe to get rendered interactive frontend code on an infinite canvas; link screens into flows and run them in Play Mode. Generate can produce multiple screens that share a DESIGN.md; pick from 50+ brand design systems or let the model invent one; export a ZIP of DESIGN.md plus per-screen HTML. The README cites Google Stitch, screenshot-to-code, and draw-a-ui. Default path is local Ollama via Docker Compose; cloud API keys are optional. Canonical repo: https://github.com/heldernoid/openstitch ; https://github.com/iohelder/openstitch 301s there. Security note: no auth—local/private network only; do not expose ports 3000/7001. This library did not bring Docker up or call a model. Separate from google-stitch in still-open #87 (hosted product).
cases.qualityNote: 收录是因为本机/私网、MIT、文字/截图/线框三条入口，以及画布+Play Mode。默认依赖 Docker + Ollama，体积大。封面来自仓库 media/generate.gif 首帧，不是本库本地跑通的画面。与 #87 google-stitch 源不同。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listed for the local/private MIT path, three input modes, and canvas + Play Mode. Default stack needs Docker + Ollama and is heavy. Cover frame comes from the repo media/generate.gif first frame, not a run captured in this library. Different source from google-stitch in #87.

cases.title: App Canvas：用真实 UI 代码铺开整应用状态与流程的开源画布
cases.titleEn: App Canvas: an open-source canvas of real UI code for app states and flows
cases.hook: 在一张可缩放画布上看真实页面、命名状态和可播放流程。
cases.hookEn: See real pages, named states, and playable flows on one zoomable canvas.
cases.summary: App Canvas（MIT）让编程助手围着「已实现的应用代码」搭一套审查画布：全屏、命名状态、带标签的跳转，以及可播放的交互流程。公开合成演示无需登录或 API key，示例 StoolSense 写明 77 个状态、44 条交互流、121 个可播放条目（含独立 case）。Browse 可平移缩放并锁定控件；选中屏幕再 Interact 才能点真实控件；Demo 按作者写的动作与断言播放失败/恢复等旅程。安装是把 GitHub 发行版当 devDependency（如 github:tombelieber/app-canvas#v0.10.3），由助手按 AGENT_GUIDE.md 做 discover、fixtures、adapter 与 --complete 门禁；画布运行时本身不调模型。演示站 https://tombelieber.github.io/app-canvas/ ，说明文 https://tomtang3.ai/blog/introducing-app-canvas/ （2026-10-18）。仓库 stargazers 目前为 0，但公开演示可打开。本库没有在自有仓库安装，也没有点 Demo 跑完整条流。
cases.summaryEn: App Canvas (MIT) is a review canvas your coding agent builds around real application code: full screens, named states, labeled transitions, and playable interaction flows. The public synthetic demo needs no login or API key; the StoolSense example states 77 states, 44 interaction flows, and 121 playable entries including standalone cases. Browse pans/zooms with controls locked; Interact unlocks real controls on a selected screen; Demo plays authored actions and assertions such as save-failure recovery. Install the GitHub release as a devDependency (e.g. github:tombelieber/app-canvas#v0.10.3) and have an agent follow AGENT_GUIDE.md for discover, fixtures, adapter, and the --complete gate; the canvas runtime itself makes no model calls. Demo: https://tombelieber.github.io/app-canvas/ ; write-up: https://tomtang3.ai/blog/introducing-app-canvas/ (2026-10-18). The repo currently shows 0 stars; the public demo loads. This library did not install it into another app and did not play a full Demo flow.
cases.qualityNote: 收录是因为公开演示无登录、用真实 UI 而非手绘稿，并明确给编程助手安装路径。GitHub stars 为 0，以演示与文档为准。本库没有装进业务仓库，也没有完整播放一条 flow。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listed because the public demo needs no login, renders real UI rather than drawn mockups, and documents an agent install path. GitHub stars are 0; judge from the demo and docs. Not installed into an app repo here, and no full flow was played.

cases.title: Pristine：给编程助手的 UI 评审与抛光 agent skill（截图打分再改）
cases.titleEn: Pristine: an agent skill that critiques and polishes web UI from real screenshots
cases.hook: 先截真实页面打分，再按 Lens 抛光到接近 10/10。
cases.hookEn: Screenshot the real page, score it, then polish it toward 10/10 with named Lenses.
cases.summary: Pristine 是开源 agent skill（Apache-2.0），面向 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor 以及任何读 SKILL.md 的助手。它用助手已有的浏览器工具，或附带的 scripts/capture.mjs（会装私有 Chromium 到 ~/.cache/pristine-capture）在 light/dark、desktop/mobile 截真实页面，按 11 个维度与 Personas 打分，再提供 /pristine init（写 DESIGN.md）、critique（只读）、design、polish（16 个 Lens，如 bolder、typeset、harden）。安装：npx skills add maddhruv/pristine，或各端的 plugin marketplace。站点 https://pristine-ui.pages.dev 放了八组 before/after；作者称一次 polish 可把示例从 3.5/10 提到 9.5/10——这是站点展示，本库没有复跑。Show HN https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50204389 （2026-10-23）。本库没有执行 npx skills add，也没有对本地项目跑 critique/polish。
cases.summaryEn: Pristine is an open-source agent skill (Apache-2.0) for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and any agent that reads SKILL.md. It captures the real page in light/dark and desktop/mobile with the agent’s browser tools or a bundled scripts/capture.mjs (private Chromium under ~/.cache/pristine-capture), scores 11 Dimensions through Personas, then offers /pristine init (writes DESIGN.md), critique (read-only), design, and polish (16 Lenses such as bolder, typeset, harden). Install with npx skills add maddhruv/pristine or each host’s plugin marketplace. https://pristine-ui.pages.dev shows eight before/after pairs; the author reports one polish run moving a sample from 3.5/10 to 9.5/10—that is site marketing, not a rerun here. Show HN https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50204389 (2026-10-23). This library did not run npx skills add or critique/polish a local project.
cases.qualityNote: 收录是因为面向真实截图的评审/抛光 skill，命令边界清楚（critique 不改代码）。before/after 分数来自官网示例，本库未复跑。安装可能在用户缓存目录放入专用浏览器内核。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listed as a real-screenshot critique/polish skill with a clear critique (read-only) boundary. Before/after scores are from the site’s examples, not rerun here. Install may place a private browser binary under the user’s cache.

cases.title: TypeUI Micro Interactions：113 个可预览微交互 + 可复制实现提示词
cases.titleEn: TypeUI Micro Interactions: 113 previewable micro-interactions with copyable build prompts
cases.hook: 113 个微交互可预览，提示词能直接复制去实现。
cases.hookEn: Preview 113 micro-interactions and copy a prompt to build each one.
cases.summary: TypeUI 的微交互画廊按控件分组：Buttons、Inputs、Selection、Modals、Drawers、Tooltips、Toasts、Step navigation、Lists、Sliders、Cards。页面写一共 113 条。每条可以预览行为，并用 TypeUI Creative 复制实现提示词。适合要用 AI 写微交互、又不想从零描述动效的人。本库没有把复制出的提示词贴进任何模型出代码。
cases.summaryEn: TypeUI’s micro-interaction gallery is grouped by control: Buttons, Inputs, Selection, Modals, Drawers, Tooltips, Toasts, Step navigation, Lists, Sliders, and Cards. The page says there are 113. Each one can be previewed, and TypeUI Creative copies an implementation prompt. Useful when you want AI to build a micro-interaction without describing the motion from scratch. This library did not paste a copied prompt into any model.
cases.qualityNote: 收录是因为每条都能预览行为，并用 TypeUI Creative 复制实现提示词。页面写 113 条，分组见正文。本库没有把提示词交给模型生成代码。本条是 /micro-interactions 画廊，和 TypeUI 主站上的 UI/UX 规则页分开。

cases.title: Figma Code Layers：画布上并排放可运行的代码原型（开放测试）
cases.titleEn: Figma Code Layers: runnable code prototypes side by side on the canvas (open beta)
cases.hook: 在画布上并排试能跑的代码原型。
cases.hookEn: Try runnable code prototypes side by side on the canvas.
cases.summary: Figma 在 2026-10-15 把 Code Layers 放进开放测试。画布上的 code layer 是一段能跑的交互原型，可以和设计帧放在一起，也可以复制一份再试另一个方向。入手有几条路：从空白层让 Figma agent 做、选中设计帧再 Build selection、用 Chrome 扩展把线上页面抓进来、连 GitHub、从本地文件夹导入，或经 Figma MCP 把编程工具里的原型放上画布。Extract designs 能把当前画面、选中的元素，或一段操作流程拉回可编辑图层。帮助中心写可用计划包括 Education（K-12）、Starter、Professional、Organization、Enterprise，需要编辑权，创建需要 Full seat，并写接下来几周陆续出现。博客和帮助中心都写：付费计划上，到 2026-11-04 为止，在 code layer 里生成和编辑不计 AI 额度；同一次请求里，助手做的其他工作仍会计额度。11 月 4 日之后，code layer 任务按其他 agent 功能走额度。导入本身不计额度。本库没有 Figma 账号，没有登录试用。
cases.summaryEn: On 2026-10-15 Figma moved Code Layers into open beta. A code layer is a running interactive prototype on the canvas, next to design frames, and it can be duplicated to try another direction. You can start from an empty layer and prompt the Figma agent, turn selected frames into a layer with Build selection, capture a live page with the Chrome extension, connect GitHub, import a local folder, or bring a prototype in through Figma MCP. Extract designs pulls the current view, a selected element, or a flow back into editable layers. The help center lists Education (K-12), Starter, Professional, Organization, and Enterprise, requires edit access, says creating a layer needs a Full seat, and says access rolls out over the following weeks. Both the blog and the help center say that on paid plans, generating and editing inside a code layer does not spend AI credits through 2026-11-04; other agent work in the same request still does. After 4 November, code-layer tasks spend credits like other agent features. The import itself does not spend credits. This library has no Figma account and did not sign in.
cases.qualityNote: 开放测试，席位和额度以帮助中心为准。帮助中心把 Starter 和 Education（K-12）也列进可用计划；免费到 2026-11-04 的额度豁免，博客和帮助中心都写成付费计划。豁免只覆盖在 code layer 里生成和编辑的任务，同一次提示里的其他助手工作仍计额度。导入本身不计额度。本库没有登录试用。

cases.titleEn: Webflow Campaigns: brand from your site, then landing pages, variants, and ads
cases.hook: 给现有网站抽出品牌，再生成可改的投放页和广告。
cases.hookEn: Turn a site URL into an on-brand landing page, variants, and ads.
cases.summary: Webflow Campaigns 是独立于主站 CMS 的投放工具。你给它现有网站的网址，它抽出品牌系统，再按一份 brief 生成可编辑的落地页、按受众、客户或关键词拆开的变体页，以及配套广告，并能把 Performance Max 推进 Google Ads。帮助中心 2026-10-20 的入门文写：抽取的是颜色、字体和语气，这个功能消耗 Webflow AI credits；表单接 HubSpot 和 Marketo；接上 CRM 后可以看 pipeline。产品页 FAQ 写抽取的是字体、颜色和样式，也可以自己交一份 design.md；pipeline 接到 HubSpot 和 Salesforce。9 月 2 日发布会博文写的是颜色、字体和 UI 元素，并写当时处于 beta、下个月可购买。CMSWire 10 月 20 日的报道把抽取结果说成 DESIGN.md 格式，那是报道的说法。Webflow MCP 可以在 Claude 或 ChatGPT 里建活动、改页面、做变体和看结果；MCP 文写服务器本身不扣额度，生成页面和个性化内容仍按站内同样的 AI credits 计，而且不能用 MCP 抽品牌或做广告。产品页现在的主按钮是 Contact sales。本库没有 Webflow 账号，没有登录试用，也没有在页面上看到公开价目。
cases.summaryEn: Webflow Campaigns is a campaign tool that stands apart from your main CMS. Give it your existing site URL and it extracts a brand system, then turns one brief into an editable landing page, variants by audience, account, or keyword, and matching ads, including a Performance Max push to Google Ads. The 2026-10-20 help article says extraction covers colors, typography, and voice, that the feature spends Webflow AI credits, that forms connect to HubSpot and Marketo, and that pipeline shows up once a CRM is connected. The product FAQ says it captures typography, colors, and styling, and that you can also supply a design.md; it names HubSpot and Salesforce for pipeline. The 2 September Conf post says colors, fonts, and UI elements, and that Campaigns was in beta and would be available for purchase the next month. CMSWire’s 20 October story describes the extract as a DESIGN.md; that wording is the article’s. The Webflow MCP can create campaigns, edit pages, make variants, and read results from Claude or ChatGPT. That article says the server itself does not spend credits, while generating pages or personalized content spends the same AI credits as in Campaigns, and that brand extraction and ads are not available over MCP. The product page’s main button is Contact sales. This library has no Webflow account, did not sign in, and did not see a public price.
cases.qualityNote: 适合看一份 brief 同时出页面、变体和广告。品牌抽取在帮助中心、发布会博文、产品 FAQ 和 CMSWire 上说法不一样，都保留。9 月博文写当时是 beta、下个月可购买；10 月 20 日的帮助中心和现在的产品页已经能打开，主按钮是联系销售，本库没看到公开价格。没有登录试用。

cases.summary: Motion2Code 是给编码 Agent 的 MIT skill。它让助手把一段动效视频还原成内联 SVG 加单条 GSAP 时间线：先把片子拆成能看的帧和色板，再逐帧和原片对比，并把首尾循环做进代码里。网站或 App 的录屏还可以做成带 ScrollTrigger 的可交互页面。README 写支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini 等。脚本要 Python 3.9+ 和 ffmpeg，打开浏览器的那几步另有依赖，写在 README 里。仓库 gallery 里有 6 个成片目录。README 写原片用 fal 上的 MiniMax H3 Max 生成，由 Claude Opus 5.5 按这个 skill 重做。在线画廊能打开，第一页是 Think Big，页上计数写 01 / 09，和仓库里的 6 个目录不是同一个数字，本库没有逐页点完。适合要把一段动效交成可改代码、而不是把视频嵌进页面的人。本库没有安装，也没有跑还原。
cases.summaryEn: Motion2Code is an MIT skill for coding agents. It has the agent rebuild a motion clip as inline SVG driven by one GSAP timeline: study the clip into frames and a palette, compare code to the source frame by frame, and close the loop in code. A screen recording of a site or app can also become an interactive page with ScrollTrigger. The README lists Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, and others. The scripts need Python 3.9+ and ffmpeg; the steps that open a browser have a further dependency named in the README. The repo’s gallery folder has six finished clips. The README says the source clips were generated with MiniMax H3 Max on fal and rebuilt by Claude Opus 5.5 with this skill. The live gallery opens on Think Big and its counter reads 01 / 09, which is not the same number as the six folders; this library did not step through every slide. Good when you want editable code instead of an embedded video. Not installed and not run here.

cases.summary: Lemo-Opuscar 是 Lemomo 做的 Claude Code 技能：51 种影片风格，每种一份风格提示词，再加一支完全用代码做出来的样片。画面、配乐和旁白都由编程助手写代码完成，不用视频模型。画廊把它们分成 10 类。另外有一支特别放映 OPUSCAR 98，用 98 部最佳影片各换一种画风，和这 51 种风格是两套东西。推荐装法是先执行 claude plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar，再执行 claude plugin install lemo-opuscar@lemolab；也可以克隆仓库后在里面打开 Claude。别的助手把 plugin/skills/lemo-opuscar/ 拷进自己的 skills 目录。第一次使用会把指南和风格提示词放到 ~/lemo-opuscar。需要 Node 20+、ffmpeg 和 Python 3.11+。代码和文档是 MIT；样片和静帧是 CC BY 4.0，可以商用，要署名 LemoLab、链回仓库，并说明有没有改过。你自己用这个库拍的片子归你。本库没有安装这个技能，也没有出过片。
cases.summaryEn: Lemo-Opuscar is Lemomo's Claude Code skill: 51 film styles, each a style prompt plus a demo film made entirely in code. Picture, score, and narration are written by the coding agent, with no video model. The gallery groups them into 10 categories. A separate feature, OPUSCAR 98, redraws 98 Best Picture winners and is not one of those 51 styles. The recommended install is claude plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar, then claude plugin install lemo-opuscar@lemolab; or clone the repo and open Claude inside it. Other agents can copy plugin/skills/lemo-opuscar/ into their skills folder. First use downloads the guides and style prompts to ~/lemo-opuscar. You need Node 20+, ffmpeg, and Python 3.11+. Code and docs are MIT; demo films and stills are CC BY 4.0, fine for commercial use if you credit LemoLab, link the repo, and say whether you changed them. Films you make with the library are yours. This library did not install the skill or render a film.
cases.qualityNote: 代码和文档按仓库许可证是 MIT；样片和静帧按说明是 CC BY 4.0，要署名 LemoLab。styles 下数到 51 个风格目录，另有一个模板目录。画廊写 10 类和 49 分钟，片长没有逐支加总。本库没有安装插件，没有出片。

The gallery says 10 categories and 49 minutes; durations were not added up. This library did not install the plugin or render a film.

cases.title: 15 种 MG 动效风格：成片、提示词和全部源码
cases.titleEn: 15 Motion Design Styles — films, prompts, and full source
cases.hook: 15 支 10 秒 MG 短片，提示词和源码都能直接用。
cases.hookEn: Fifteen 10-second motion films, each with its prompt and full source.
cases.summary: 这个仓库收了 15 种动态设计风格，每种一支 10 秒成片。画面、动画、配乐和音效都是 Claude Opus 5.5 按一段提示词写代码做的，不用图像或视频模型；3D 那支的画面用 Blender，网页再叠字。每种都给风格说明、完整提示词和源码。用法是在空文件夹里打开能跑命令的编程助手（说明里举了 Claude Code），把 prompts/ 里的提示词整段贴进去；只改 Creative seed 里的故事、品牌和颜色，Signature features 留着。本机要 Node、Chrome 和 ffmpeg，3D 还要 Blender。许可证是 MIT。页面写这些风格达到商用水准，README 还写 AI 评审分从 7.57 到 8.21，都是作者说法。本库没有渲染任何一支，也没有复跑评审。
cases.summaryEn: The repo collects 15 motion-design styles, each a 10-second film. Picture, animation, music, and sound effects were made by Claude Opus 5.5 writing code from one prompt, with no image or video model; the 3D film's picture is Blender, with type added on a web page. Each style includes notes, the full prompt, and the source. Open a coding agent that can run commands (the docs name Claude Code) in an empty folder and paste a prompt from prompts/; change only the story, brand, and colors in Creative seed, and keep Signature features. The machine needs Node, Chrome, and ffmpeg; the 3D film also needs Blender. The license is MIT. The page calls the styles commercial standard, and the README cites AI-jury scores from 7.57 to 8.21; both are the author's claims. This library did not render a film or rerun the review.

cases.title: Dashboard Design：给 Claude Code 的看板界面技能
cases.titleEn: Dashboard Design — a Claude Code skill for dashboard UI
cases.hook: KPI、图表和日期选择做完，还要过一遍截图。
cases.hookEn: KPI tiles, charts, and date pickers, then a screenshot QA pass.
cases.summary: Dashboard Design 是 Otabek Abdiraimov 的 Claude Code 技能，当前版本 1.3.0。它约束看板怎么做：KPI 磁贴、图表、对比周期、排行条、日期范围、筛选、空状态、宽屏和手机布局，网页用 Tailwind，也有一份 SwiftUI 对照。SKILL.md 的最后一步是截图 QA：网页看三个宽度，SwiftUI 看设备尺寸、最大动态字体、暗色和减弱动效。作者写这套规则来自 127 块已上线看板；sources.md 是一份产品名单，本库没有把「127」逐屏数过。装法可以在 Claude Code 里执行 /plugin marketplace add abdiraimov-otabek/dashboard-design-skill，再 /plugin install dashboard-design@dashboard-design-skill；或克隆后把 skills/dashboard-design 拷到 ~/.claude/skills/。别的助手把规则指到 skills/dashboard-design/SKILL.md。做完一整件工作，技能会加一句作者署名，并提到他的 Mac 应用 Halo 和 Shedi；不想要就删掉 SKILL.md 里的 Sign-off。README 里的看板图是作者自己的 Pulse 应用、用的样例数据。本库没有安装，没有跑 QA。
cases.summaryEn: Dashboard Design is Otabek Abdiraimov's Claude Code skill, currently version 1.3.0. It sets rules for KPI tiles, charts, comparison periods, ranked bars, date ranges, filters, empty states, and wide and phone layouts, with Tailwind for the web and a SwiftUI counterpart. The last step in SKILL.md is a screenshot QA pass: three browser widths on the web, and device sizes, the largest Dynamic Type, dark mode, and Reduce Motion for SwiftUI. The author says the rules come from 127 shipped dashboard screens; sources.md is a product list, and this library did not count those 127 screens. In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add abdiraimov-otabek/dashboard-design-skill, then /plugin install dashboard-design@dashboard-design-skill; or clone and copy skills/dashboard-design to ~/.claude/skills/. Other agents can point their rules at skills/dashboard-design/SKILL.md. When a whole job finishes, the skill adds a one-line author sign-off that mentions his Mac apps Halo and Shedi; delete the Sign-off section in SKILL.md to stop it. The dashboard figure in the README is the author's Pulse app on sample data. This library did not install the skill or run QA.

cases.title: Penmentor：在手写数学页上画圈打勾，给提示不给答案
cases.titleEn: Penmentor: mark handwritten math on the page, with hints instead of answers
cases.hook: 按一下键，让助手在手写数学上画圈、给提示。
cases.hookEn: Press a key and an agent marks handwritten math with hints, not answers.
cases.summary: Penmentor 是 Abdullah Alhariri 的 MIT 开源程序：在 xournal++ 里手写微积分，按一个键，已经登录的 Claude Code、Codex 或 Antigravity 会在这一页上用彩笔批改。README 写它先圈出第一处真正的错误、给做对的行打勾、把受这处错误影响的后面几行画线，按 Esc 才清掉；提示分成几档，从轻轻推一把到点出方法，不直接把答案写完。框住想看懂的一步，它用 3Blue1Brown 的 manim 做可拖动的动画。配套的 xournal++ 插件把当前这一页交给助手，而不只是屏幕上看得见的那一块。设置里用前缀选助手，README 举的例子是 claude:opus、codex:gpt-5.6-terra、agy:gemini-4-argon-medium。适合用数位板做演算、又已经在用这些命令行助手的人。本库没有安装，没有接助手，没有批改过一页。
cases.summaryEn: Penmentor is Abdullah Alhariri’s MIT program: write calculus by hand in xournal++, press a key, and a Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity session you already signed into marks that page in colored pen. The README says it circles the first real mistake, ticks correct lines, underlines later lines that inherit the mistake, and leaves the marks until you press Esc. Hints climb from a nudge to naming the technique, without writing the answer out. Box a step you want to understand and it builds a draggable animation with 3Blue1Brown’s manim. A xournal++ plugin sends the current page, not only what fits on screen. A prefix in Settings picks the agent; the README’s examples are claude:opus, codex:gpt-5.6-terra, and agy:gemini-4-argon-medium. Useful if you already work on a pen tablet and already use one of those command-line agents. This library did not install it, did not connect an agent, and did not mark a page.
cases.qualityNote: 圈错、打勾、分档提示、manim 动画和整页插件都按 README，本库没有安装，也没有让任何模型批改。README 写运行环境是 Linux 的 X11（它说配 i3 最好），还要 rofi、slop、xdotool、PyQt6，以及已经登录的 claude、codex 或 agy 之一。演示动图的说明写明：为了能重复录，笔是脚本在画，模型回答是一段固定例子。手写内容会进你自己的助手订阅。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Circling mistakes, ticks, stepped hints, manim animations, and the whole-page plugin all follow the README. This library did not install it and did not have any model mark a page. The README says it runs on Linux under X11 (best with i3) and needs rofi, slop, xdotool, PyQt6, plus a signed-in claude, codex, or agy. The demo’s caption says that, so the recording can be repeated, the pen is scripted and the model’s answer is a fixed example. Handwriting goes to your own agent subscription.

cases.title: Lovart 2.0 的 Arti：记得你口味、能隔夜交稿的设计助手
cases.titleEn: Arti in Lovart 2.0 — a design agent that remembers your taste and works overnight
cases.hook: 下班前交一份需求，第二天看调研和初稿；反馈会记进它的记忆。
cases.hookEn: Leave a brief before you log off and review research and drafts in the morning.
cases.summary: Lovart 在 2.0 版推出个人设计助手 Arti。官方说法：它记得你的偏好和作品集，下班前排一份需求，第二天就有调研和初稿等你看。Arti 页面列了五件它会自己做的事：定期检查画布、提前标出问题（Canvas check-up）；新项目先上网找竞品、配色和案例，整理成报告（Design research）；自动更新记忆；把你跑顺的流程存成技能，合适时提出来用（Self-evolving skills）；把同事或客户在画布上的评论一键交给它改（Feedback revisions）。定价页把 Arti 标为 Beta，只写在付费档：Starter 按年付每月 16 美元起，每天 2 次委派任务、2 次画布检查、1 次调研，高档位次数更多；免费档没有列 Arti。Lovart 本身是做电商主图、品牌物料、社媒图和短视频的 AI 设计平台。适合已经在用 Lovart、想把重复的出图和改稿交出去的人。本库没有付费账号，没有登录，也没有试过 Arti。
cases.summaryEn: Lovart 2.0 introduces Arti, a personal design agent. Lovart says it remembers your preferences and portfolio, so you can schedule a brief before logging off and wake up to research and drafts. The Arti page lists five things it does on its own: Canvas check-up (looks over your canvases and flags issues early), Design research (searches the web for competitors, palettes and case studies and writes a report for a new project), auto-updated memory, Self-evolving skills (workflows you have nailed become skills it suggests later), and Feedback revisions (send teammate or client canvas comments to Arti in one click and it revises). The pricing page marks Arti as Beta on paid plans only: Starter from $16 a month billed annually, with 2 delegated tasks, 2 canvas check-ups and 1 research run a day, and more on higher tiers; the free plan does not list Arti. Lovart itself is an AI design platform for e-commerce images, brand assets, social graphics and short video. Good if you already use Lovart and want to hand off repeat image work and revisions. This library has no paid account, did not sign in, and did not try Arti.
cases.qualityNote: 官方发布帖加官网功能页和定价页，功能描述都是 Lovart 自己的说法。Arti 是 Beta、只在付费档；本库没有付费账号，没试委派任务、画布检查或调研报告的实际效果，也没核对按次数之外的额度怎么扣。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The official launch post plus Lovart’s feature and pricing pages; every capability is Lovart’s own description. Arti is Beta and paid-only; this library has no paid account, did not try delegated tasks, canvas check-ups or research reports, and did not check how usage beyond the daily counts is billed.

cases.title: 反推品牌规范提示词：让 Claude Code 量出一个网站的字体、配色和组件
cases.titleEn: Reverse-brand prompt — have Claude Code measure a site’s type, colour and components
cases.hook: 给一个网址，让 Claude 实测字体配色，产出非官方品牌手册。
cases.hookEn: Give Claude Code a URL; it measures type, colour and grid into an unofficial guide.
cases.summary: 设计师 Amir Mušić 在 X 上分享的一段长提示词：贴进 Claude Code（或任何能跑命令、开浏览器、写文件的 Claude 环境），填上网址和配图方式，它会先写一个可复用的命令行工具 reverse-brand，再拿它去分析那个网站。流程分九步：用本机 Chrome 无头打开首页和 3–5 个关键页（含 390px 手机宽度），逐个元素记下字体、字号、行高、颜色、间距、圆角、阴影和断点；聚类出字号层级、颜色角色、间距基数和按钮卡片变体，从文案里统计出三条语气规则；导出 CSS 变量和 W3C design-tokens JSON；再用这些 token 拼出一份长得像对方官网的非官方品牌手册（无图版 ≤150 KB、带图版），外加 Instagram 轮播图、X 配图和一段 60 帧演示视频，最后写 verify.js 自检并截图复查。提示词写死了几条底线：每一页标「非官方分析」，不复制 logo、字体文件和对方图片，遇到人机验证就停下让人处理，AI 配图只能从文字生成并标注。作者原帖拿 Revolut 做了示范。适合想快速摸清某个品牌视觉体系、或给自己产品倒推一份 token 的设计师。本库没有跑这段提示词。
cases.summaryEn: A long prompt shared on X by designer Amir Mušić. Paste it into Claude Code (or any Claude setup with a shell, a browser and file access), set the URL and image mode, and it first writes a reusable CLI called reverse-brand, then runs it on that site. The nine steps: open the home page and 3–5 key pages in headless local Chrome (plus a 390px mobile pass) and record every element’s font, size, line height, colour, spacing, radius, shadow and breakpoint; cluster a type scale, colour roles, a spacing base and button and card variants, and derive three voice rules from copy statistics; export CSS variables and W3C design-tokens JSON; rebuild an unofficial brand guide that looks like the brand’s own site using only those tokens (an image-free edition under 150 KB and an image edition), plus an Instagram carousel, X images and a 60 fps presentation video; finally write verify.js and review screenshots. The prompt fixes some hard limits: every page says “Unofficial analysis”, no logos, font files or brand images are copied, it stops at bot checks for a human, and AI images come from text prompts only and are labelled. The author demonstrated it on Revolut. Useful for designers who want a fast read of a brand’s visual system or to back-derive tokens for their own product. This library did not run the prompt.
cases.qualityNote: 提示词全文公开，步骤和底线都照原文写。本库没有在 Claude Code 里跑过，量出来的值准不准、要花多少 token 和配图费用都没验证；原帖下也有人指出间距 token 还要手调、语气只看首页文案会偏。产物明确是非官方分析，别拿去当对方的官方规范。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The full prompt is public and the steps and limits follow it. This library did not run it in Claude Code, so measurement accuracy and token and image costs are unverified; replies under the post also note that spacing tokens still need hand-tuning and homepage-only voice analysis can skew. The output is explicitly unofficial; do not treat it as the brand’s own guidelines.

cases.title: huashu-motion：让编程助手做产品发布片、配乐，指着画面改
cases.titleEn: huashu-motion: an agent skill for launch films with a score, edited by pointing at the frame
cases.hook: 一句话让助手写片、作曲，再点画面哪里改哪里。
cases.hookEn: Ask your agent for a launch film with a score, then click the frame to fix it.
cases.summary: huashu-motion 是花叔（alchaincyf）开源的 agent skill，代码和文档是 MIT。对 Claude Code、Codex 这类助手说「给我的产品做个30秒的发布片」，README 写它会先读产品、给三个方向挑，再写整支片子，用 ABC 记谱写配乐，最后在浏览器里打开编辑器 om studio 等你。按 C 在画面上点一下、写下要改什么，评论带着时间点、场景、点中的元素和源码位置交给助手，它只改那一处。一支片子就是一个 index.html，画面用 GSAP、Canvas、Three.js、SVG 写，不调用视频生成模型；可以导出 MP4、带透明通道的 MOV、WebM、GIF，或一个带播放器的分享页。自带 10 个模板，有数据图表、关键词快切、3b1b 式公式、白板手绘、口播包装等，口播包装能出透明叠层直接拖进剪映或 Premiere。需要 Node 22 以上、Chrome 和 FFmpeg；README 写目前只在 macOS 上实测过。适合想给自己的产品、报告或口播视频做动效包装的人。本库在 Linux 上用一个模板渲出了一支 8 秒的视频，没有让助手跑完整的发布片流程。
cases.summaryEn: huashu-motion is an open-source agent skill by Huashu (alchaincyf); code and docs are MIT. Tell an assistant such as Claude Code or Codex “make a 30-second launch film for my product,” and the README says it reads the product, offers three directions, writes the film, scores it in ABC notation, and opens the om studio editor in your browser. Press C, click the frame, and write the change; the comment reaches the agent with the time, scene, clicked element, and source location, and only that spot is changed. A film is one index.html drawn with GSAP, Canvas, Three.js, or SVG, with no video-generation model. Exports are MP4, MOV with alpha, WebM, GIF, or a share page with a player. Ten templates ship with it, including data charts, kinetic type, 3b1b-style equations, whiteboard doodles, and talking-head packaging that exports a transparent overlay for CapCut or Premiere. It needs Node 22+, Chrome, and FFmpeg; the README says it has only been tested on macOS. Useful when you want motion packaging for a product, a report, or a talking-head video. This library rendered an 8-second clip from one template on Linux and did not run the full agent workflow.
cases.qualityNote: 先读产品、出三个方向、写谱配乐、指着画面改，这些流程都按 README，本库没有让助手跑一遍。README 写只在 macOS 上实测过；本库在 Linux 上 om doctor 全部通过，用 kinetic-type 模板直接渲出 8 秒 1920×1080 的 MP4（加了 --silent，没有配乐），没有打开 om studio，没有下载约 55MB 的真乐器采样，也没有试口播。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 半小时花 1.95 元、发布片被当成官方片，都是作者自述。GSAP 用的是它自己的免费许可，不是 MIT；「豆子花叔」卡通形象不随 MIT 授权。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Reading the product, offering three directions, scoring, and point-to-edit all follow the README; this library did not have an agent run them. The README says it is only tested on macOS. On Linux, om doctor passed every check and the kinetic-type template rendered straight to an 8-second 1920×1080 MP4 (with --silent, no score). This library did not open om studio, did not download the roughly 55 MB instrument samples, and did not try narration. The ¥1.95, half-hour DeepSeek V4.1 Flash film and the launch film being mistaken for an official one are the author’s own accounts. GSAP ships under its own no-charge licence, not MIT, and the “bean Huashu” cartoon character is not covered by the MIT grant.

cases.title: Spotnote：在页面上点元素写改动，交给编程助手精确到行
cases.titleEn: Spotnote: click an element, write the change, hand your agent the exact line
cases.hook: 点页面上的元素写一句，助手拿到文件、行和列。
cases.hookEn: Click an element, write the change, and your agent gets the file, line, and column.
cases.summary: Spotnote 是 harukikuri 做的 Vite 插件，MIT。开发服务器页面左下角多一个按钮，点开后点任一元素、写一句要改什么、按 Enter，剪贴板里就是一段给助手的提示词：你的要求、源文件和行列、在哪个组件里被调用、元素和文字、同一行代码渲染出的第几个，以及当前的 padding、圆角、字号等计算样式。贴进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 都可以；也能装 spotnote-mcp，让助手直接收到笔记，改完在笔记上回话。默认只在 vite dev 里运行，staging 构建要自己打开；不用账号，笔记存在本机。支持 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、Astro，需要 Vite 5 以上和 Node 22 以上；Next.js 等不用 Vite 的项目不支持。第三方组件库里的元素、v-html 这类注入的 HTML、图表等脚本生成的 DOM，只能指到最近的源码祖先。适合在浏览器里挑 UI 毛病、再交给助手改的设计师和开发者。本库在一个 React 小项目和官方 Playground 里试过复制提示词，没有接 MCP。
cases.summaryEn: Spotnote, by harukikuri, is an MIT Vite plugin. Your dev page gets a button in the bottom-left corner: open it, click any element, write what should change, and press Enter. The clipboard then holds a prompt for your agent with the request, the source file with line and column, where the component is used, the element and its text, which instance of that line it is, and computed styles such as padding, radius, and font size. Paste it into Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, or install spotnote-mcp so the agent receives notes directly and replies on them. It runs only under vite dev unless you turn it on for a staging build; there is no account and notes stay on your machine. It supports React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Astro, and needs Vite 5+ and Node 22+; Next.js and other non-Vite setups are not supported. Elements from a component library, injected HTML such as v-html, and script-built DOM such as charts resolve only to the nearest stamped ancestor. Useful for designers and developers who spot UI issues in the browser and hand them to an agent. This library copied prompts in a small React app and in the official Playground; MCP was not connected.
cases.qualityNote: 本库装了 0.3.3，在自建的 React + Vite 8 小页面和官方 Playground 各点了一个元素，复制出的提示词里文件、行列、实例序号和计算样式都和源码对得上。README 写需要 Node 22，本库用 Node 22 跑。没有装 spotnote-mcp，没有试 staging 构建和 webhook，也没有让助手照提示词改代码。官方说明写笔记跟着位置走：改动挪了开头标签、或列表重新排序后，笔记可能脱落或指到别的项。
cases.qualityNoteEn: This library installed 0.3.3 and clicked one element in a small React + Vite 8 page and one in the official Playground. The file, line and column, instance number, and computed styles in the copied prompts matched the source. cases.title: Design System Loop：让编程助手查设计系统、按计划补组件
cases.titleEn: Design System Loop: let your coding agent audit and repair your design system
cases.hook: 先在本地查出绕开 token 的样式，再让助手按证据补。
cases.hookEn: Find styles that bypass your tokens, then let your agent fix them from the evidence.
cases.summary: Design System Loop（npm 包 ds-loop）是 owaizin 做的开源工具，MIT，分成两部分：一个本地检查引擎，和一份给编程助手用的 skill。在项目目录跑 npx ds-loop，它读 CSS 里的变量和规则，列出绕开 token 的硬编码颜色、间距等问题，每条都指到源文件和行，并在本地写一份 HTML 报告。报告明确写计数不是质量分，也列出没检查到的部分。接着用 npx ds-loop install --agent codex（或 claude、cursor、all）把 skill 接进助手，让助手先只读调查、提计划，你同意后再改共享组件、用法示例和设计决策记录；README 建议的第一句是「先只读」。官网写需要 Node.js 22.6 以上。适合组件越来越多、助手老在重造按钮的团队。本库在一个自建的小项目上跑过检查，没有把 skill 交给助手。
cases.summaryEn: Design System Loop (npm package ds-loop), by owaizin, is an MIT open-source tool in two parts: a local check engine and a skill for your coding agent. Run npx ds-loop in a project and it reads CSS variables and rules, lists hard-coded colors, spacing, and other values that bypass your tokens with the file and line for each, and writes an HTML report locally. The report says its counts are not a quality grade and lists what it did not check. Then npx ds-loop install --agent codex (or claude, cursor, all) wires the skill into your agent, which investigates read-only, proposes a plan, and, once you approve, changes shared components, usage examples, and decision records; the README’s suggested first prompt says to start read-only. The site asks for Node.js 22.6+. Useful for teams whose component count is growing and whose agent keeps rebuilding buttons. This library ran the check on a small test project and did not hand the skill to an agent.
cases.qualityNote: 本库只跑了 0.4.0 的检查：在一个故意写了硬编码颜色和间距的小项目里，它报了 4 组问题（3 高、1 中），位置都指到 CSS 文件。这一版的读取器只读 .css，同一项目 JSX 里的内联硬编码样式没有被报出来，用 Tailwind 或 CSS-in-JS 的项目要留意覆盖面。没有运行 install，没有让助手写 consult.json，也没有试 report 命令和 Claude Code 插件。官网和 README 里的网址不一样，两个都能打开。
cases.qualityNoteEn: This library ran only the 0.4.0 check. On a small project seeded with hard-coded colors and spacing it reported 4 finding groups (3 high, 1 medium), all located in CSS files. This version’s readers only read .css, so inline hard-coded styles in the same project’s JSX were not reported; projects on Tailwind or CSS-in-JS should check the coverage. install was not run, no agent wrote consult.json, and the report command and Claude Code plugin were not tried. The site and the README use different addresses; both open.

cases.title: UI Design Editor：浏览器里的免费设计画布，AI 可以接着改
cases.titleEn: UI Design Editor: a free browser canvas your AI can keep editing
cases.hook: 把截图或 HTML 放进画布，你挪完再交给 AI。
cases.hookEn: Drop a screenshot or HTML on the canvas, then hand it back to the AI.
cases.summary: UI Design Editor 是一个免费的网页设计画布，不用注册。左边可以加文字、图标、按钮、方框和箭头，也能把截图放上去切开再挪。侧栏的 Connect AI 给一段提示词，让你贴进 Codex、Claude 这类助手；README 写助手用页面上的 WebMCP 工具读设计和改元素。仓库简介仍写「100% local in your browser」，但当前 README 和打开的编辑器不是这样：第一次访问会建一个 Space，侧栏显示已保存，改动存到服务器，拿到链接的人都能读和改。导出的 HTML 按 README 可以单独留下。适合想先用手挪界面、再让助手接着改的人。本库没有把提示词贴进任何助手，也没有改画布上的元素。
cases.summaryEn: UI Design Editor is a free browser design canvas with no sign-up. You can add text, icons, buttons, boxes, and arrows, or drop in a screenshot, cut a piece out, and move it. Connect AI in the sidebar gives a prompt to paste into an assistant such as Codex or Claude; the README says the assistant reads and edits the design with WebMCP tools on the page. The repo description still says “100% local in your browser,” but the current README and the live editor do not: the first visit creates a Space, the sidebar shows it as saved, edits go to the server, and anyone with the link can read and change every project. The README says an HTML export can stand on its own. Useful when you want to move the interface by hand and then let an assistant continue. This library did not paste the prompt into any assistant and did not move elements on the canvas.
cases.qualityNote: 线上编辑器会保存 Space，持有链接的人可以读写，不是只留在这台浏览器里的草稿。仓库简介里的「100% local」和当前 README 不一致，本条以后者为准。本库没有安装自托管版本，没有调用页面上的工具，没有导出 HTML，也没有核对服务器上还留着什么。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The live editor saves a Space, and anyone with the link can read and edit it. That is not a draft that stays only in this browser. The repo blurb still says “100% local”; the current README does not, and this entry follows the README. This library did not install the self-hosted app, did not call the page tools, did not export HTML, and did not check what the server kept.

cases.title: Agent Glyphs：按语义和笔画挑开源图标，免得助手编造图标名
cases.titleEn: Agent Glyphs — search open icons by meaning and stroke so agents stop inventing names
cases.hook: 给助手一份按语义和笔画筛过的开源图标索引。
cases.hookEn: An open icon index so agents stop inventing icon names.
cases.summary: Agent Glyphs 是给设计和编程助手用的开源图标索引，代码 MIT。首页徽章写着 415,236 个图标、248 个库；作者帖子把同一份索引写成约 415,000 个图标、248 个库。可以按意思搜（英文或阿拉伯语），再按外形、颜色、圆角、笔画、疏密、分类和许可证筛，许可证默认停在允许商用。装进助手的命令是 npx skills add molamine08/agent-glyphs，页面写它适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex，以及任何支持 skills 的助手。图标仍用各库自己的许可证，从 Iconify 或该库的仓库取，不把 Iconify 图标重新打包分发。适合不想让助手编造图标名的人。本库在网页上用阿拉伯语搜过「钱包」，并点开过圆角筛选，没有安装 skill。
cases.summaryEn: Agent Glyphs is an open icon index for designers and coding agents; the code is MIT. The homepage badge reads 415,236 icons across 248 libraries, and the author's post states that same index as about 415,000 icons from 248 libraries. Search by meaning in English or Arabic, then filter by shape, color, corners, stroke, density, category, and licence. The licence filter sits on commercial use. The install line is npx skills add molamine08/agent-glyphs. The page says it works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any agent that supports skills. Each icon keeps its library licence and is fetched from Iconify or that library's repository; Iconify icons are not redistributed. Good when an agent should stop inventing icon names. This library searched the page in Arabic for wallet and opened the corner filter. The skill was not installed.

cases.title: Kapwing AI Camera Controls：给 AI 视频提示词用的镜头词
cases.titleEn: Kapwing AI Camera Controls — camera words for AI video prompts
cases.hook: 写视频提示词时，按机位、运镜和景别挑模型认得的词。
cases.hookEn: Pick angle, movement, and shot size in words video models know.
cases.summary: Kapwing 的 AI Camera Controls 是一页给 AI 视频提示词用的镜头词参考。页头写：摄影机在哪、看到多少、怎么动，决定成片像被导过还是像随机生成。下面分成角度、运动、景别和术语。角度一栏写的是同一个人、六种高度，能看到平视、俯视、仰视和虫视，旁边是可以复制的整句提示词。运动一栏能看到横摇、俯仰、变焦、跟焦、推拉、横移、环绕和升降。适合写视频提示词、但不知道镜头该怎么说的人。本库看了角度示意，没有登录，也没有把提示词交给视频模型。
cases.summaryEn: Kapwing's AI Camera Controls is a camera-language reference for AI video prompts. The page says where the camera sits, how much it sees, and how it moves decide whether a clip feels directed or random. Below that are angle, movement, shot size, and terms. The angle section is the same person at six heights, including eye level, high, low, and worm's-eye, next to a full prompt you can copy. The movement section includes pan, tilt, zoom, rack focus, dolly, truck, orbit, and crane. Good when you are writing a video prompt and do not know the camera words. This library looked at the angle diagram, did not sign in, and did not send a prompt to a video model.
cases.qualityNote: 角度、运镜、景别和一键复制的提示词都来自 Kapwing 这一页。没有登录，也没有把提示词交给视频模型生成。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Angle, movement, shot size, and the one-click prompts are from Kapwing's own page. Not signed in, and no prompt was sent to a video model.

cases.title: Llmspeed：买硬件前，先看本地模型在这台机器上多快出字
cases.titleEn: Llmspeed — feel local-model speed on a machine before you buy it
cases.hook: 买硬件前，先感受这块机器跑本地模型有多快出字。
cases.hookEn: Feel how fast a local model types on that hardware before you buy.
cases.summary: Llmspeed 用来在买显卡或整机之前，先选硬件、模型和量化，看本地大模型出字大概多快。页面写明：按短提示、单台设备估计；标成 Measured 的数字来自社区基准（页面点名 r/LocalLLaMA 和 localscore.ai 等），其余由相近配置推算，或按规格投影。默认是 NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB、Llama 3.1 8B、Q4_K_M。这一档页面给出 86–129 tok/s；点 Run 之后，短对话按页面显示以约 108 tok/s、首字约 0.3 秒走完。展开的计算说明写：权重大约 8.03B，Q4_K_M 文件大约 4.9 GB。它不是一款新模型，所以放在 Cases，不进模型板。适合想比较这块卡跑这个模型顺不顺的人。本库只点了网页上的这次模拟，没有在本机加载模型。
cases.summaryEn: Llmspeed is for looking, before you buy a GPU or a whole machine, at how fast a local model will type on that hardware, model, and quantization. The page says the figures are for a short prompt on one device. Numbers it marks Measured come from community benchmarks (it names r/LocalLLaMA, localscore.ai, and others); the rest are derived from similar setups or projected from specs. The default is an NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB, Llama 3.1 8B, Q4_K_M. For that combo the page shows 86–129 tok/s. After Run, the short chat played at about 108 tok/s with a time to first token of about 0.3 seconds, as the page displayed it. The calculation note says about 8.03B weights and a Q4_K_M file of about 4.9 GB. This is not a new model, so it lives in Cases rather than on the model board. Good when you want a feel for whether that card runs that model. This library only played the on-page simulation and did not load a model locally.
cases.qualityNote: 出字速度是网页上的模拟。标成实测的数字来自页面引用的社区基准，不是本库复测。点过默认的短对话；没有在本机加载模型。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The typing speed is the page's simulation. Figures it marks as measured come from the community benchmarks the page cites, and were not re-run here. The default short chat was played once. No model was loaded locally.

cases.title: Doory：开源、在浏览器里跑的 Canva 式设计编辑器
cases.titleEn: Doory — an open-source, browser-based Canva-style design editor
cases.hook: 浏览器里的开源设计编辑器，不注册也能开始做。
cases.hookEn: An open-source browser editor for posters, posts, and cards.
cases.summary: Doory 是跑在浏览器里的开源设计编辑器，作者 Siam 把它做成 Canva 式的替代：海报、社媒帖、故事、幻灯片、邀请函、简历、缩略图和名片都能做。不注册也能开始，访客的作品先存在这台浏览器里；没有付费档，也没有锁功能。导出 PNG、JPG、SVG、PDF、MP4、WebM 和 GIF，打印用的 PDF 可以带出血和裁切线。README 写大约 25,000 个图标、曲线文字、蒙版和滤镜，抠图在浏览器里完成；动画是 27 个进入/退出、12 个强调，另有 16 种页面转场。可以用 Docker 自托管，也可以不装 Docker 在自己的服务器上跑。模板库还小，目前随项目带了 10 个起始模板。技术栈是浏览器里的 React 19、Fabric.js、Yjs，服务端 Django 5。许可是 Attribution Assurance License：可以商用、可以改，但运行中的应用必须醒目署上作者。README 要求的句子是 “Doory by Siam, creator and maintainer of Doory”。适合想自己留一套设计编辑器、又不想先注册的人。本库没有用 Docker 自托管，也没有在编辑器里做完一张图再导出。
cases.summaryEn: Doory is an open-source design editor that runs in the browser. Siam built it as a Canva-style alternative for posters, social posts, stories, slides, invitations, resumes, thumbnails, and business cards. You can start without an account; guest work stays in that browser. There is no paid plan and no locked feature. Export PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF, MP4, WebM, and GIF. Print PDFs can include bleed and crop marks. The README lists about 25,000 icons, curved text, masks, and filters, plus background removal that runs in the browser. Motion is 27 enter and exit animations, 12 emphasis animations, and 16 page transitions. You can self-host it with Docker, or without Docker on your own server. The template library is still small: ten starter templates ship with the project. The stack is React 19, Fabric.js, and Yjs in the browser, and Django 5 on the server. The license is the Attribution Assurance License: commercial use and changes are allowed, but the running app must show a prominent credit. The README’s required line is “Doory by Siam, creator and maintainer of Doory”. Good when you want a design editor you keep yourself and do not want to sign up first. This library did not self-host it with Docker and did not finish a design and export it.
cases.qualityNote: 品类、导出格式、动画数量、10 个起始模板、Docker 自托管和技术栈都照 README。许可是 Attribution Assurance License，运行中的应用必须醒目署上作者。本库没有自托管，也没有在编辑器里导出过文件。Adafruit 那篇转述没有打开，不作为依据。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Formats, animation counts, the ten starter templates, Docker self-hosting, and the stack follow the README. The license is the Attribution Assurance License, and the running app must show a prominent author credit. This library did not self-host it or export a file from the editor. The Adafruit write-up did not open, so it is not used as a source.

cases.title: Topview 3D Builder：先在 3D 里摆好场景和机位，再交给视频模型出片
cases.titleEn: Topview 3D Builder — stage the scene and camera in 3D, then hand it to a video model
cases.hook: 先在 3D 里定好站位和机位，再交给视频模型出片。
cases.hookEn: Lock blocking and camera in 3D, then hand the scene to a video model.
cases.summary: Topview 3D Builder 让编程助手先在 3D 里把场景摆好，再交给视频模型出片。你用一句话描述镜头，助手用内置素材摆人、姿势、基础体和相机。仓库素材清单里是 4 个角色（Child、Youth、Female、Man）、121 个姿势、5 种基础体（方块、球体、圆柱、圆锥、平面）；相机按需要加，另有一个俯瞰总览。3D 场景定的是站位、比例和机位；质感、光照和表演由后面的视频模型生成。README 写本地构建和渲染不需要账号，也不上传，项目留在本机的 .topview-3d/ 目录。代码是 Apache-2.0；内置素材是 CC BY 4.0，要求署名为 “Scene3D built-in assets © Topview, CC BY 4.0”。可以装进 ChatGPT/Codex、Claude Code、Cursor，以及其他支持 skills 的助手；PyPI 上有 topview-3d-cli。产品页写的是另一套云端：描述场景或上传参考，建一个可编辑的 3D 场景是 $0.10，然后再设相机出片。FAQ 写这 $0.10 是场景构建的价钱，方便在花钱生成视频之前多排练站位。产品页没有提到开源本地版。适合本来就要画分镜、又想把镜头收成一份能改的文件的人。本库没有安装插件或 CLI，没有建场景，也没有调用视频模型。
cases.summaryEn: Topview 3D Builder has a coding agent stage the shot in 3D, then hands that scene to a video model. You describe the shot; the agent places people, poses, primitives, and cameras from the built-in set. The repo’s asset manifest has 4 characters (Child, Youth, Female, Man), 121 poses, and 5 primitives (box, sphere, cylinder, cone, plane). Cameras are added as needed, plus a bird’s-eye overview. The 3D scene fixes blocking, scale, and camera angles. Texture, lighting, and performance come from the video model. The README says local building and rendering need no account and upload nothing; the project stays in a .topview-3d/ folder on your machine. Code is Apache-2.0. Built-in assets are CC BY 4.0, credited as “Scene3D built-in assets © Topview, CC BY 4.0”. It installs into ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents with skills support. PyPI has topview-3d-cli. The product page is a separate cloud path: describe a scene or upload a reference, and building one editable 3D scene costs $0.10, then you set the camera and generate. The FAQ says that $0.10 is the scene-build price, so you can rehearse blocking before spending on video generation. The product page does not mention the open-source local build. Good when you already storyboard and want the shot saved as a file you can edit. This library did not install the plugin or CLI, did not build a scene, and did not call a video model.
cases.qualityNote: 角色、姿势和 5 种基础体照仓库素材清单；本地免费、不需要账号照 README。云端每次建场景 $0.10 照产品页，那一页没写开源本地版。本库没有安装，没有建场景，也没有调用视频模型。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Character, pose, and five-primitive counts follow the repo asset manifest. Local use with no account follows the README. The $0.10 cloud scene build follows the product page, which does not mention the open-source local build. This library did not install it, build a scene, or call a video model.

cases.title: Reason Network：让编程助手互相派活，避免同时改同一处
cases.titleEn: Reason Network — coding agents assign work and see each other's repo
cases.hook: 让本机编程助手互相派活，并看到彼此在改哪个仓库。
cases.hookEn: Local coding agents assign each other work and see who is in which repo.
cases.summary: Reason Network 由 Reason（@reasonmachines，YC 支持）做。它让本机的 Codex、Cursor、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Copilot CLI、opencode、Pi、Grok Bot、Muse 互相派活，并看到彼此在改哪个仓库、哪条分支，多个助手同时写代码不撞车。队友的助手可以加入同一个工作区。同一局域网里的流量直连，端到端加密。安装是 `curl -fsSL https://reasonmachines.com/install.sh | bash`，然后 `reason network setup`。免费；云端 Reason 会话另外计费。网络引擎开源（Apache 2.0），Reason 命令行工具不开源。本库没有安装，也没有让助手互相对话。
cases.summaryEn: Reason Network is from Reason (@reasonmachines, YC-backed). It lets coding agents on your machine assign work to each other and see who is in which repo and branch, so several assistants can code without colliding: Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, opencode, Pi, Grok Bot, and Muse. Teammates' agents can join the same workspace. Traffic on the same LAN is direct and end-to-end encrypted. Install with `curl -fsSL https://reasonmachines.com/install.sh | bash`, then `reason network setup`. Free; cloud Reason sessions are billed separately. The network engine is open source (Apache 2.0); the Reason CLI is not. This library did not install it or have agents talk.
cases.qualityNote: 适合同时开着好几个编程助手、想互相派活又不撞车的人。网络免费，云端 Reason 会话另外计费。网络引擎是 Apache 2.0，Reason 命令行工具不开源。本库没有安装，也没有让助手互相对话。

cases.title: Stylebot：开源扩展，用手或编程助手改任意网站样式
cases.titleEn: Stylebot — open-source extension to restyle any site by hand or with a coding agent
cases.hook: 在真网页上改样式，也能让编程助手截图核对。
cases.hookEn: Restyle a live page, or let a coding agent check it with screenshots.
cases.summary: Stylebot 是免费开源的浏览器扩展（MIT）：在 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 里点选元素改样式，也可以直接写 CSS，改动会立刻生效，下次打开同一网站自动套上。官网有一批可复制的起步样式，其中包括 Hacker News 的 Newspaper。可选连接 Google Drive，把样式同步到别的电脑。新的命令行 @stylebot/cli 配有 Claude Code 技能，让编程助手在已经打开的浏览器里改样式，并用截图核对；文档写命令行目前支持 Chrome、Edge 等 Chromium 系，还不支持 Firefox。适合想改自己常看的网页，或让助手按截图迭代样式的人。本库没有安装扩展，也没有运行命令行。
cases.summaryEn: Stylebot is a free, open-source browser extension (MIT). In Chrome, Edge, or Firefox you point at an element and restyle it, or write CSS; changes apply immediately and load again the next time you open that site. The site offers starter styles you can copy, including a Newspaper look for Hacker News. Google Drive sync is optional and carries styles to other computers. The new @stylebot/cli command, with a Claude Code skill in the repo, lets a coding agent restyle a page in the browser you already have open and check the result with screenshots. The CLI docs cover Chrome, Edge, and other Chromium browsers, and say Firefox is not supported yet. Good when you want to restyle sites you actually read, or let an agent iterate from screenshots. This library did not install the extension or run the CLI.
cases.qualityNote: 免费开源，商店链接列出 Chrome、Edge、Firefox。命令行文档写明还不支持 Firefox 与 Safari。官网起步样式含 Hacker News 的 Newspaper；作者在 Show HN 里说用户互相分享安装的画廊仍是下一步。Google Drive 同步可选。仓库带 Claude Code 技能。本库没有安装扩展，也没有运行命令行。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Free and open source; the store links list Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. The CLI docs say Firefox and Safari are not supported yet. Starter styles on the site include a Newspaper look for Hacker News; in the Show HN post the author says a gallery where people share and install each other’s styles is still the next step. Google Drive sync is optional. The repo includes a Claude Code skill. This library did not install the extension or run the CLI.

cases.title: FigCraft：开源的 Figma 式界面与原型编辑器（浏览器可试）
cases.titleEn: FigCraft — open-source Figma-like UI and prototype editor you can try in the browser
cases.hook: 开源的 Figma 式编辑器，自动布局、组件和原型都有。
cases.hookEn: An open-source Figma-like editor with auto layout, components, and prototypes.
cases.summary: FigCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队用 Rust 写的开源界面与原型工具，版面接近 Figma：自动布局、组件与变体、原型，以及检查代码（CSS、HTML、React、SwiftUI、Compose）。浏览器版在 figcraft.run，页眉写网页构建 v0.6.0、2026 年 10 月 14 日发布，免费、不用账号。它仍是 alpha：浏览器构建不能保存、不能导出、也不能打开文件，关掉标签稿就没了。核心编辑器没有生成式 AI。站点另加的 AI 面板是分开的，用你自己的 OpenAI、Gemini 或 OpenRouter 密钥，或用 Craft Apps 点数（新账号 30 个免费点数，用完可买一次性点数包）。设计留在标签页里，只有提示会发给所选服务。MCP 要桌面版或命令行，驱动不了这个浏览器编辑器。这和库里的 artcraft-crafting-apps 不是同一条：那条是 PhotoCraft、VectorCraft 等七款创作软件，这条是 Figma 式的界面与原型应用。适合想在浏览器里试开源设计工具、又接受不能在网页里存档的人。本库没有运行 AI 面板，也没有安装桌面版。
cases.summaryEn: FigCraft is the ArtCraft team’s open-source UI and prototype tool, written in Rust, with a layout close to Figma: auto layout, components and variants, prototypes, and inspect/code for CSS, HTML, React, SwiftUI, and Compose. The browser build at figcraft.run says web build v0.6.0, released 14 October 2026, free, with no account. It is still alpha: the browser build cannot save, export, or open files, so closing the tab drops the work. The core editor has no generative AI. The site adds a separate AI panel that uses your own OpenAI, Gemini, or OpenRouter key, or Craft Apps credits (30 free credits for a new account, then one-time credit packs). Designs stay in the tab; only the prompt goes to the provider you chose. MCP needs the desktop app or the CLI and cannot drive this browser editor. This is not the in-library artcraft-crafting-apps entry, which covers PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, and the other five creative apps; this one is the Figma-like UI and prototype app. Good when you want to try an open-source design tool in the browser and can accept that the page cannot keep the file. This library did not run the AI panel or install the desktop app.
cases.qualityNote: 与已收录的 PhotoCraft 等七款创作软件不是同一条。浏览器构建不能保存、导出或打开文件；常见问答仍写 0.5 不能保存，页眉写的是 v0.6.0。AI 面板可选，核心没有生成式 AI；自备密钥不另收费，点数含 30 个免费额度和一次性付费包。MCP 需要桌面版或命令行，不能驱动浏览器编辑器。本库没有运行 AI 面板，没有安装桌面版，也没有接 MCP。

The browser build cannot save, export, or open files; the FAQ still says 0.5 cannot save, while the page header says v0.6.0. The AI panel is optional and the core editor has no generative AI; your own key adds no FigCraft charge, and credits include 30 free plus one-time paid packs. MCP needs the desktop app or CLI and cannot drive the browser editor. This library did not run the AI panel, install the desktop app, or connect MCP.

cases.title: OpenUI：开源生成式 UI 标准，让助手用组件回答而不是贴墙文字
cases.titleEn: OpenUI — open generative-UI standard so agents answer with components
cases.hook: 助手用组件作答，而不是贴一整墙文字。
cases.hookEn: Agents answer with components instead of a wall of text.
cases.summary: OpenUI 是 Thesys 维护的开源生成式界面标准，仓库为 MIT。模型可以按你已经在用的组件流式画出卡片、表单、图表或整屏，而不是只回一段文字。官网写它不绑某一种模型、前端框架或组件库；中间格式叫 OpenUI Lang，一行一个组件，回答还在生成时界面就可以出来。Gateway 写在生产环境里修掉不合法输出，并继续用现有的 Chat Completions / Responses SDK。起步是 npx @openuidev/cli@latest create；在项目里再跑 setup-agent，会把用法写进 AGENTS.md，给 Codex、Cursor、Claude Code 这类编程助手看。这和 Weights & Biases 的 wandb/openui 不是同一个项目，也不是 open-ui.org。适合想让助手用组件回答的人。本库没有跑 create 或 setup-agent，也没有接 Gateway。
cases.summaryEn: OpenUI is the open generative-UI standard maintained by Thesys; the repo is MIT. A model can stream cards, forms, charts, or a full screen from components you already use, instead of returning only a paragraph. The site says it is not tied to one model, frontend framework, or component library. The format is OpenUI Lang, one component per line, so the interface can render while the answer is still streaming. Gateway is described as repairing invalid output in production while keeping the Chat Completions and Responses SDKs you already use. Start with npx @openuidev/cli@latest create; setup-agent writes usage notes into AGENTS.md for coding agents such as Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. This is not Weights & Biases’ wandb/openui, and it is not open-ui.org. Good when you want an assistant to answer with components. This library did not run create or setup-agent, and did not connect Gateway.
cases.qualityNote: 本库未跑 create/setup-agent、未接 Gateway 实测；功能照官网与仓库。不是 wandb/openui，也不是 open-ui.org。
cases.qualityNoteEn: This library did not run create or setup-agent and did not connect Gateway; features follow the site and the repo. This is not wandb/openui and not open-ui.org.
cases.verifyLog: 2026-10-16 早间：www.openui.com、/docs 与 github.com/thesysdev/openui 均为 HTTP 200。gh api：MIT、11051★，仓库创建于 2024-12-02，最近推送 2026-10-15；当日发布含 @openuidev/react-lang@1.0.1。npm 注册表 @openuidev/cli 为 0.6.0、MIT（HTTP 200）。官网 FAQ 写 npx @openuidev/cli@latest create 与 setup-agent，并写 Gateway 可修不合法输出、供应商故障时可切换；首页写任意模型、框架与组件库，以及比 JSON 界面快 3 倍、少 67% token。FAQ 另有 46 个界面的自测：平均 1362 个输出 token，比 json-render 少 58%、比 A2UI 少 52%。首页营销文案写 10890 stars、7M+ downloads；本次首屏徽章显示 11037 stars；gh api 为 11051★。三个数不一致，都记下，不取其中一个当实数。首页可见文案没有「OpenUI 1.0」这几个字。README 仍链 /playground，本次打开是 308 到 /openui-vs-json。/gateway 为 HTTP 404，Gateway 说明以首页 FAQ 为准。预览为 Playwright 实拍官网首屏，裁 3:2 WebP（1200×800）。
cases.verifyLogEn: 2026-10-16 morning: www.openui.com, /docs, and github.com/thesysdev/openui all HTTP 200. gh api: MIT, 11051★, repo created 2024-12-02, last push 2026-10-15; that day’s releases include @openuidev/react-lang@1.0.1. npm registry @openuidev/cli is 0.6.0, MIT (HTTP 200). The FAQ lists npx @openuidev/cli@latest create and setup-agent, and says Gateway repairs invalid output and can switch providers. The homepage says any model, framework, and component library, plus up to 3× faster and 67% fewer tokens than JSON UI. The FAQ also cites a 46-interface benchmark: 1,362 output tokens on average, 58% fewer than json-render and 52% fewer than A2UI. Marketing copy says 10,890 stars and 7M+ downloads; the homepage badge in this capture showed 11,037 stars; gh api returned 11,051. The three figures disagree, so all three are recorded and none is treated as the real count. Visible homepage copy does not say “OpenUI 1.0”. The README still links /playground; opening it returned 308 to /openui-vs-json. /gateway was HTTP 404, so Gateway wording follows the homepage FAQ. Preview is a Playwright capture of the homepage, cropped to a 3:2 WebP (1200×800).
cases.approvalBoundary: setup-agent 会改项目里的 AGENTS.md；把生成界面接到用户面前之前，自己看一眼输出。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: setup-agent edits AGENTS.md in the project; review the generated interface before users see it.

cases.title: Mowgli：给手机、网页和桌面用的 AI 设计画布，改完经 MCP 交给编程助手
cases.titleEn: Mowgli — AI design canvas for mobile, web, and desktop, with MCP handoff
cases.hook: 同一张画布出手机、网页和桌面稿，再交给助手。
cases.hookEn: Design mobile, web, and desktop on one canvas, then hand off to your agent.
cases.summary: Mowgli 是商业 AI 设计画布。官网写：可以按产品想法生成整套高保真界面（手机、网页或桌面，含各种状态），先用 16 种以上的情绪板定视觉方向，再做成能点的原型；也能把 Figma 文件导进来，用对话改布局、文案或整条流程。改完可以经 MCP 交给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或其他 MCP 客户端，两边保持同步，也可以导出 React + Tailwind，或推回 Figma。首页文案写可以免费开始，FAQ 写可以免费起步再升级。适合想在一张画布上把产品和界面想清楚、再交给编程助手的人。本库没有注册，没有生成设计，也没有接 MCP。
cases.summaryEn: Mowgli is a commercial AI design canvas. The site says it generates a full set of high-fidelity screens for mobile, web, or desktop, including states; you can start from a moodboard of 16+ directions, turn the result into a clickable prototype, or import a Figma file and edit layout, copy, or whole flows in chat. Finished work can go to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client and stay in sync both ways, or export as React + Tailwind or back to Figma. The homepage says you can start for free, and the FAQ says you can start free and upgrade later. Good when you want the product and the screens on one canvas before a coding agent builds them. This library did not sign up, generate a design, or connect MCP.
cases.qualityNote: 未注册实测，功能照官网。首页写可以免费开始；定价页各档没有抄进本条。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Not signed up or tried here; features follow the site. The homepage says you can start for free; pricing tiers are not copied into this entry.
cases.verifyLog: 2026-10-16 早间：mowgli.ai 与 /pricing 均为 HTTP 200。首页 meta 写 Free to start；页内 FAQ「Is there a free tier?」写 Yes. You can start for free and upgrade as your needs grow。功能（整套界面生成、16+ 情绪板、可点原型、Figma 导入、对话修改、MCP 双向同步、React + Tailwind 或 Figma 导出）照首页。定价页能打开，价目没有抄进摘要。页脚 © 2026，首页没有单独的发布日期。预览为 Playwright 实拍官网首屏，裁 3:2 WebP（1200×800）。
cases.verifyLogEn: 2026-10-16 morning: mowgli.ai and /pricing both HTTP 200. Homepage meta says Free to start; the on-page FAQ “Is there a free tier?” says yes, you can start for free and upgrade as your needs grow. Features (full-app generation, 16+ moodboards, clickable prototypes, Figma import, chat edits, two-way MCP sync, React + Tailwind or Figma export) follow the homepage. The pricing page loads; tiers are not copied into the summary. Footer © 2026; the homepage has no separate launch date. Preview is a Playwright capture of the homepage, cropped to a 3:2 WebP (1200×800).
cases.approvalBoundary: 经 MCP 交出去会改代码库里的界面；推回团队的 Figma 文件前自己看一层。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: MCP handoff can change UI in the codebase; review before pushing back into a shared Figma file.

cases.title: MagicOS：Magic Patterns 的无限 AI 设计画布，方向和交接放在同一张画布上
cases.titleEn: MagicOS — Magic Patterns’ infinite AI design canvas for directions and handoff
cases.hook: 无限画布上并行试几版，选中再交给编程助手。
cases.hookEn: Compare directions on one infinite canvas, then hand the winner to your agent.
cases.summary: Magic Patterns 在 2026-10-13 的官方博客推出 MagicOS：一张一直留着的无限画布，PRD、参考图、设计变体和否掉的方向放在一起，而不是埋进聊天气泡。博客写可以在同一段对话里并行推进多件设计，也可以用语音边说边改画布；已有的代码库、Claude Design 和 Figma 可以导入再导出。定稿后经 MCP 交给 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 或其他编程助手。原来的 Magic Patterns 设计稿变成这块画布上的一块。适合想同时比较几版界面、再把选中的一版交给编程助手的人。本库没有注册，没有在画布上生成。
cases.summaryEn: On 2026-10-13 Magic Patterns’ blog introduced MagicOS: a persistent infinite canvas where the PRD, inspiration, variants, and rejected directions stay visible instead of disappearing into a chat log. The post says one conversation can move several design tasks in parallel, and you can talk to the canvas by voice. Existing work can come in from a codebase, Claude Design, or Figma, and go back out again. The chosen direction hands off over MCP to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or another coding agent. Classic Magic Patterns designs become one block on that canvas. Good when you want to compare several UI directions and then give the winner to a coding agent. This library did not sign up or generate anything on the canvas.
cases.qualityNote: 未注册实测；按 2026-10-13 官方博客。本条写的是 MagicOS 画布，不是产品首页的总介绍。

Persistent canvas, PRD / inspiration / variants, parallel tasks, voice, import and export from a codebase / Claude Design / Figma, and MCP handoff to Claude Code / Cursor / Codex follow that post. cases.summary: Figma 在 2026-10-15 推出 Specs：放在 Figma 或 FigJam 画布上的多人 Markdown。可以把现成的 .md 拖进画布，也可以按 D 或点工具栏的 Specs 图标新建；帮助中心还写了独立 Spec 文件，文件浏览器里选 Spec，或打开 figma.com/spec/new。说明里能嵌画布上的画框、FigJam 或节点，文字和设计放在一起。接上 Figma MCP 的编程助手用 figma-spec 技能读写这些 Spec。博客写从当天起向付费方案开放测试；帮助中心写 Professional、Education、Organization、Enterprise，且需要对文件有编辑权，并写功能会在接下来几周陆续出现。用助手改 Spec 会计入 Figma 的 AI 额度，自己直接写字不计。这和库里的 figma-agent-ga 不是同一条：那条是 10 月 6 日设计助手正式版，这条是画布上的说明容器。适合想把设计说明写在稿子旁边、让编程助手按同一份 Spec 干活的人。本库没有付费工作区，没有打开 Spec，也没有接 MCP。
cases.summaryEn: On 2026-10-15 Figma launched Specs: multiplayer Markdown on the Figma or FigJam canvas. Drop a .md file onto the canvas, or press D / click the Specs icon; the help center also describes a standalone Spec file from the file browser or figma.com/spec/new. A spec can embed a frame, a FigJam file, or a canvas node, so the writing sits next to the design. Coding agents on the Figma MCP server read and write Specs with the figma-spec skill. The blog says open beta on paid plans starting that day; the help center lists Professional, Education, Organization, and Enterprise, requires edit access, and says the feature rolls out over the following weeks. Using the agent on a Spec spends Figma AI credits; typing in the spec yourself does not. This is not the in-library figma-agent-ga entry, which is the 6 October design-agent launch; this one is the on-canvas spec container. Good when the brief should live beside the frames and the coding agent should follow that same Spec. This library has no paid workspace, did not open a Spec, and did not connect MCP.

cases.title: Doop — 人和 AI Agent 一起用的开源设计画布（自带 MCP）
cases.titleEn: Doop — open-source multiplayer design canvas with built-in MCP for agents
cases.hook: Agent 在画布上直接画帧，你和它共用同一份设计记忆。
cases.hookEn: Agents sketch frames on a shared canvas with one design memory.
cases.summary: Doop 自称 Paper.design 的开源替代：无限画布上的帧是真实 HTML（沙箱 iframe），人在浏览器里改，Claude Code / Codex 等任意 MCP 客户端通过内置 MCP（云端 `https://doop.design/mcp`，自托管也有）连上后，可以边画边流式更新、自评截图、接评论当任务。画布带多人光标、批注、活动流和「设计记忆」（钉住范例帧、沉淀风格规则给后来的 Agent）。官网写 Free in beta；仓库 AGPL-3.0，可用 `bun run dev` 或 Docker 自托管，也可用 doop.design 托管版。助手用你已有的模型订阅连 MCP，不必再交一套 AI 密钥。适合想和编程助手在同一张设计画布上改界面、又不愿只靠「截图→粘贴→再说一遍」的人。
cases.summaryEn: Doop calls itself an open-source Paper.design alternative: frames on an infinite canvas render real HTML in sandboxed iframes; people edit in the browser while Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP client joins via the built-in MCP (cloud `https://doop.design/mcp`, also self-hosted) to stream frames, self-review screenshots, and turn comments into tasks. The canvas has live cursors, comments, an activity feed, and design memory (pinned exemplars and distilled style rules for later agents). The site says free in beta; the repo is AGPL-3.0 and runs with `bun run dev` or Docker, or on doop.design hosted. Agents keep your existing model subscription—no second AI key for Doop itself. Good when you want to co-design UI on one canvas instead of screenshot-and-paste loops.
cases.qualityNote: MCP 连接、自托管、设计记忆、Free in beta 均照官网与 README。本库没有注册 Doop、没有连 MCP、没有自托管实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: MCP connect, self-host, design memory, and free-in-beta follow the site and README. This library did not sign up, connect MCP, or self-host.
cases.approvalBoundary: Agent 会在画布上改帧与导出；合并进产品代码或对外发布前，自己过一遍视觉与文案。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Agents can edit frames and exports on the canvas; review visuals and copy yourself before shipping product code or public links.

cases.hookEn: Click what to change on the live page, then paste one batch to Claude Code or Cursor.
cases.summary: EditUI 是免费的 Chrome 扩展（MIT 开源）：打开正在跑的页面（含 localhost），开编辑模式后点元素、写下想改成什么样，可以连点多处，最后「Copy all」生成一份带 URL、视口、DOM 上下文和你的备注的提示词，粘贴进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 或任意能吃粘贴的助手。它不直接改代码、不接 MCP、不替你调模型，只负责把「你指的是哪一块」说清楚。官网写 Free、不用账号、不用先配仓库。适合做界面走查、又懒得口头描述「左上角那个按钮」的人。
cases.summaryEn: EditUI is a free Chrome extension (MIT): open a running page (localhost included), turn on edit mode, click elements and write the change you want, collect several notes, then Copy all builds one prompt with URL, viewport, DOM context, and your notes for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or any paste-friendly agent. It does not edit code, speak MCP, or call a model—it only makes “which element” unambiguous. The site says free, no account, no repo setup. Good for UI review when you are tired of describing “the button at the top left.”

cases.summary: Diffui 是前 Figma 工程师做的扩散式界面设计工具。官网写：用提示词一次生成多张界面方向（自称约 50 秒出 9 张），还能上传现有截图学品牌色、字体和组件，再往同风格扩页。做完可抽成设计 token，并转成不绑框架的 Web Components；也可把构建说明交给 Codex / Cursor 一类助手去实现。定价页写个人按张计费（约 17 美分一张图）、无需绑卡试用；设计转代码在 beta 期免费。Show HN（2026-07-21）约 80 分。适合想先快速比视觉方向、再交给编程助手落地的产品与设计同学。
cases.summaryEn: Diffui is a diffusion-based UI design tool from a former Figma engineer. The site says a prompt can return multiple UI directions at once (it claims about nine in ~50 seconds), and you can upload screenshots so new screens follow your brand colors, type, and components. Finished work can become design tokens and framework-free Web Components, or a build brief for agents like Codex / Cursor. Pricing is per image for individuals (about 17¢), no card required to try; design-to-code is free while in beta. The 2026-07-21 Show HN landed around 80 points. Good when you want to compare visual directions fast, then let a coding agent implement.

cases.approvalBoundary: 生成按张计费；往正式仓库或设计系统落地前自己先看一眼稿和导出代码。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Generations are billed per image; review mockups and exported code before landing them in a production repo or design system.

cases.title: Claude Motion 和 Claude Dashboards — 一句话做动画讲解短片，连上数据出实时看板
cases.titleEn: Claude Motion and Claude Dashboards — animated explainers from a prompt, live dashboards from your data
cases.hook: 一句话把报告做成动画短片，每个字和数字都能改。
cases.hookEn: Turn a report into a short animated explainer where every word and number stays editable.
cases.summary: Anthropic 2026-10-08 同时上线两个 beta 功能。Claude Motion：让 Claude 把季度报告做成 30 秒讲解动画、给演示里的图表加动效、或做一段客户上手演示，播放起来像短视频，可以在编辑器里调，也可以接着对话改，最后下载成 MP4。它不是视频生成模型，而是写代码去动你的文字、图表、形状和图片，所以没有生成画面、没有 AI 人物，任何一个字、数字、节奏都能改；做完还能拿去 Adobe、Descript、HeyGen、Luma AI、Runway 等工具继续做（Canva 和 Captions 写着即将支持）。Claude Dashboards：连上 BigQuery、Databricks、Snowflake、Redshift、ClickHouse 或 Salesforce，用大白话提问，Claude 出一张会自动刷新的看板，点任何数字能看到背后的查询，深入分析时可发到 Amplitude、Grafana、Hex、Mixpanel、PostHog 等。套餐：Motion 只在 Team 和 Enterprise，Dashboards 在付费档；同一篇公告说 Docs、Slides、Design 去掉 beta，所有套餐含免费档都能用。适合要做汇报动效、产品讲解、数据周报的设计和运营。
cases.summaryEn: Anthropic launched two beta features on 2026-10-08. Claude Motion: ask Claude to turn a quarterly report into a 30-second explainer, add motion to a chart in a deck, or make a customer onboarding walkthrough. It plays like a short video; tweak it in the editor or by chatting, then download an MP4. It is not a video generation model: Claude writes code that animates your text, charts, shapes, and images, so there is no generated footage or AI-generated people and any word, number, or timing can change. You can take it further in Adobe, Descript, HeyGen, Luma AI, Runway, and others (Canva and Captions listed as coming soon). Claude Dashboards: connect BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse, or Salesforce, ask in plain language, and get a dashboard that stays current; click any number to see its query, and send it on to Amplitude, Grafana, Hex, Mixpanel, PostHog, and more. Plans: Motion is Team and Enterprise only, Dashboards is on paid plans; the same post takes Docs, Slides, and Design out of beta on every plan including Free. Good for designers and ops people who make presentation motion, product explainers, or weekly data reports.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：AI×设计，动效讲解是设计和运营常做的活，这条把它变成对话加可编辑代码。本库没有 Team/Enterprise 账号，没有实际做动画、连数据源或导出 MP4。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Why it is listed: AI×design, since motion explainers are everyday work for designers and ops, now done by chatting with editable code. This library has no Team/Enterprise seat and did not make an animation, connect a data source, or export an MP4.
cases.approvalBoundary: Dashboards 要连公司数据源，先让管理员确认权限；看板和动画可以分享到组织外，发出去前看清分享范围。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Dashboards connect to company data, so have an admin confirm access first; dashboards and animations can be shared outside the org, so check sharing scope before sending.
cases.verifyLog: 主源是 Claude 官方文章 https://claude.com/resources/articles/dashboards-and-motion （日期 2026-10-08），晚间 HTTP 200；Motion 不用视频生成模型、导出 MP4、可接的外部工具名单，Dashboards 的数据源和可转发工具，以及套餐范围都照文章写。发布帖 @claudeai 2026-10-08T19:01Z（约 10-09 03:01 北京时间），晚间约 505 万次浏览、4.1 万赞；Runway 同日发帖说可把 Motion 的作品拿去 Runway 继续做。预览为 Playwright 实拍文章首屏缩成 3:2 WebP。
cases.verifyLogEn: Primary source is Claude's official article https://claude.com/resources/articles/dashboards-and-motion (dated 2026-10-08), HTTP 200 this evening; Motion not using a video model, MP4 export, the list of follow-on tools, Dashboards' data sources and send-to tools, and plan coverage all follow the article. cases.title: Claude Design — 用对话出设计稿，还能套上你自己的设计系统
cases.titleEn: Claude Design — prompt for designs that stay on your design system
cases.hook: 跟 Claude 说需求，它按你的组件配色先出一版。
cases.hookEn: Describe it; Claude drafts on your design system, then you refine.
cases.summary: Anthropic Labs 的 Claude Design：用对话做设计稿、可点原型、一页纸和演示相关视觉。产品页写你可以说需求，Claude 先出一版，再通过继续聊、批注、直接改画布或滑杆微调。能从 GitHub、设计文件或本机代码库导入设计系统，让输出用真实组件、颜色和字体，而不是一套通用模板。和 Claude Code 之间可用 /design-sync 把设计系统拉过去，或用 /design 在终端里建、改、同步设计项目；做完也能交给 Claude Code 接着写代码。导出写的有 PDF、PPTX、HTML，以及 Adobe、Canva、Gamma、Lovable、Miro、Replit、Vercel、Wix 等连接。2026-10-08 官方公告：Claude Design 连同 Docs、Slides 去掉 beta，所有套餐（含免费档）都能用。企业组织默认关闭，管理员可开。独立站 claude.ai/design 写明开到 2026-12-14，之后迁到对话里的 Artifacts。
cases.summaryEn: Claude Design from Anthropic Labs: make designs, clickable prototypes, one-pagers, and presentation visuals by chatting. The product page says you describe what you need, Claude builds a first version, then you refine through conversation, comments, direct canvas edits, or sliders. You can import a design system from GitHub, design files, or a local codebase so output uses your real components, colors, and type instead of a generic template. With Claude Code you can /design-sync to pull the system in, or /design from the terminal to create, edit, and sync design projects; when ready you can hand off to Claude Code to implement. Exports listed include PDF, PPTX, HTML, plus connectors to Adobe, Canva, Gamma, Lovable, Miro, Replit, Vercel, and Wix. Anthropic's 2026-10-08 post took Claude Design, Docs, and Slides out of beta on every plan, including Free. Enterprise orgs default off until an admin enables them. The standalone claude.ai/design site stays open until 2026-12-14, then work moves into Artifacts in any Claude chat.

cases.title: Flowstep — 给编程助手用的设计画布，出屏、改稿、再拷进 Figma

cases.summary: Flowstep 自称「给 agent 用的设计画布」。官网写：把颜色、字体、间距写进设计指南，之后每次生成和修改都跟这套走；也可以说「以后都用我们的蓝」，它会自己改规则。MCP 服务器地址是 https://api.flowstep.ai/mcp，文档写可接 Cursor、Claude Code、Windsurf、Codex：助手能生成屏幕、看渲染图、改稿，并和指南同步。画布上的帧可用 ⌘⇧C / ⌘V 拷进 Figma，也能从 Figma 导入成可编辑屏幕，不装插件。导出写的是 React、TypeScript、Tailwind。官网首页写 No credit card required；具体免费额度和付费档本库没在价格页核对。适合已经在用编程助手、又想先有可改视觉稿再写代码的人。
cases.summaryEn: Flowstep calls itself a design canvas for agents. The site says you write colors, typography, and spacing into design guidelines so every generation and edit follows them, and you can say “from now on, use our blue” for it to update the rules. Its MCP server is at https://api.flowstep.ai/mcp; docs say it connects to Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, and Codex so an agent can generate screens, view renders, edit them, and keep guidelines in sync. Frames paste into Figma with ⌘⇧C / ⌘V, and Figma frames import as editable screens with no plugin. Export is listed as React, TypeScript, and Tailwind. The homepage says no credit card required; free quotas and paid tiers were not checked on a pricing page. Good for people already using a coding agent who want editable UI mockups before code.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：AI×设计，把出屏能力直接塞进编程助手，和库里的 ProtoPie MCP、Figma 助手互补。本库没有注册 Flowstep，没有连 MCP，没有生成屏幕，也没有核对价格与额度。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Why it is listed: AI×design that puts screen generation inside a coding agent, complementary to ProtoPie MCP and the Figma agent already in the library. This library did not sign up for Flowstep, connect MCP, generate a screen, or check pricing and quotas.
cases.approvalBoundary: 连 MCP 要登录 Flowstep；生成会占额度。往正式 Figma 文件粘贴前自己先看一眼。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Connecting MCP needs a Flowstep login and generations use quota. Review before pasting into a production Figma file.
