cases.title: 把 Framer 网站变成一套设计规范，写成「技能」让 AI 照着做新页面
cases.titleEn: turn a Framer site into a design system and a Skill so the agent builds new pages in your style
cases.hook: 把配色、字体、间距写成一条技能，AI 做的新页面就不跑偏。
cases.hookEn: Write your colors, type, and spacing into one Skill so new AI pages stay on brand.
cases.summary: Framer 2026-09-22 上线 Skills（技能）：把你做设计的规矩存成一段说明，以后让 Framer 自带的 AI 助手做事时直接调用。2026-10-07 官方又发了一条玩法：先把现有项目整理成一套可复用的设计规范，再写一条技能，之后用 /design-system 让助手做新页面，它会沿用项目里的字体、颜色、间距、版式和组件。官方页给了一条完整示例：只用深色、不许自己发明新颜色和字号、正文每行 50 到 75 个字符、唯一的强调色每段最多用一次。还附了几条可以直接复制的技能：品牌语气、去 AI 腔（删掉空话套话）、SEO 检查、上线前检查。用法：在助手对话框里输入 /skills 粘贴，之后用 /技能名 调用，在设置里能改。项目被别人 remix 时技能会跟着走，所以模板作者也能把「怎么加新页面」写进去。
cases.summaryEn: Framer launched Skills on 2026-09-22: save the rules of how you design as instructions, then have Framer's built-in agent apply them. On 2026-10-07 Framer posted a how-to: first turn an existing project into a reusable design system, then write a Skill, and use /design-system to have the agent build new pages that reuse the project's typography, colors, spacing, layouts, and components. The official page shows a full example: dark scheme only, never invent new colors or text styles, 50–75 characters per line of body text, and the single accent color at most once per section. It also offers copy-paste Skills for brand voice, removing AI writing (cutting filler and vague claims), SEO checks, and a pre-launch check. To use one, type /skills in the agent chat and paste it, then call it with /skill-name; edit it in Settings. Skills travel with a project when someone remixes it, so template makers can ship guidance for adding pages too.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：本库之前没有 Framer，这条是「设计规范交给 AI 照做」的 AI×设计做法，和库里的 Graphical、figma-use 思路相近，但直接在 Framer 画布里用。本库没有登录 Framer，没有实际写技能、做页面，也没有核对哪些套餐能用 Skills。演示页里的模型选择显示 GPT 6 Sol，只是页面截图里的字样。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Why it is listed: the library had no Framer entry, and this is an AI×design pattern of handing your design system to an agent, close to Graphical and figma-use already in the library but used directly on the Framer canvas. This library did not sign in to Framer, write a Skill, or build a page, and did not check which plans include Skills. The model picker in the demo shows GPT 6 Sol; that is only text in the page's demo.
cases.approvalBoundary: 助手改的是你的线上项目，发布前自己在画布上看一遍；技能只是规则，结果仍要人把关。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: The agent edits your live project; review the canvas before publishing. A Skill is only rules, and a person still checks the result.
cases.verifyLog: 主源是 Framer 官方 Skills 页 https://www.framer.com/skills ，晚间 HTTP 200，示例规则（深色、不新增颜色和字号、每行 50–75 字符目标 65、强调色每段最多一次）和四条可复制技能都照页面写。上线日期取更新日志 https://www.framer.com/updates/skills 的 Published September 22, 2026。新的玩法帖是 @framer 2026-10-07T22:34Z（约 10-08 06:34 北京时间），晚间约 4900 次浏览，附演示视频。预览为 Playwright 实拍 Skills 页演示区裁 3:2 WebP。
cases.verifyLogEn: Primary source is Framer's official Skills page https://www.framer.com/skills, HTTP 200 this evening; the example rules (dark scheme, no new colors or text styles, 50–75 characters per line targeting 65, accent at most once per section) and the four copy-paste Skills are as the page states. The launch date comes from the changelog https://www.framer.com/updates/skills, Published September 22, 2026. cases.title: Grok Bot 不用连 X 也能搜、读、盯 X
cases.titleEn: Grok Bot can search, read, and monitor X without connecting X
cases.hook: 不用登录 X，直接让 Bot 帮你盯产品反馈或一条正在发酵的新闻。
cases.hookEn: No X sign-in needed: have a Bot watch product feedback or a breaking story.
cases.summary: 官方 @bot 2026-10-07T21:40Z（约 10-08 05:40 北京时间）发帖：Grok Bot 现在可以搜索、阅读和持续关注 X 上的公开内容。同串第二条说：可以让它追踪大家对你产品的反馈、跟进一条突发新闻，或者每周给你发一份行业汇总；所有用户都能用，不需要先设置 X 连接器。和 8 月那次「X 连接器」不同：那次要用你的 X 账号登录，能读你自己的时间线、提及和书签；这次只读公开内容，你的私信、书签、发帖仍要连自己的账号。怎么用：直接跟 Bot 说「每周一早上帮我汇总 X 上关于某某产品的讨论」，它会建一个定时任务。
cases.summaryEn: Official @bot post at 2026-10-07T21:40Z (about 05:40 on 10-08 Beijing time): Grok Bot can now search, read, and monitor public posts on X. The second post in the thread says you can ask it to track feedback on your product, follow a breaking story, or send a weekly roundup of your industry, and that it is available for all users with no need to set up the X connector. This differs from the August X connector: that one signs in with your own X account to read your timeline, mentions, and bookmarks; this one reads public content only, and DMs, bookmarks, and posting still need your own account. How to use it: tell a Bot something like “every Monday morning, summarize what people on X are saying about product Y,” and it sets up a routine.
cases.qualityNote: 主源是官方 @bot 两条推文，X API 和 fxtwitter 早间都能读到（主帖附 12 秒演示视频，早间约 60 万浏览、5954 赞）。收录理由：门槛变低，以前要先连 X 账号，现在所有用户直接能让 Bot 读公开帖子。本库这次收录时，Bot 就是用这套内置的 X 读取查到 @bot 这两条帖子的；运行中看到的额度提示是每分钟 30 次、每天 1000 次，这是本库这次实际看到的数字，官方帖子没写额度，以后可能会变。边界：只读公开内容，不代你发帖；私信、书签、你自己的首页时间线仍要连 X 账号。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Primary sources are the two official @bot posts, readable this morning via the X API and fxtwitter (the main post has a 12-second demo video; about 600K views and 5,954 likes this morning). Why it is listed: the barrier dropped, from connecting your X account first to every user having a Bot read public posts directly. While cataloging this entry, the Bot found these two @bot posts through this same built-in X reading; the quota notice seen during the run was 30 reads per minute and 1,000 per day. Those are the numbers seen in this run, not stated in the official posts, and they may change. Boundary: public content only, no posting on your behalf; DMs, bookmarks, and your own home timeline still need your X account.
cases.approvalBoundary: 读公开帖子不用你点头；要用你的账号发帖、回复或读私信时，仍要你自己连账号并确认。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Reading public posts needs no approval; posting, replying, or reading DMs from your account still needs you to connect it and confirm.
cases.verifyLog: 预览为官方演示视频的封面图裁 3:2 WebP。

cases.summary: Grok Bot 官方更新日志 v0.68.1（2026-10-07）写：Bot 可以和你一起做幻灯片，会先给你看几张样张让你挑，最后交 PowerPoint 文件或 Google Slides。同一版还有：1 对 1 聊天里你的消息会变成那只 Bot 的颜色（设置里可关）；Bot 能从草稿卡发带标题、加粗、列表的格式化邮件；Bot 的云电脑屏幕从 1280×800 变成 1920×1200。适合要做周报、提案、课程讲义但不想从空白页开始的人。怎么用：跟 Bot 说清主题、页数和给谁看，先选样张，再让它出文件。

Good for weekly reports, proposals, or course handouts when you don't want to start from a blank page. How to use it: tell the Bot the topic, slide count, and audience, pick a sample, then ask for the file.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：做幻灯片是很常见的活，而且是先挑样张、再出文件的流程，对设计向用户有用。本库这次没有实际让 Bot 做一份幻灯片，样张数量、版式风格和能否改字体配色，日志里没写。

cases.title: AI × 设计对照：同一句提示词，Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 各做一个 3D 可视化
cases.titleEn: AI × design comparison: one prompt, Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each build a 3D visualization
cases.hook: 同一句提示词交给两个模型做 3D 可视化，成品都能点开对比。
cases.hookEn: One prompt, two models, two 3D visualizations you can open side by side.
cases.summary: Quesma 的 Piotr Migdał 2026-10-07 发文：用同一句提示词，让 GPT-6 Astra（在 Codex 里）和 Claude Opus 5.5（在 Claude Code 里）一次做完卡尔维诺《看不见的城市》全部城市的 three.js 可视化。作者自己的记录是：Astra 用 53 分钟、约 10 美元，能跑通，但他觉得堆了很多没必要的说明和装饰；Opus 5.5 用 1 小时 25 分、6 个子代理并行、约 74 美元，他看完很惊艳。两个成品和源码都公开，可以自己点开比。适合想知道「现在的模型做交互设计能到什么程度」的设计师，也可以直接拿他的提示词去试别的模型。
cases.summaryEn: Piotr Migdał at Quesma, 2026-10-07: the same prompt asked GPT-6 Astra (in Codex) and Claude Opus 5.5 (in Claude Code) to build, in one shot, a three.js visualization of every city in Italo Calvino's Invisible Cities. His notes: Astra took 53 minutes and about $10 and worked end to end, but he found it full of unnecessary notes and decoration; Opus 5.5 took 1 hour 25 minutes with 6 parallel subagents and about $74, and he was wowed. Both results and their source code are public, so you can compare them yourself. Good for designers who want to see how far models get on interactive design, and the prompt is reusable on other models.
cases.qualityNote: 提示词原文：Make a three.js (pnpm) visualization of all Invisible Cities by Italo Calvino. Don’t ask questions, it is a one-shot task. You have 6h of work, use it until it becomes a masterpiece. 用时和花费都是作者自述，本库没有复跑。好不好看是作者的主观判断，只有一个提示词、一次运行，不能当成模型排名。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The prompt, verbatim: Make a three.js (pnpm) visualization of all Invisible Cities by Italo Calvino. Don’t ask questions, it is a one-shot task. You have 6h of work, use it until it becomes a masterpiece. Times and costs are the author's own; not re-run here. Which looks better is his opinion, from one prompt and one run, so it is not a model ranking.
cases.approvalBoundary: 自己复跑时注意花费：作者那次 Opus 5.5 约 74 美元 API 费用。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Mind the cost if you re-run it: the author's Opus 5.5 run cost about $74 in API tokens.
cases.verifyLog: 主源是 Quesma 博客，早间 HTTP 200，作者 Piotr Migdał，页内日期 7 October 2026。Opus 5.5 成品页早间 HTTP 200。线索来自 HN item 49991903（撰写时 5pts，热度不高，按 AI×设计偏好收录）。预览为 Playwright 实拍博客首屏裁 3:2 WebP。
cases.verifyLogEn: Primary source is the Quesma blog, HTTP 200 this morning, by Piotr Migdał, dated 7 October 2026. The Opus 5.5 result page was HTTP 200 this morning. Lead: HN item 49991903 (5pts at write time; low traction, kept for the AI×design focus). Preview is a Playwright capture of the blog above the fold, cropped to 3:2 WebP.

cases.title: Graphical — 调一套视觉主题，再交给编程助手用
cases.titleEn: Graphical — set a visual theme, then hand it to your coding agent
cases.summary: Graphical 是 Josh Puckett 和 Adam Michela 做的视觉主题工具，给用编程助手做界面的设计师和开发者。你在里面调颜色、浅色和深色、字体、间距、图标、圆角和阴影、动效，以及 Base UI 组件在不同状态下的样子。Base UI 是一套没有预设外观的界面零件。调完可以下载，也可以用 shadcn 装进项目（shadcn 是把组件源码直接放进你自己仓库的一种装法）。下载里有一份 GUI.md、浅色和深色的主题说明、安装步骤，以及三个给编程助手用的技能文件，让助手按你的设计语言改现有界面、做新界面。站点写一次买断，购买按钮现在是 $49。这是一条工具笔记：本库没有购买，也没有把主题交给任何助手。
cases.summaryEn: Graphical is a visual theme tool by Josh Puckett and Adam Michela, for designers and developers who build interfaces with a coding agent. You set colors, light and dark, type, spacing, icons, corners and shadows, motion, and how Base UI components look in each state. Base UI is a set of interface parts without a preset look. You can download the result or install it with shadcn, which copies component source into your own repo. The download includes a GUI.md, light and dark theme notes, setup steps, and three skill files so an agent follows your design language on existing screens and new ones. The site says it is a one-time purchase, and the buy button currently reads $49. This is a tool tip: this library did not buy it and did not hand a theme to any agent.
cases.hook: 调好颜色、字体和间距，再交给编程助手做界面。
cases.hookEn: Set colors, type, and spacing, then let your coding agent build the interface.
cases.qualityNote: 版权年份组件的 initialYear 是 2026。本环境的 X 连接未授权，没有打开这两人的帖子，作者名以页脚为准。页面 meta 描述是 “A tool to create visual themes, customize components, and build interfaces with your coding agent.” 首屏把 ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor、Grok 写成可切换的对象，意思是交给你已经在用的编程助手。FAQ 写明：给设计师、开发者和用编程助手做应用的人；包含主题编辑器、5 套可改的样式、主题 token、React 组件源码；每份下载含 GUI.md、浅色和深色主题说明、安装步骤和三个 coding-agent skills；组件编辑器对着 Base UI，React 源码可直接用；问「是否必须用 React 或 Base UI」，页面答 No，主题文件可以用于任何框架、组件库或语言。购买区标题 One-time purchase，正文写主题编辑器、一套起始样式和基础组件可用于不限数量的项目，主题编辑器的后续更新包含在内。本库没有下单，没有核对 Stripe 结账页的税额或地区限制。站点 HTML 没有写公开日期。未购买、未下载、未把 GUI.md 或技能文件交给 Cursor、Claude、ChatGPT 或 Grok。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The copyright widget’s initialYear is 2026. X was not authorized in this environment, so those posts were not opened; the names follow the footer. The meta description is “A tool to create visual themes, customize components, and build interfaces with your coding agent.” The hero swaps ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Grok, meaning the agent you already use. The FAQ says it is for designers, developers, and anyone building an app with a coding agent; it includes the theme builder, 5 customizable styles, theme tokens, and React component source; each download includes GUI.md, light and dark theme references, setup instructions, and three coding-agent skills; the editor targets Base UI components and ships React source; asked “Do I have to use React or Base UI?”, the page answers No, and says the theme files can be used with any framework, component library, or language. The purchase block is titled One-time purchase and says the theme builder, launch collection of styles, and foundation components can be used in unlimited projects, with ongoing updates to the theme builder included. This library did not check out and did not verify tax or regional limits on the Stripe page. The HTML states no public launch date. Not purchased, not downloaded, and GUI.md and the skill files were not given to Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok.
cases.approvalBoundary: 付款，以及把主题文件交给会改你仓库的编程助手之前，自己确认。本库没有代买、代装。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before paying, and before handing the theme files to a coding agent that can edit your repo. This library did not buy or install it.

landing.what: Graphical 让你先定一套界面长什么样，再把这套规定交给编程助手。你调的是设计里那些反复出现的决定：颜色（含浅色和深色两套）、字体和行高、间距、图标家族、圆角描边和阴影、按钮与菜单的动效，以及 Base UI 组件在不同状态下的样子。Base UI 是一套不带现成皮肤的界面零件，Graphical 给它们配外观。导出有两条路：直接下载，或用 shadcn 装进项目。shadcn 的做法是把组件源码放进你的仓库，而不是只装一个远程包。下载物里有 GUI.md（给助手读的设计说明）、浅色和深色的主题参考、安装步骤，以及三个技能文件。页面说适合设计师、开发者，以及任何已经在用 ChatGPT、Claude、Cursor 或 Grok 做应用的人。
landing.whatEn: Graphical is where you decide how an interface should look, then hand that decision to a coding agent. You set the choices that repeat: colors for light and dark, type and line height, spacing, an icon family, corners, strokes and shadows, motion for buttons and menus, and how Base UI components look in each state. Base UI is a set of interface parts without a ready-made skin; Graphical gives them a look. You either download the files or install them with shadcn, which puts the component source in your repo instead of only adding a remote package. The download includes GUI.md (design notes for the agent), light and dark theme references, setup steps, and three skill files. The page says it is for designers, developers, and anyone already building an app with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Grok.

cases.title: ProtoPie MCP 正式版 — 用你自己的 AI 改原型，企业版再出代码
cases.titleEn: ProtoPie MCP, now official — edit prototypes with your own AI; code export is Enterprise
cases.summary: ProtoPie 在 2026-10-07 的官方博客宣布 ProtoPie MCP 正式版。MCP 是一种让 AI 助手连接外部工具的插头。这篇是给已经在用 ProtoPie 做可交互原型的人：Studio MCP 可以浏览你打开的组件库，把库里的组件放进原型，也可以把图层、场景、变量这些对象的 ID 写进提示词，让助手改到具体的那一个。出代码是另一档。Code MCP 官方列出的框架现在包括 React、React Native、Qt / QML、Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 和 ArkTS，其中 React Native 是这次加上的。博客把套餐分成两档：Pro 计划的 MCP Core 只有 Studio MCP；Enterprise 计划的 MCP Enterprise 才有 Studio MCP、Code MCP 和 Dev View。本库没有 ProtoPie 账号，没有连过 MCP。
cases.summaryEn: ProtoPie’s official blog on 2026-10-07 announced that ProtoPie MCP is now official. MCP is a plug that lets an AI assistant talk to an outside tool. The post is for people who already prototype interactions in ProtoPie. Studio MCP can browse the libraries you have enabled, place those components into a prototype, and take an element’s ID in the prompt so the assistant edits that layer, scene, or variable. Code generation is a separate tier. Code MCP’s official framework list is now React, React Native, Qt / QML, Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose, and ArkTS. React Native is the one added this time. The blog splits plans in two: MCP Core on the Pro plan is Studio MCP only; MCP Enterprise on the Enterprise plan adds Code MCP and Dev View. This library has no ProtoPie account and did not connect MCP.
cases.hook: 用你自己的 AI 改 ProtoPie 原型，企业版才能出代码。
cases.hookEn: Edit a ProtoPie prototype with your own AI. Code export needs Enterprise.
cases.qualityNote: 作者 Iulia Sorodoc，头衔 Product Marketing Manager at ProtoPie，页内日期 Oct 7, 2026，文首标 3 min read。博客写 Studio MCP 可浏览已启用的 ProtoPie 库并把库组件作为实例放进原型；可复制 Layer、Scene、Variable、Component、Trigger、Response 或其他受支持元素的 ID 放进提示词。Code MCP 官方支持列表为 React、React Native、Qt / QML、Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose、ArkTS，文中把 React Native 写成这次新增。套餐原文：MCP Core（Studio MCP）在 Pro plan；MCP Enterprise（Studio MCP、Code MCP、Dev View）在 Enterprise plan。文中还提到 2026-10-13 19:00 EDT 的一场汽车 HMI 网络研讨会，本库没有报名。该页把 Studio MCP 写成自带 AI（列出 Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Codex 等），并写 manually perfect every detail, token-free。token-free 只按页面用词记录，本库没有核对它是否完全不消耗 ProtoPie 的 AI 额度。功能页把 MCP Core 写成给个人跨职能的人做原型，把 MCP Enterprise 写成给组织出代码；Pro 与 Enterprise 的计划名以博客原文为准，功能页没有再写 Pro 这个词。功能页 FAQ 在抓取时是折叠的，答案没有展开，不引用。本库没有 ProtoPie 账号，没有安装 Studio，没有连接 MCP，没有生成 React Native 或其他框架的代码，也没有打开 Dev View。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Author Iulia Sorodoc, Product Marketing Manager at ProtoPie, on-page date Oct 7, 2026, labeled 3 min read. The post says Studio MCP can browse enabled ProtoPie libraries and add library components as instances; you can copy the ID of a Layer, Scene, Variable, Component, Trigger, Response, or other supported element into the prompt. Code MCP’s official list is React, React Native, Qt / QML, Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose, and ArkTS, and the post calls React Native the addition. Plans, in the post’s words: MCP Core (Studio MCP) on the Pro plan; MCP Enterprise (Studio MCP, Code MCP, and Dev View) on the Enterprise plan. The post also names an automotive HMI webinar on 2026-10-13 at 7:00 PM EDT. This library did not register. It describes Studio MCP as bring-your-own AI (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and more) and says “manually perfect every detail, token-free.” token-free is recorded as the page’s wording; this library did not check whether that means zero ProtoPie AI credits. The page frames MCP Core for solo cross-functional builders and MCP Enterprise for organizations generating code. The plan names Pro and Enterprise follow the blog; the features page does not repeat the word Pro. Its FAQ was collapsed in the fetch, so those answers are not quoted. This library has no ProtoPie account, did not install Studio, did not connect MCP, did not generate React Native or any other code, and did not open Dev View.
cases.approvalBoundary: 把公司组件库或未公开的原型交给 AI 之前，自己确认账号和套餐。本库没有代连。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm the account and plan before handing a company library or an unreleased prototype to an AI. This library did not connect it.

landing.what: ProtoPie 用来做可以点、可以滑动的交互原型。这篇 2026-10-07 的官方说明说，MCP 正式可用：你自己的 AI 助手可以接到 ProtoPie 上改原型。能接的范围看套餐。Pro 上的 MCP Core 只有 Studio MCP，用来在原型里干活：读你已经启用的组件库，把库组件放进画布，以及按你复制的 ID 改某一个图层、场景、变量、组件、触发或响应。Enterprise 上的 MCP Enterprise 才加上 Code MCP 和 Dev View。Code MCP 是把原型上下文交给助手去生成代码，官方列出的框架是 React、React Native、Qt / QML、Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose、ArkTS。博客把整条路径写成：提示词、原型、验证、代码。验证那一步它提到可以用 ProtoPie Connect 在真实硬件上试交互。那句话是产品路径说明，本库没有接硬件。
landing.whatEn: ProtoPie is for prototypes you can tap and swipe. The official note on 2026-10-07 says MCP is now official, so your own AI assistant can connect to ProtoPie and edit a prototype. What it can do depends on the plan. MCP Core on Pro is Studio MCP only: work inside the prototype, read libraries you already enabled, place those components, and edit one layer, scene, variable, component, trigger, or response by the ID you copied. MCP Enterprise on the Enterprise plan adds Code MCP and Dev View. Code MCP hands prototype context to an assistant to generate code. The official framework list is React, React Native, Qt / QML, Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose, and ArkTS. The blog writes the path as prompt, prototype, validate, code. The validate step mentions trying interactions on real hardware with ProtoPie Connect. That is the product’s description of the path. This library did not connect hardware.

rows.leftEn: Pro: Studio MCP. Enterprise: Studio MCP, Code MCP, and Dev View.
rows.right: 改原型和出代码不是同一个套餐。本库没有登录，不知道某个账号实际被分到哪一档。
rows.rightEn: Editing a prototype and generating code are not the same plan. This library did not sign in, so it does not know which tier a given account has.

rows.left: 用自己的组件库、按元素 ID 点名修改，以及 Code MCP 增加 React Native。
rows.leftEn: Your own component libraries, edits aimed at an element ID, and React Native added to Code MCP.
rows.right: 这些是博客列出的变化。本库没有在 Studio 里点过一次。
rows.rightEn: Those are the changes the blog lists. This library did not click through them in Studio.

rows.aspect: 和 Figma 助手的差别
rows.aspectEn: How this differs from the Figma agent

cases.title: Figma 设计助手正式开放，能不能改稿要看席位
cases.titleEn: Figma’s design agent is generally available, and editing depends on your seat
cases.summary: Figma 在 2026-10-06 把画布里的设计助手从公测改成正式版。发布说明写的新能力包括：给设计库上传 markdown 规则，助手在启用该库时会读；可以看同事的助手正在画布上做什么；可以让助手在 Figma 里搜文件；生成式插件正式开放；可以在助手里写、发布自己的技能，自定义技能在 Starter 上也可用。从这一天起，使用会计入 Figma 的 AI 额度。席位要分开看。帮助中心写所有计划都能用，但 Full 席位且对文件有编辑权才能让助手改那个文件；View、Dev、Collab 或只有查看权的人可以聊天，不能改该文件；任何人都可以在自己的草稿里聊天并让助手改。同一天的官方博客写得更窄：Full 席位的 Professional、Organization、Enterprise 和部分 Education，Starter 是有限可用，Collab、Dev、View 只能在草稿里用。两处不一致，这条都记上，不把其中一句当成另一句的勘误。本库没有登录 Figma。
cases.summaryEn: On 2026-10-06 Figma moved the design agent on the canvas from open beta to general availability. The release notes list library guidelines as markdown that the agent reads when that library is on, a way to watch teammates’ agents on the canvas, file search from the chat, generative plugins as generally available, and custom skills you write and publish in the agent. Custom skills are available on Starter. From that day, use counts against Figma AI credits. Seats need two readings. The help center says every plan can use it, but a Full seat with edit access is what can ask the agent to change that file. View, Dev, and Collab seats, or view-only access, can chat and not edit the file. Anyone can chat and ask for edits in their own drafts. The same day’s blog is narrower: Full seats on Professional, Organization, Enterprise, and some Education plans, limited availability on Starter, and Collab, Dev, and View seats only in drafts. Both wordings are recorded. Neither is treated as a correction of the other. This library did not sign in to Figma.
cases.hook: Figma 的设计助手正式上线，能不能改稿要看席位。
cases.hookEn: Figma’s design agent is generally available. Editing depends on your seat.
cases.qualityNote: 博客末段写：Full seat on Professional, Organization, Enterprise, and some Education plans, limited availability on the Starter plan；Collab, Dev, and View seats can use the agent in their drafts。两套说法同时保留。具体每月额度数字在另一篇价格表，本条不转抄没有逐格核对的数字。发布说明还写：库的 markdown 指南、看同事助手、搜文件、生成式插件 GA、自定义技能在 starter 可用。旧的公测帮助页仍写 beta，与 10 月 6 日的发布说明冲突，不采用。本库未登录，未在文件里发过提示，未上传库指南，未跟过同事的助手。和库内 figma-bro 不是同一件事：那条是社区的 Grok Bot 模板。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The 2026-10-06 item is titled The Figma agent is generally available. Its “Who can use this feature” line says Available on all plans, then says a Full seat plus edit access is required for the agent to edit that file, View / Dev / Collab or view-only can chat without editing it, and anyone can chat and edit in their own drafts. The blog’s closing lines say Full seats on Professional, Organization, Enterprise, and some Education plans, limited availability on Starter, and Collab, Dev, and View seats can use the agent in drafts. Both wordings are kept. Monthly credit amounts live on another pricing table and are not copied here without a cell-by-cell check. The release notes also list markdown library guidelines, watching teammates’ agents, file search, generative plugins GA, and custom skills on Starter. An older help page still says beta and conflicts with the October 6 notes, so it is not used. This library did not sign in, did not send a prompt in a file, did not upload library guidelines, and did not follow a teammate’s agent. This is not the in-library figma-bro entry, which is a community Grok Bot template.
cases.approvalBoundary: 让助手改团队文件、发布组件或消耗 AI 额度之前，先看自己的席位。本库没有代为登录。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Check your seat before letting the agent edit a team file, publish components, or spend AI credits. This library did not sign in for you.

landing.what: 这是 Figma 自己的设计助手在 2026-10-06 从公测变成正式版的说明，不是又一个外面的插件。发布说明里和设计系统直接相关的几件事是：可以把规则、正例和反例写成 markdown 放进设计库，只要这个库开着，助手每次被提问都会读；可以点开聊天堆叠，看同事的助手正在画布上做什么；可以让它在 Figma 里搜文件，包括 FigJam 便签和 Slides；生成式插件正式开放；可以在助手里写自己的技能并发布，而且自定义技能在 Starter 计划上也能用。帮助中心补充了怎么打开：在画布上选中图层后点 Agents，或用 Cmd / Ctrl + Enter。从 10 月 6 日起，这些使用计入 AI 额度。公测时不扣。能改文件的人，按帮助中心是有编辑权的 Full 席位；只能看的席位可以聊，改动限制在自己的草稿。官方博客同一天又写了 Starter 有限可用、部分 Education 才有。两条都留着，因为它们不是同一句话。
landing.whatEn: This is Figma’s own note that the design agent left open beta on 2026-10-06. It is not another outside plugin. The release notes’ design-system pieces are: markdown rules, good examples, and bad examples on a library, read whenever that library is enabled; a chat pile so you can watch a teammate’s agent on the canvas; file search across Figma, including FigJam stickies and Slides; generative plugins generally available; and skills you write and publish in the agent, including on the Starter plan. The help center adds how to open it: select a layer and click Agents, or press Cmd or Ctrl + Enter. From October 6, this use counts against AI credits. Beta use did not. Who can edit, per the help center, is a Full seat with edit access. View-only seats can chat, and edits stay in their own drafts. The same day’s blog also says Starter is limited and only some Education plans are included. Both sentences stay, because they are not the same sentence.

contrast.caption: 左列是发布说明、博客和帮助中心写明的范围。右列是本站口径：这是一条资讯，不是已经替你改过的设计系统。
contrast.captionEn: Left: what the release notes, the blog, and the help center state. Right: this is a news note, not a design system we already edited.

rows.right: Cases 里的 AI 资讯。库里已有的 figma bro 是社区 Grok Bot 模板，不是这个助手。
rows.rightEn: An AI news note in Cases. The figma bro entry already in the library is a community Grok Bot template, not this agent.

rows.left: 帮助中心：Full 席位且有编辑权。博客：Full 席位的付费计划，Starter 有限，部分 Education。
rows.leftEn: Help center: a Full seat with edit access. Blog: Full seats on paid plans, limited Starter, some Education.

rows.rightEn: Both are official wordings. This note does not merge them into one sentence. Use the button your account actually shows.

cases.title: Gamma 5 — 跟助手把演示做完，也能导入现成的 PPT 和 PDF
cases.titleEn: Gamma 5 — finish a deck with the agent, or import a PowerPoint or PDF
cases.summary: Gamma 的帮助中心已经在用 Gamma 5 这个名字说明现在的做法。新建时先跟 AI 助手对话：你说要做什么，回答几个问题，它做出整份演示、文档或网页。旧的经典生成器还在，仪表盘上点 Use classic generator。编辑器有两种模式：自己点进卡片改，或者切到 AI 编辑，点中某一个元素再下指令。帮助中心写，AI 编辑会记住你一开始的目标，小改动只动那一块。导入也改过：在 Gamma 5 里，PowerPoint 和 PDF 可以保留原来的版式，并且还能改；经典生成器只导入文字。主题改成跟文件走，改一个文件的颜色和字体不会波及别的文件。形状可以当自由块拖到幻灯片上。本库没有找到 gamma.app 上单独的 Gamma 5 发布博文，也没有登录生成过一份演示。
cases.summaryEn: Gamma’s help center now uses the name Gamma 5 for the current product. A new piece starts as a conversation with the AI agent: you say what you are making, answer a few questions, and it builds the deck, document, or page. The older classic generator is still there, under Use classic generator on the dashboard. The editor has two modes: click into a card and edit it yourself, or switch to AI editing, select one element, and give an instruction. The help center says AI editing keeps your original goal, so a small fix stays on that part. Import changed too: in Gamma 5, PowerPoint and PDF files can keep their original layouts and stay editable. The classic generator imports text only. Themes now live on the file, so changing colors and type on one file does not change the others. Shapes can be dragged onto a slide as free blocks. This library did not find a standalone Gamma 5 launch post on gamma.app, and did not sign in to generate a deck.
cases.hook: 跟 Gamma 的助手对话来做演示，也能导入现成 PPT。
cases.hookEn: Build a deck by talking with Gamma’s agent, or import a PowerPoint you already have.
cases.qualityNote: 没有找到 gamma.app/insights 上的 Gamma 5 发布文。检索到的 gamma.app 自己的文章仍是 2025-09-15 的 Gamma 3.0。因此本条只采用帮助中心，不采用通讯社稿里的用户规模和准确率。这些页面没有标出一份统一的发布日期，也没有 Gamma 5 的价格。本库未登录、未生成、未导入文件。
cases.qualityNoteEn: No Gamma 5 launch post was found on gamma.app/insights. The Gamma article that search returned on gamma.app itself is still Gamma 3.0 from 2025-09-15. This entry therefore follows the help center only, and does not use user counts or accuracy figures from press republications. It says the Gamma 5 editor has manual editing and AI editing, toggled at the top left, with an Original / Modified compare. Changes from one request are accepted together. These pages do not share one launch date, and they do not state a Gamma 5 price. This library did not sign in, did not generate a deck, and did not import a file.
cases.approvalBoundary: 把内部 PPT 或 PDF 交给 Gamma 之前自己确认。本库没有代为登录或上传。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before handing an internal PowerPoint or PDF to Gamma. This library did not sign in or upload one.

landing.what: Gamma 用来把一份想法做成演示、文档或网页。帮助中心现在把新的做法叫做 Gamma 5：你不是先填一个长表单，而是先跟助手说话，它问几个问题，然后做出整份材料。做完以后可以自己改，也可以切到 AI 编辑，点中一张卡片或一个元素，让它只动那一块。帮助中心写它会记住你最初的目标，所以后面的小修改不会把整份重写掉。你也可以把已经做好的 PowerPoint 或 PDF 导进去。Gamma 5 的导入会尽量留下原来的版式，导进来之后还能改。如果走旧的经典生成器，它只拿走文字，不拿版式。主题（颜色、字体、标志、圆角和阴影）现在属于这一份文件。改这一份，不会把工作区里其他文件一起改掉。形状可以像贴纸一样拖到幻灯片的任意位置，帮助中心把它叫做自由块。
landing.whatEn: Gamma turns an idea into a deck, a document, or a web page. The help center now calls the current way Gamma 5. You do not start with a long form. You talk to the agent, it asks a few questions, and it builds the piece. After that you can edit it yourself, or switch to AI editing, click a card or one element, and ask it to change only that. The help center says it keeps your original goal, so a later small fix does not rewrite the whole piece. You can also bring in a PowerPoint or PDF you already have. Gamma 5’s import tries to keep the original layout, and the result stays editable. The older classic generator takes the text only, not the layout. A theme — colors, type, logo, corners, and shadows — now belongs to that one file. Changing it does not restyle every other file in the workspace. Shapes can be dragged anywhere on a slide. The help center calls that a freeform block.

cases.title: OpenAI 公开一批数学文稿，附带可检查的证明文件
cases.titleEn: OpenAI published a batch of math papers, with proof files you can check
cases.summary: OpenAI 发了一篇《Sharing AI progress in mathematics》，并在 GitHub 仓库 openai/math 放出一批由内部模型写出的数学文稿。仓库说明写，当前目录有 722 篇文稿，分成 372 个结果族。一篇族可以把主结果、伴随论证和另一种证法放在一起。仓库同时放了 Lean 证明。Lean 是一种可以用电脑检查证明对不对的语言。说明写，不是每一篇都有 Lean，没有形式化的结果里可能有问题，他们会尽快改。博文还写，这次附了 10 份推理过程的缩写，以及按 ChatGPT Pro 思考时长估算的计算量：平均每个结果大约相当于 3 小时。模型本身还没有放出。本库没有读这些论文，也没有跑过 Lean。
cases.summaryEn: OpenAI published “Sharing AI progress in mathematics” and put a batch of math papers from an internal model in the GitHub repo openai/math. The repo says the catalogue has 722 manuscripts in 372 families. A family can hold a main result, companion arguments, and another proof. The repo also includes Lean proofs. Lean is a language a computer can use to check whether a proof holds. The readme says not every paper has Lean, that some results without it could have issues, and that they will try to fix those quickly. The post also says this release includes 10 shortened reasoning summaries and a compute estimate in ChatGPT Pro thinking time: about three hours for the average result. The model itself is not released. This library did not read the papers and did not run Lean.
cases.hook: OpenAI 公开一批数学文稿，并附上可以核对的证明。
cases.hookEn: OpenAI published a batch of math papers, plus proofs you can check.
cases.qualityNote: 可读文本来自 r.jina.ai 对同一 URL 的抓取，标题 Sharing AI progress in mathematics。博文写：结果来自一个内部前沿模型；与普林斯顿高等研究院的数学与人工智能顾问组商量过发布方式；材料放在 GitHub，含修订和引用约定；许多证明有 Lean 形式化，以后继续补；另有 10 份推理摘要、按 ChatGPT Pro 用量估算的计算量，以及尝试过多少问题的统计。博文给出的计算量原句是 The average result used the equivalent compute of roughly three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking。博文说会资助研讨会，细节以后再说；模型还在准备负责任地发布，本条不把它写成已上线的模型。README 与 CONTENTS.md 都写 722 manuscripts、372 families。README 写并非都有 Lean，未形式化的结果可能有问题。本库没有逐篇打开 PDF，没有运行 Lean，没有核对“大约三小时”的换算，也没有打开博文里指向的 Navier-Stokes 模型页。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The readable text is a fetch of that same URL through r.jina.ai, title Sharing AI progress in mathematics. The post says the results come from an internal frontier model, that release practice was discussed with the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence at the Institute for Advanced Study, that the materials are on GitHub with revision and citation protocols, that many proofs have Lean formalizations and more will be added, and that the release includes 10 reasoning summaries, a compute estimate in ChatGPT Pro usage, and statistics on how many problems were attempted. The compute sentence is: The average result used the equivalent compute of roughly three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking. The post says workshops will be funded later, without details. It says the model is still being prepared for a responsible release, so this note does not treat it as a model you can call. Both the README and CONTENTS.md say 722 manuscripts and 372 families. The README says not every paper has Lean and that some unformalized results could have issues. This library did not open the PDFs one by one, did not run Lean, did not check the “about three hours” conversion, and did not open the Navier-Stokes model page linked from the post.

landing.what: 这是一次数学结果的公开，不是一个你能在聊天框里调用的新模型。OpenAI 说这些文稿来自他们内部还没发布的模型。公开的位置是 GitHub 仓库 openai/math，许可 Apache-2.0。仓库自己的目录写着 722 篇文稿、372 个结果族。一个族是一组相关论文，可以包括主结果、配套论证或另一种证法。旁边有 Lean 证明，电脑可以检查这些证明是否成立。仓库写得很直：不是每篇都有 Lean，没做形式化的结果里可能有错，发现了会改。博文另外说，这次放了 10 份推理过程的缩写，并说平均每个结果用掉的计算量大约等于 ChatGPT Pro 思考 3 小时。这句话是官方的估算，本库没有重算。
landing.whatEn: This is a release of math results, not a new model you can call from a chat box. OpenAI says the papers come from an internal model that is not released yet. The public place is the GitHub repo openai/math, under Apache-2.0. The repo’s own catalogue says 722 manuscripts and 372 families. A family is a group of related papers: a main result, companion arguments, or another proof. Lean proofs sit beside them. A computer can check whether those proofs hold. The repo is direct: not every paper has Lean, results without that check could be wrong, and they intend to fix problems they find. The post also says this release includes 10 shortened reasoning write-ups, and that the average result used about three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking. That is the vendor’s estimate. This library did not recompute it.

contrast.caption: 左列是公告和仓库写明的事实。右列是本站口径：为什么放在 Cases 的资讯里，而不是模型板。
contrast.captionEn: Left: what the post and the repo state. Right: why this sits in Cases as news, not on the model board.

rows.left: 722 篇文稿、372 个族，外加一部分 Lean 证明和 10 份推理摘要。
rows.leftEn: 722 manuscripts, 372 families, plus some Lean proofs and 10 reasoning summaries.
rows.right: 篇数和族数来自仓库 README 与 CONTENTS.md，不是新闻标题里的约数。
rows.rightEn: The manuscript and family counts come from the repo README and CONTENTS.md, not from a rounded figure in a headline.

rows.left: 博文说还在准备发布做出这些结果的模型。仓库里是文稿和证明，不是模型权重。
rows.leftEn: The post says the model that produced the results is still being prepared for release. The repo holds papers and proofs, not weights.
rows.right: 所以这条进 Cases 的资讯，不进模型板。本库也不能替你调用它。
rows.rightEn: That is why this is a Cases news note and not a model card. This library also cannot call it for you.

rows.left: 仓库写许多篇有 Lean，但不是全部；没有形式化的结果可能有问题。
rows.leftEn: The repo says many papers have Lean, not all of them, and unformalized results could have issues.
rows.right: 本库没有跑 Lean，也没有把 722 篇逐篇读完。
rows.rightEn: This library did not run Lean and did not read all 722 papers.

cases.title: ArtCraft Crafting Apps — 七款对标 Adobe 的开源创作软件，AI 助手能直接操作
cases.titleEn: ArtCraft Crafting Apps — seven open-source Adobe-style creative apps an AI agent can drive
cases.summary: ArtCraft 团队用 Rust 从零重写了七款对标 Adobe 的创作软件：修图 PhotoCraft（对标 Photoshop）、矢量插画 VectorCraft（Illustrator）、剪视频 FilmCraft（Premiere Pro）、照片管理和 RAW 冲印 LightCraft（Lightroom）、PDF 工具 PrintCraft（Acrobat）、动效特效 EffectCraft（After Effects）、排版 DesignCraft（InDesign）。全部免费开源，Mac、Windows、Linux 都有安装包。跟 AI 最相关的是：每个应用都带命令行和 MCP 服务器，Claude 这类 AI 助手可以直接打开文件、调参数、导出，不用靠截图点鼠标。现在都还很早期，官方自己说 PhotoCraft 还替代不了日常专业工作。这是一条工具笔记：本库没有下载安装，也没有让 AI 助手实际操作过。
cases.summaryEn: The ArtCraft team rewrote seven Adobe-style creative apps from scratch in Rust: PhotoCraft for image editing (like Photoshop), VectorCraft for vector illustration (Illustrator), FilmCraft for video editing (Premiere Pro), LightCraft for photo library and raw development (Lightroom), PrintCraft for PDFs (Acrobat), EffectCraft for motion graphics and effects (After Effects), and DesignCraft for page layout (InDesign). All are free and open source, with installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux. The AI angle: every app ships a command-line tool and an MCP server, so an agent like Claude can open files, set parameters, and export without clicking through screenshots. All of them are early; the team itself says PhotoCraft cannot yet replace daily professional work. This is a tool tip. This library did not install any of them or let an agent drive one.
cases.hook: 七款对标 Adobe 的开源软件，AI 助手能用 MCP 直接操作。
cases.hookEn: Seven free, open-source Adobe-style apps that an AI agent can drive over MCP.
cases.qualityNote: 帖子说法偏夸张，本条以官方来源为准。七个仓库都在 GitHub 组织 storytold 下（ArtCraft 主仓库 storytold/artcraft 也在此，官网页脚写 hello@storyteller.ai），各自 README 都写 clean-room（只依据公开规范和观察到的行为实现，不含 Adobe 代码或素材）、MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可，并写明与 Adobe 无关联。官网状态标签：PhotoCraft、PrintCraft 为 Early alpha，其余为 In development。PhotoCraft README：500+ 条命令同时供界面、CLI、JSON 控制通道和 MCP 使用；`photocraft-cli mcp` 可无界面运行，也可桥接到正在运行的应用；docs/control-protocol.md 写桥接只监听本机回环地址并要令牌，文件读写范围用 --automation-read-root / --automation-write-root 限定。PrintCraft README 写 MCP 默认不启动、不开网络端口，只在助手启动 printcraft-cli mcp 时经 stdin/stdout 运行。PhotoCraft README 状态段原话大意：还不是日常专业工作的 Photoshop 替代品，最大缺口是 AI/生成式功能、约二十个工具、排版深度和插件兼容。PSD：官网写 135 个真实文件里 134 个逐字节往返；README 更细：psd-tools 测试集 309 个文件里 307 个打开再保存后渲染一致，重新保存的文件并非逐字节相同，只有独立的 photocraft-psd 库能逐字节还原。两处口径不同，本条按 README。组织里 10-07 还新建了 gridcraft（Excel）、cadcraft（AutoCAD）、deckcraft（PowerPoint）、soundcraft（Pro Tools），不在官网七款之列，本条不收。本库未下载、未安装、未从源码编译、未接 MCP。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The post overstates things, so this entry follows the official sources. All seven repos live in the GitHub org storytold (alongside the main ArtCraft repo storytold/artcraft; the site footer lists hello@storyteller.ai). Each README says clean-room (built from public specs and observed behaviour only, no Adobe code or assets), dual MIT or Apache-2.0, and not affiliated with Adobe. Site status labels: PhotoCraft and PrintCraft are Early alpha, the rest In development. PhotoCraft README: 500+ commands shared by the UI, CLI, JSON control channel, and MCP; `photocraft-cli mcp` runs headless or bridges to the running app; docs/control-protocol.md says the bridge listens on loopback only and needs a token, and file access is limited with --automation-read-root / --automation-write-root. PrintCraft README says its MCP server never starts on its own, opens no network port, and runs over stdin/stdout only while an agent launches printcraft-cli mcp. PhotoCraft README status, paraphrased: not yet a Photoshop replacement for daily professional work; the biggest gaps are AI/generative features, about twenty tools, typography depth, and plug-in compatibility. PSD: the site says 134 of 135 real files round-trip byte for byte; the README is more specific — 307 of 309 psd-tools files render the same after open-and-save, a re-saved file is not byte-identical, and only the standalone photocraft-psd crate reproduces files byte for byte. The two differ; this entry follows the README. On 10-07 the org also created gridcraft (Excel), cadcraft (AutoCAD), deckcraft (PowerPoint), and soundcraft (Pro Tools); they are not among the site’s seven and are not covered here. This library did not download, install, build from source, or connect MCP.
cases.approvalBoundary: 让 AI 助手通过 MCP 读写文件前，先限定它能碰的文件夹，重要文件先备份。本库没有代装。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Before letting an agent read or write files over MCP, limit which folders it can touch and back up important files. This library did not install it.

landing.what: ArtCraft 本来是做 AI 出图出视频的团队，这次另开了一套叫 Crafting Apps 的开源软件：七款应用分别对应 Adobe 的 Photoshop、Illustrator、Premiere Pro、Lightroom、Acrobat、After Effects 和 InDesign，界面、快捷键和菜单都照着设计师已经熟悉的习惯来，全部用 Rust 从零写成，文件都在你自己电脑上处理。对 AI 来说，最有用的是每个应用里的每个按钮都是一条命令：界面、命令行和 MCP 服务器调的是同一套命令。所以你可以让 Claude、Cursor 这类助手直接修图、批量调色、拆合 PDF、排版，而不是让它看截图去点。适合想试 Adobe 免费替代品的设计师，以及想让 AI 助手直接动手处理图片、PDF、视频的人。
landing.whatEn: ArtCraft is a team that makes an AI image and video studio. Crafting Apps is a separate set of open-source apps: seven of them, matching Adobe’s Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Acrobat, After Effects, and InDesign. Layouts, shortcuts, and menus follow habits designers already have. Every app is written from scratch in Rust, and your files are processed on your own machine. For AI, the useful part is that every button in each app is a command, and the UI, the command line, and the MCP server all call the same commands. So an agent like Claude or Cursor can retouch images, batch-grade photos, split and merge PDFs, or lay out pages directly, instead of reading screenshots and clicking. It suits designers who want to try a free Adobe alternative, and anyone who wants an AI agent to work on images, PDFs, and video hands-on.

contrast.caption: 左列是官网和各仓库 README 写的事实。右列是本站口径：为什么收进来，以及别把它当成已经能换掉 Adobe 的东西。
contrast.captionEn: Left: what the site and each repo README state. Right: this library’s framing — why it is here, and why not to treat it as a ready Adobe replacement.

rows.left: 七款开源创作软件：修图、矢量、剪辑、照片 RAW、PDF、动效、排版。Mac、Windows、Linux 都有安装包，免费。
rows.leftEn: Seven open-source creative apps: image editing, vector, video, photo raw, PDF, motion, and layout. Installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux, free.
rows.right: Cases 里的工具笔记，偏 AI×设计。收它是因为「设计软件能被 AI 助手直接操作」，不是因为它已经比 Adobe 好用。
rows.rightEn: An AI×design tool tip in Cases. It is here because design software that an agent can drive directly is useful, not because it already beats Adobe.

rows.aspect: 跟 AI 有什么关系
rows.left: 每个应用都带命令行和 MCP 服务器。PhotoCraft 有 500 多条命令，界面能点的，AI 助手也能调。
rows.leftEn: Every app ships a command line and an MCP server. PhotoCraft has 500+ commands; anything you can click, an agent can call.
rows.right: 这是 README 的说法。本库没有接过 MCP，也没让助手真修过一张图。PhotoCraft 自己还没有生成式 AI 功能。
rows.rightEn: That is the README’s claim. This library did not connect MCP or have an agent edit a real image. PhotoCraft itself has no generative AI features yet.

rows.left: 官网标 PhotoCraft、PrintCraft 为早期 alpha，其余为开发中。PhotoCraft README 直说还替代不了日常专业工作，缺约二十个工具和插件兼容。
rows.leftEn: The site marks PhotoCraft and PrintCraft as early alpha and the rest as in development. PhotoCraft’s README says plainly it cannot yet replace daily professional work and lacks about twenty tools and plug-in support.
rows.right: X 上「Adobe 天塌了」是夸张说法。可以先拿来做小活、试自动化，正式项目别急着迁过去。
rows.rightEn: “Adobe is done for” on X is an overstatement. Use it for small jobs and automation experiments; don’t rush real projects over.

steps.title: 先看总览页，挑一个你最常用的
steps.titleEn: Start with the overview and pick the one you use most
steps.body: 打开官网总览页，七款应用各有一张卡片，写着对应的用途、状态（早期 alpha 或开发中）和支持的系统。修图选 PhotoCraft，处理 PDF 选 PrintCraft，这两个最成熟。每个应用页都有下载按钮和 GitHub 链接。
steps.bodyEn: Open the overview page. Each of the seven apps has a card with what it does, its status (early alpha or in development), and supported systems. Pick PhotoCraft for image editing or PrintCraft for PDFs; those two are the furthest along. Every app page has a download button and a GitHub link.

steps.title: 下载安装，或者从源码跑
steps.titleEn: Download an installer, or run from source
steps.body: Mac 下 dmg，Windows 下 msi 或免安装 zip，Linux 有 AppImage、deb、rpm。官网下载区的版本号可能比 GitHub 慢一步，想要最新的去 GitHub Releases。会用 Rust 的话，官网也给了 git clone 后 cargo run 的三行命令。
steps.bodyEn: On macOS grab the dmg; on Windows the msi or the portable zip; on Linux there are AppImage, deb, and rpm. The site’s download area can lag GitHub by a version, so check GitHub Releases for the newest. If you use Rust, the site also gives a three-line git clone and cargo run.

steps.title: 让 AI 助手接上 MCP
steps.titleEn: Connect your AI agent over MCP
steps.body: 每个应用都有自己的命令行工具，比如 photocraft-cli mcp、printcraft-cli mcp。把它加进 Claude、Cursor 等助手的 MCP 配置里，助手就能直接调这个应用的命令。PhotoCraft 可以不开窗口跑，也可以连到你正在用的应用上，让你看着它改。配置前先读控制协议文档，用读写目录参数限定它能碰的文件夹。
steps.bodyEn: Each app has its own command-line tool, such as photocraft-cli mcp or printcraft-cli mcp. Add it to the MCP config of Claude, Cursor, or another agent, and the agent can call that app’s commands directly. PhotoCraft can run with no window, or bridge to the app you have open so you can watch it work. Read the control protocol doc first, and use the read/write root flags to limit which folders it can touch.

boundaries.text: 本库没有下载、安装或编译任何一款，也没有把 MCP 接进任何 AI 助手。功能和测试数字都是官网和 README 的说法。
boundaries.textEn: This library did not download, install, or build any of them, and did not connect MCP to any agent. Features and test numbers are what the site and READMEs say.

boundaries.text: 都还很早期：PhotoCraft、PrintCraft 是早期 alpha，其余五款在开发中。PhotoCraft 官方说还替代不了日常专业工作，缺约二十个工具、排版深度和 Photoshop 插件兼容，也还没有生成式 AI 功能。
boundaries.textEn: All early: PhotoCraft and PrintCraft are early alpha, the other five are in development. PhotoCraft’s team says it cannot yet replace daily professional work; it lacks about twenty tools, typography depth, Photoshop plug-in support, and generative AI features.

boundaries.text: 这是独立开源项目，和 Adobe 没有关系，也打不开 Adobe 账号或云文档。PSD 能打开再保存，但 README 写明重新保存后的文件不是逐字节相同；交付给别人的文件，先在原软件里核对一遍。
boundaries.textEn: This is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with Adobe, and it does not open Adobe accounts or cloud documents. It opens and saves PSDs, but the README says a re-saved file is not byte-identical; check anything you hand off in the original software first.

boundaries.text: 让 AI 助手通过 MCP 改文件前，先限定它能读写的文件夹，并备份原文件。网页版需要你自己下载网页包部署，官网没有现成的在线编辑器。
boundaries.textEn: Before an agent edits files over MCP, limit which folders it can read and write, and back up originals. The web build is a package you host yourself; the site offers no ready-made online editor.

cases.title: James Pember：让 Bot 先接 Slack 里的产品问题，再替你备好双周会材料
cases.titleEn: James Pember: a Bot that triages product questions in Slack and preps the fortnightly sync
cases.summary: James Pember 用了一周 Grok Bot 后写的实测。他给每只 Bot 只分一件事、配好要用的技能和工具，让它们自己建和改例行任务：看日历、等 Slack 里某类回复、或者按「每天早上」「一天 4 次」跑。文中两个能照着做的用法：一是 Bot 当「第一道防线」，在 Slack 里自己分诊产品问题和 bug，帮团队找到临时绕过办法；二是双周产品营销例会前，Bot 去翻发布说明、GitHub 和 Slack，汇总成一份会前阅读材料发给大家。他也说得很直白：给团队用的多人 Agent 还没真正解决。
cases.summaryEn: James Pember’s write-up after a week with Grok Bot. Each Bot gets one scoped job plus the skills and tools it needs, and creates or updates its own routines: watch the calendar, wait for a certain kind of Slack reply, or run “every morning” or “4 times a day.” Two workflows you can copy: a Bot as the first line of defense that triages product questions and bugs in Slack on its own and found the team an instant workaround, and a Bot that digs through release notes, GitHub, and Slack before the fortnightly product-marketing sync and sends a packaged pre-read. He is also blunt that multi-player agents for whole teams are still unsolved.
cases.hook: Slack 里的产品问题先让 Bot 接，例会材料也让它备。
cases.hookEn: Let a Bot take first pass on product questions in Slack, and prep the sync too.
cases.qualityNote: 两个用法（Slack 分诊、双周会前阅读材料）是作者自述的真实工作流，文中有截图，但没有公开提示词或技能文件；本库没有复跑。他提到 Gmail、日历、Drive、Slack、GitHub 五个原生连接器占他约八成工作，这是他个人的估计。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The two workflows (Slack triage, fortnightly pre-read) are the author’s own account with screenshots; no prompts or skill files are published, and this library did not re-run them. His “about 80% of my work” for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Slack, and GitHub is his personal estimate.
cases.approvalBoundary: Bot 在 Slack 里先答、先分诊可以；给客户回话、改工单优先级或往外群发会前材料前，先让人看一眼。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Let the Bot answer and triage first in Slack; have a person check before it replies to customers, changes ticket priority, or sends a pre-read to a wider list.

cases.title: CoIsland — 把开发告警收进 Mac 刘海，一键交给编程助手
cases.titleEn: CoIsland — a Mac notch app that hands a dev alert to your coding agent
cases.summary: CoIsland 是一款只跑在 Mac 上的小应用，给同时盯着很多开发工具的人用。GitHub、Vercel、Sentry、Jira、Snowflake 这些地方一有状况，它就收成一条告警，出现在屏幕顶部的刘海里；你点一下，就能把这条告警交给 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cortex Code 去看。不买也能先试：最早的 2 条监控可以一直免费跑，不用注册。这是一条工具笔记：本库没有安装，也没有把真实告警交给任何助手。
cases.summaryEn: CoIsland is a Mac-only app for people who watch a lot of developer tools at once. When something happens in GitHub, Vercel, Sentry, Jira, Snowflake, and the rest, it turns that into one alert in the notch at the top of the screen. One click hands that alert to Claude Code, Codex, or Cortex Code. You can try it without paying: the two oldest monitors keep running for free, with no account. This is a tool tip. This library did not install it and did not hand a real alert to any agent.
cases.hook: Mac 刘海里盯着开发工具，告警一键交给编程助手。
cases.hookEn: A Mac notch app that hands a dev alert to your coding agent.
cases.qualityNote: 评论 49971029 问会不会加 Cursor，作者回复 49971033「Yes We can! Will work on it.」——所以今天的助手名单里还没有 Cursor。首页 FAQ 写：连接器 35+；免费是最早的 2 条监控一直可用、不限时间、不用账号；许可证一次买断，早鸟价 $29.99 到 10 月 25 日，之后 $49.99，最多 2 台 Mac，含一年更新，这一年里的版本以后仍归你，再续一年更新是 $5.99，无订阅，30 天内可一键退款。页面还列了早鸟合计 $50.99（每把钥匙 $25.49）和 $112.49（每把钥匙 $22.49），每把钥匙仍是最多 2 台 Mac；页文没有把套装写成「几把」，这里不替它补数量。系统要求：苹果自研芯片（M1 或更新）、macOS 14 及以上，不支持 Intel；原生 Swift。隐私政策写开发者是蒙特利尔的 DonTizi；首页作者自述是蒙特利尔的应用 AI 工程师，并称自己从 2026 年 7 月起每天用刘海办公。本库没有把这两个名字核成同一个人。隐私政策比首页那句「没有 CoIsland 服务器」更细：工具数据留在本机，应用还会问更新服务器，买了之后还会问许可证服务器，这两处都不接收工具里的数据；「匿名上报我加了哪类连接器」默认关闭。把告警交给助手时，那份简报会进 Anthropic、OpenAI 或 Snowflake 你自己的账号。本库未下载、未安装、未接任何连接器、未把告警交给助手。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Comment 49971029 asks about Cursor; the author replied in 49971033 “Yes We can! Will work on it.” Cursor is not in today’s agent list. The homepage FAQ says 35+ connectors; the free tier is the 2 oldest monitors, forever, no account; a license is paid once, early bird $29.99 until October 25 then $49.99, for up to 2 Macs, with a year of updates, and the versions from that year stay yours. Another year of updates is $5.99. No subscription. 30 days to refund in one click. The page also lists early-bird totals of $50.99 ($25.49 a key) and $112.49 ($22.49 a key), each key still covering up to 2 Macs. The page does not spell the bundle as a key count, so none is added here. Requirements: Apple silicon (M1 or later), macOS 14 or newer, not Intel; native Swift. The privacy policy names DonTizi, an independent developer in Montreal. The homepage author describes themself as an applied AI engineer in Montréal and says they have run their days from the notch since July 2026. This library did not verify that those names are the same person. The privacy policy is more specific than the homepage line “no CoIsland server”: tool data stays on the Mac, while the app also contacts an update server and, after purchase, a license server. Neither receives tool data. “Share which connector types I add, anonymously” is off until you turn it on. Handing an alert to an agent sends that brief to Anthropic, OpenAI, or Snowflake under your own account. This library did not download, install, connect a tool, or hand over an alert.
cases.approvalBoundary: 把真实账号或密钥接进去，以及让助手动手之前，自己确认。本库没有代装。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before connecting a real account or key, and before letting an agent act. This library did not install it.

landing.what: CoIsland 是一个住在 Mac 刘海（屏幕最上方那条凹槽）里的监视器。你给每个工具设一条监控：一句这个工具自己的查询，按你定的间隔去看，比如每 30 秒或每 5 分钟。出了状况才出现在刘海里，带上命中的行和备注。你点一下，Claude Code、Codex 或 Cortex Code 会在告警下面打开自己的命令行，第一条消息就是这份告警。站点写明它自己不带模型，用的是你已经登录的那三个助手。助手不能自己把告警关掉，关掉仍是你的事。适合一个人同时看着公司、副业和课业好几套 GitHub、部署和工单、不想再来回切浏览器标签的人。
landing.whatEn: CoIsland lives in the Mac notch, the cutout at the top of the screen. You set a monitor per tool: one query in that tool’s own language, checked on a schedule you pick, such as every 30 seconds or every 5 minutes. Only what fired shows up in the notch, with the matching rows and your notes. One click opens Claude Code, Codex, or Cortex Code in a terminal under the alert, and the first message is that alert. The site says CoIsland adds no model of its own. It starts the agent you already signed into. No agent can close an alert. You do. It is for someone watching several stacks at once — a job, a side project, coursework — and tired of tabbing between GitHub, deploys, and tickets.

contrast.caption: 左列是首页、助手页和隐私政策写明的事实。右列是本站口径：为什么放进 Cases，以及不要把它当成已经替你装好的技能。
contrast.captionEn: Left: what the homepage, the agents page, and the privacy policy state. Right: this library’s framing — why it is in Cases, and why it is not a skill we already installed.

rows.left: Mac 刘海应用：盯着你的开发工具，把告警一键交给 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cortex Code。
rows.leftEn: A Mac notch app: watch your dev tools, and hand an alert to Claude Code, Codex, or Cortex Code.
rows.right: Cases 里的工具笔记。补的是「告警别散落在十个网站里」，不是又一篇聊天机器人教程。
rows.rightEn: An AI tool tip in Cases. It fills “don’t leave alerts scattered across ten sites,” not another chatbot tutorial.

rows.left: 首页称没有 CoIsland 账号，密钥在 Mac 钥匙串里，应用直接找你的工具。免费保留最早 2 条监控。买断早鸟 $29.99，10 月 25 日后 $49.99。
rows.leftEn: The homepage says no CoIsland account, keys live in the Mac Keychain, and the app talks to your tools directly. The 2 oldest monitors stay free. A license is $29.99 early bird, then $49.99 after October 25.
rows.right: 隐私政策还写了更新服务器和买后的许可证服务器，只是它们不收工具数据。本库没有安装，也没有付款。
rows.rightEn: The privacy policy also names an update server and, after you buy, a license server. They do not receive tool data. This library did not install it and did not pay.

rows.aspect: 助手会不会自己改东西
rows.left: 站点写 Claude Code 用自动模式、Codex 用 approve-for-me、Cortex Code 默认先问再写。三者都不能自己关掉告警。
rows.leftEn: The site says Claude Code runs in auto mode, Codex uses approve-for-me, and Cortex Code asks before writes by default. None of the three can close an alert.
rows.right: 这是站点对三家助手的描述。本库没有装这三个命令行，也没有交过一条真告警。
rows.rightEn: That is the site’s description of the three agents. This library did not install those command-line tools and did not hand over a real alert.

steps.title: 先看首页和 Show HN
steps.titleEn: Read the homepage and the Show HN first
steps.body: 打开 coisland.app，看它怎么讲刘海、35 个以上的连接器，以及免费的 2 条监控。Show HN 讨论在 item 49970043。有人问 Cursor，作者说会做，所以别默认今天就能接 Cursor。点数会变，以你打开当天为准。
steps.bodyEn: Open coisland.app and see how it describes the notch, 35+ connectors, and the two free monitors. The Show HN thread is item 49970043. Someone asked about Cursor and the author said they would work on it, so don’t assume Cursor works today. Point counts change — use whatever the thread shows when you open it.

steps.title: 对照能接什么、交给谁、数据去哪
steps.titleEn: Check what it connects, who it hands work to, and where data goes
steps.body: 连接器页是完整名单。助手页写三个命令行：Claude Code、Codex、Cortex Code，以及各自要你自己的账号。隐私政策写密钥在 Mac 钥匙串（系统存密码的地方），工具内容留在本机；更新和许可证会联网，但不收这些内容。把告警交出去之后，那份简报会进助手厂商。
steps.bodyEn: The connectors page is the full list. The agents page names three command-line tools — Claude Code, Codex, and Cortex Code — and says each one uses your own account. The privacy policy says keys stay in the Mac Keychain (where the system keeps passwords) and tool contents stay on the Mac. Updates and the license do use the network, but they don’t receive those contents. Once you hand an alert over, that brief goes to the agent’s maker.

steps.title: 自己决定要不要装
steps.titleEn: Decide yourself whether to install
steps.body: 首页有 Download free。系统要求是苹果自研芯片、macOS 14 或更新，Intel 的 Mac 不行。免费先跑最早的 2 条监控。要全部监控再看早鸟价。本库没有下载安装包，也没有把任何一个仓库或数据库交给它。
steps.bodyEn: The homepage has Download free. It needs Apple silicon and macOS 14 or newer. Intel Macs are out. The free tier runs the two oldest monitors. Read the early-bird price before you unlock the rest. This library did not download the installer and did not point it at any repo or database.

links.label: 首页上的下载和价格
links.labelEn: Download and price on the homepage

boundaries.text: 本库未下载、未安装、未接 GitHub 或其他工具，也没有把告警交给 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cortex Code。
boundaries.textEn: This library did not download it, did not install it, did not connect GitHub or any other tool, and did not hand an alert to Claude Code, Codex, or Cortex Code.

boundaries.text: 只支持苹果自研芯片（M1 或更新）和 macOS 14 及以上。Intel 的 Mac 不能用。
boundaries.textEn: Apple silicon only (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or newer. It does not run on Intel Macs.

boundaries.text: 「没有服务器、密钥只在钥匙串」要和隐私政策一起看：更新服务器和买后的许可证服务器是存在的，它们不接收工具数据。匿名的连接器种类统计默认关闭。交给助手的那条告警，会按你在 Anthropic、OpenAI 或 Snowflake 的账号送出去。
boundaries.textEn: “No server, keys only in the Keychain” has to be read with the privacy policy. An update server exists, and a license server exists after you buy. They do not receive tool data. The anonymous connector-type count is off until you enable it. The alert you hand to an agent is sent under your Anthropic, OpenAI, or Snowflake account.

boundaries.text: 价格、35+ 连接器、三家助手的自动或询问模式，都是站点自己的说法。Cursor 还不在名单里。本库没有付款，也没有替你试退款。
boundaries.textEn: The price, the 35+ connectors, and how the three agents auto-run or ask first are the site’s own statements. Cursor is not on the list yet. This library did not pay and did not try a refund.

cases.title: Grok Bot for Work（收件箱、日历、情报三只 Bot + 一个总管）
cases.titleEn: Grok Bot for Work (inbox, calendar, intel bots plus one Bot Boss)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 的 Josh Kim 2026-09-24 写的官方指南：他用四只 Bot 管日常工作。Inbox Manager 只读邮件、Slack 和私信，每次只挑出约 3 件「又重要又急」的事；Calendar EA 守住整块专注时间、把会议排得紧凑、别撞上接孩子的时间，改日程前先问；Intel Scout 工作日 8 点和 17 点各报一次：公司里影响你的事、没跟进的事、开会前要知道的事；最后一只 Bot Boss 当唯一入口，其他三只都向它汇报，你只跟它说话。四只 Bot 的完整设定文都能直接复制。
cases.summaryEn: Official guide by SpaceXAI’s Josh Kim, Sep 24, 2026: four bots for everyday work. Inbox Manager reads email, Slack, and DMs read-only and surfaces about three items that are both important and urgent; Calendar EA protects focus blocks, packs meetings together, guards the school-pickup hard stop, and asks before moving anything; Intel Scout reports at 8am and 5pm on weekdays (company moves that affect you, open follow-ups, what you need before meetings); Bot Boss is the single front door the other three report to. All four instruction texts are copyable.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Guides（2026-09-24），早间页面 200。收录理由：四段设定文可以原样复制，是普通上班族最容易照抄的一套。边界：文中效果是作者个人感受；设定里写明默认「先建好但不启用、你点 Enable 才跑」、只读、不替你发。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official Guides (Sep 24, 2026), page returned 200 this morning. Why listed: four copy-paste instruction texts, the easiest set for an ordinary office worker to reuse. Boundary: results are the author’s own account; the instructions default to created-but-disabled until you hit Enable, read-only, never sending for you. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 读和整理可以自动；回邮件、发 Slack、改日历、发邀请都要你确认。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Reading and sorting can run on their own; replies, Slack posts, calendar changes, and invites need your confirmation.
cases.hook: 四只 Bot 管邮件、日历、消息，你只跟总管说话。
cases.hookEn: Four bots handle mail, calendar, and news; you only talk to the boss bot.

cases.title: Grok Bot for Post-Sales（一个参谋长 Bot 管一屋子专员）
cases.titleEn: Grok Bot for Post-Sales (one chief-of-staff bot over a bench of specialists)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 的 Blake Schuller 2026-09-24 官方指南：客户经理手上账户多、上下文散在通话记录、Slack、邮件和日历里。他试过自己管 20 只 Bot，太乱，于是只跟一只叫 Gus 的参谋长说话，其他 Bot（每个客户一只专员、帮他写邮件的 Ink、查文档答问题的 Questions、读内部频道的 Scout 等）都向 Gus 汇报。常用 Routine：每 15 分钟检查一次、会前 15–35 分钟才写会前卡片；每天 9/13/16 点列「我答应过但没做的事」；只追「我发了没人回、下一步在我」的消息；工作日早上找用量骤降的账户；周五自动更新看板；周三让 Gus 自查哪些 Routine 没人看。起步方法：录 10 分钟语音讲你一天怎么过，丢给 Bot 让它搭系统。
cases.summaryEn: Official guide by SpaceXAI’s Blake Schuller, Sep 24, 2026. Post-sales context is scattered across call transcripts, Slack, email, and calendars. After trying to manage twenty bots directly, he talks only to one chief-of-staff bot, Gus; account specialists, a writer bot (Ink), a docs-answer bot (Questions), and a channel reader (Scout) report to Gus. Routines include call prep that checks every 15 minutes but only writes when a call is 15–35 minutes out, an unfinished-promises list at 9, 1, and 4, an unanswered-asks check that only surfaces threads where the next move is his, morning usage-cliff scans, a Friday dashboard, and a Wednesday self-audit. Start by recording a ten-minute voice memo of your day and asking a bot to build the system.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Guides（2026-09-24）。收录理由：「只管一只 Bot」的思路和一组时间点很具体的 Routine，换成任何手上客户多的岗位都能抄。边界：用到的通话记录、CRM 等连接器要你自己有；邮件只存草稿，作者亲自按发送。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official Guides (Sep 24, 2026). Why listed: the manage-one-bot idea plus routines with very concrete timing transfer to any role juggling many accounts. Boundary: you need your own transcript and CRM connections; replies sit in drafts and the author presses send. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 整理、写草稿、做会前卡片可以自动；任何以你名义发出去的东西都由你按发送。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Organizing, drafting, and prep cards can run on their own; anything sent under your name waits for you to press send.
cases.hook: 只跟一个参谋长 Bot 说话，其余 Bot 向它汇报。
cases.hookEn: Talk to one chief-of-staff bot; the rest report to it.

cases.title: Grok Bot for Recruiting（面试简报、评分表、寻访、漏斗分析）
cases.titleEn: Grok Bot for Recruiting (interview briefs, scorecards, sourcing, loop analysis)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 的 Holly Dyche 2026-09-24 官方指南：招聘团队搭了四只 Bot。Preppy 在面试前往 Slack 发一条简报，把候选人背景、阶段、要重点问什么集中到一处；Pulse 面完拉会议转写，对着岗位评分表起草反馈，先问你几个问题（打分、感觉、哪里存疑）再改稿提交到招聘系统；Scout 读几百份录用和淘汰的记录学规律，夜里找候选人、起草多轮触达，你批准才发；eVal 找候选人在哪一轮最常挂、原因是什么，反推初筛该问的问题。开车路上也能用语音让它改招聘系统里的记录。
cases.summaryEn: Official guide by SpaceXAI’s Holly Dyche, Sep 24, 2026: four recruiting bots. Preppy posts one Slack brief before each interview with candidate context, stage, and focus areas; Pulse pulls the meeting transcript after an interview, drafts feedback against the role scorecard, asks you a few follow-ups (rating, gut feel, anything fuzzy), then redrafts and submits to the ATS; Scout learns from hundreds of hired and rejected candidates, sources overnight, and drafts multi-touch outreach you approve before sending; eVal finds where candidates fail in the loop and turns that into recruiter-screen questions. Voice mode lets you update the ATS on the go.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Guides（2026-09-24）。收录理由：四只 Bot 各管一段招聘流程，前后串起来，是团队一起用的完整示例。边界：要连招聘系统（文中是 Ashby）、Notion、会议转写；涉及候选人个人信息，注意公司隐私规定。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official Guides (Sep 24, 2026). Why listed: four bots each own one stage and hand off to each other, a full team example. Boundary: needs your ATS (Ashby in the post), Notion, and meeting transcripts; candidate data is personal, so follow your privacy rules. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 简报和草稿可以自动；给候选人发消息、提交评分、改录用状态要人确认。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Briefs and drafts can run on their own; messaging candidates, submitting scorecards, and changing hiring status need a person.
cases.hook: 面前简报、面后评分表，Bot 先起草你再拍板。
cases.hookEn: Briefs before, scorecards after: the bot drafts, you decide.

cases.title: Grok Bot for SDRs（Cursor 写研究和初稿，Grok Bot 做后面的杂活）
cases.titleEn: Grok Bot for SDRs (Cursor writes research and drafts, Grok Bot does the busywork)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 销售开发 Stefan Markarian 2026-09-24 官方指南：五步做外联——Cursor 云端 agent 查客户用量、丢单记录和过往通话写研究包；按这个故事找人；用写作技能起草第一封信；Grok Bot 检查每个人是否已在别的序列里或有进行中的商机，干净的标 CLEAR 进序列但不发，有问题的标 FLAG 等人看；最后他本人发。一只 Bot 一件事：总管负责每天早上的流程，一只管名单表格防止重复联系，一只发不带附言的 LinkedIn 邀请并先查每日上限。规矩：绝不自动发送，同一个问题出两次就写进技能。
cases.summaryEn: Official guide by SpaceXAI SDR Stefan Markarian, Sep 24, 2026: five steps. Cursor cloud agents build a research packet from product usage, closed-lost deals, and past calls; prospects are matched to that story; first touches are drafted with writing skills; Grok Bot checks whether each person is already in another sequence or tied to an open opportunity, enrolls CLEAR contacts unsent and holds FLAGs for review; he sends himself. One job per bot: a chief of staff owns the morning run, one keeps the prospecting sheet so nobody is worked twice, one sends blank LinkedIn requests after checking caps. Rules: never auto-send, and any problem that happens twice becomes a skill update.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Guides（2026-09-24）。收录理由：清楚示范 Cursor 和 Grok Bot 怎么分工，以及 CLEAR/FLAG 这种「干净的往前走、有疑问的停下」的分拣法，其他岗位也能用。边界：依赖 Salesforce、Gong、Nooks、Amplemarket 等付费销售工具；文中数字是作者某一天的情况。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official Guides (Sep 24, 2026). Why listed: a clear split of work between Cursor and Grok Bot, and a CLEAR/FLAG triage (clean items move, questionable ones stop) that works for other roles too. Boundary: relies on paid sales tools (Salesforce, Gong, Nooks, Amplemarket); figures describe one day in the author’s work. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 研究、起草、建记录、排进序列（不发）可以自动；每一封信和每条触达都由人发。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Research, drafts, record creation, and unsent enrollment can run on their own; every email and touch is sent by a person.

cases.title: Grok Bot for Legal Ops（法务运营：会前准备、Slack 分拣、合同流程）
cases.titleEn: Grok Bot for Legal Ops (1:1 prep, Slack triage, contract workflows)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 法务运营 Kelly Noguchi 2026-09-24 官方指南：律师 1:1 前，Bot 翻 Slack、Notion、会议记录和跟踪表起草议程，会后把决定写回对应页面；盯法务相关频道里没人回、口径打架的问题；从 Slack 请求自动维护「待法务审」跟踪表，并补上商机和报价快照；在合同系统里查流程和状态，经明确要求才帮你把已批文件放进流程，写入前先预览确认。原来靠 Cursor 自动化 + Google Apps Script 跑的表，现在全搬进 Grok Bot。可借鉴的规矩：按流程拆 Bot、对外消息一律先草稿再人发、读和写系统分开。
cases.summaryEn: Official guide by SpaceXAI Legal Ops’ Kelly Noguchi, Sep 24, 2026. Before attorney 1:1s the bot drafts an agenda from Slack, Notion, notes, and trackers, then writes decisions back afterward; it watches legal channels for unanswered or conflicting guidance; it maintains a Legal Review tracker from Slack intakes enriched with deal and quote snapshots; in the contract system it looks up workflows and, only on explicit request, moves approved documents with a preview before any write. A tracker that used to run on Cursor automation plus Google Apps Script now runs fully in Grok Bot. Portable rules: one bot per workflow, draft-then-human-send for outbound messages, separate read and write paths.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Guides（2026-09-24）。收录理由：少见的法务岗位实例，而且写清了「哪些只读、哪些写之前要预览」。边界：依赖 Ironclad、Salesforce 等企业系统；法律判断仍由律师做。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official Guides (Sep 24, 2026). Why listed: a rare legal-team example that spells out what stays read-only and what needs a preview before writing. Boundary: relies on enterprise systems like Ironclad and Salesforce; legal judgment stays with attorneys. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 整理、查资料、起草可以自动；对外消息、写入合同系统和 CRM 前都要人确认。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Organizing, research, and drafting can run on their own; outbound messages and writes to the contract system or CRM need a person first.

cases.titleEn: Haggle Bot for procurement (idle seats, price comparison, negotiation prep)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 2026-09-04 官方文章：他们做了一只叫 Haggle Bot 的采购 Bot，接上 Slack、Notion、Drive、Gmail、Hex 和 Ramp，先摸清约 125 家在用供应商。例子：某个软件 43 个付费席位 90 天没人用，退掉省 $14,220；另一个按月付费的软件找出每年 $85,662 的闲置项；续约时比较几家替代品、算出筹码再起草回信；每周新员工物品订单在 Amazon、Costco、Uline、Walmart 间比价，结果写进可改的表格。文中给出完整设定文模板：哪些事可以直接做、哪些每次都要你点头、哪些绝对不做（签约、下单、付款）。官方称累计找出超过 $100,000 的直接节省。
cases.summaryEn: Official SpaceXAI post, Sep 4, 2026: a procurement bot called Haggle Bot, connected to Slack, Notion, Drive, Gmail, Hex, and Ramp, first mapped about 125 active vendors. Examples: 43 paid seats idle for 90 days on one product ($14,220 saved), $85,662 a year of unused SKUs on a month-to-month product, renewal research that priced alternatives and drafted a counteroffer, and weekly new-hire supply orders shopped across Amazon, Costco, Uline, and Walmart into an editable sheet. The post shares a full instruction template with three permission lines: always allowed, needs the operator’s go every time, never (signing, buying, approving charges). SpaceXAI reports more than $100,000 in direct savings.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 News（2026-09-04），早间页面 200。收录理由：设定文模板把「能做、要批、绝不做」三条线写得很清楚，小公司查闲置订阅也能直接套。边界：节省金额是官方自报，本库无法核实；需要能读到账单和席位使用数据。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official News (Sep 4, 2026), page returned 200 this morning. Why listed: the template draws clear lines between allowed, needs-approval, and never, and a small company can reuse it to find idle subscriptions. Boundary: savings figures are self-reported and not verified here; you need access to billing and seat-usage data. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 查数据、问同事、整理档案可以自动；给供应商发信每次都要批；签约、下单、付款一律不做。

cases.title: SpaceXAI 用 Grok Bot 扛客服量（先只写内部备注，再逐步放开）
cases.titleEn: how SpaceXAI scaled customer support with Grok Bot (internal notes first, then wider)
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 2026-09-22 官方文章：Cursor 并入后两支客服团队合并、产品线变多。做法是一步步放开：先接工单系统 Plain 和 Linear，让 Bot 像负责人一样处理工单，但只能写内部备注、每个写操作都要人批；给每次运行加记录和评估，出错就调；第一天先人工审它对简单工单的理解和回复，当天就放它直接回客户。之后让它在工单进来时先查 Linear 已知问题和 Datadog 报错、录视频复现 bug；按退款规则处理大部分退款；盯排队量和响应时限；同类问题多到阈值就自动开事故；每周给管理层报哪里答得不好。官方称工单量涨了 175% 没加人，单张成本低到 $0.20–0.30。
cases.summaryEn: Official SpaceXAI post, Sep 22, 2026. After Cursor joined, two support teams merged around more products. Rollout was gradual: connect Plain (ticketing) and Linear, let the bot act as ticket owner but write only internal notes with every write approved, add traces and evals, review its read and proposed reply on easy tickets for one day, then let it answer customers directly. Later it pre-investigates every ticket against known Linear issues and Datadog errors, records bug repro videos, resolves most refunds under clear rules, manages queue priority and SLA alerts, declares incidents when similar reports cross a threshold, and sends leadership a weekly note on where AI answers fall short. SpaceXAI reports a 175% ticket increase with no new hires and costs as low as $0.20–0.30 per ticket.
cases.qualityNote: 官方 News（2026-09-22）。收录理由：和已收的 Support 指南互补，重点是「怎么一步步放权」——先只写内部备注、全程人批，再放开。边界：175%、$0.20–0.30 等数字是官方自报，本库无法核实；用到的 Plain、Linear、Datadog 需要你自己有。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official News (Sep 22, 2026). Why listed: complements the Support guide already listed, focusing on how to hand over control step by step, starting with internal notes and human approval on every write. Boundary: the 175% and $0.20–0.30 figures are self-reported and not verified here; Plain, Linear, and Datadog are your own to connect. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 起步阶段所有写操作都人批；放开后直接回复和规则内退款由 Bot 做，规则外的仍交给人。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: At the start every write is approved by a person; later the bot replies and handles in-policy refunds itself, and anything outside the rules goes to a person.
cases.hook: 客服先只写内部备注，靠得住了再放开。
cases.hookEn: Start with internal notes only; widen once it’s reliable.

cases.title: SCM（Screen Memories）— 用一句话搜本机照片和视频
cases.titleEn: SCM (Screen Memories) — search local photos and video in plain words
cases.summary: SCM（Screen Memories，屏幕记忆）是一款只跑在你自己 Mac 上的找图应用。你用平常的话描述一张照片或一段画面，它就在你指定的文件夹里找：整张照片或整段视频、视频里的某一镜头、画面上印着的字、以及视频里说出口的原话。不需要账号，文件也不上传；识别在这台 Mac 上完成。第一次使用会下载视觉模型的权重（README 写默认大约 435MB），下完之后可以断网搜。安装走 Homebrew，README 写明面向苹果自研芯片的 Mac（M 系列）、系统 macOS 12 及以上。这是一条工具笔记：本库没有安装，也没有拿真实相册试过。
cases.summaryEn: SCM (Screen Memories) is a find-your-photos app that runs only on your Mac. You describe a picture or a moment in ordinary words and it looks through folders you choose: a whole photo or video, one shot inside a video, words printed on the picture, or the exact words spoken in a clip. No account, and the files are not uploaded; the matching happens on that Mac. The first run downloads vision-model weights (the README says the default is about 435MB); after that it can search offline. Install is Homebrew. The README says Apple-silicon Macs (M-series) and macOS 12 or newer. This is a tool tip: this library did not install it or try it on a real photo library.
cases.hook: 用一句话搜本机照片，也能跳到视频里的那一帧。
cases.hookEn: Search local photos, and jump to the matching moment inside a video.
cases.qualityNote: Electron 是把网页技术包成桌面程序的壳）。README 与产品页列出的安装命令是 brew tap allenv0/scm；brew trust allenv0/scm；brew install --cask allenv0/scm/scm。五种搜索是 README 表格：Files（整张照片/视频按意思找，用 CLIP，也就是把一句话和画面配对的视觉模型）、Scenes（视频里的镜头，点开跳到时间码）、OCR（认出画面上的字；引擎是 Tesseract，这个开源程序负责认字；README 写英语加 35 种语言开关）、Dialogue（视频里的原话，用 Whisper，也就是把人话转成文字的模型）、LLMs（可选；对已经抽出的对白、画面文字和文件名做本地对话，回答带引用。README 写没在设置里打开就不会下载聊天模型）。收录理由：本机、无账号、用一句话搜照片和视频镜头，是具体能用的找图工具。边界：只按 README 的 Mac 安装路径记；默认权重大小、语言数量和聊天模型体积都是 README 数字，本库没有自己称过。未执行 brew、未安装、未索引任何相册。

landing.what: SCM 是 Allen Lee 做的 Mac 桌面应用，名字展开是 Screen Memories（屏幕记忆）。它不把照片传上云，而是在你选定的文件夹里建一个本地索引，然后让你用一句人话去搜。README 把搜索分成五档，每档解决的问题不一样：Files 找整张照片或整段视频（靠视觉模型把句子和画面配上，这种模型叫 CLIP）；Scenes 找视频里的一个镜头，结果上有时间码，点开就跳到那一秒；OCR 找画面上印着的字（认字程序是 Tesseract，README 写可以开英语和另外 35 种语言）；Dialogue 找视频里说出口的原话（把声音转成文字的模型叫 Whisper）；LLMs 是可选的本地聊天，只根据已经抽出来的对白、画面文字和文件名来答，并给出处，不打开就不会下载那份聊天模型。适合手里有大量本地素材、又不想把底片交出去的人。
landing.whatEn: SCM is Allen Lee’s Mac app. The name expands to Screen Memories. It does not upload your photos. It builds a local index of folders you pick, then lets you search with an ordinary sentence. The README splits search into five modes: Files finds a whole photo or video (a vision model called CLIP pairs the sentence with the picture); Scenes finds one shot inside a video and shows a timecode you can jump to; OCR finds words printed on the frame (the reader is Tesseract; the README says English plus 35 other language toggles); Dialogue finds the exact words spoken in a video (Whisper is the model that turns speech into text); LLMs is an optional local chat that answers only from dialogue, on-screen text, and filenames already extracted, and it cites them — the chat model is not downloaded until you turn the mode on. It is for people who have a lot of local footage and do not want to hand the originals to a cloud.

cases.title: Cloudflare Web Search API — 让 Agent 搜现在的网页
cases.titleEn: Cloudflare Web Search API — let an agent search the live web
cases.summary: Cloudflare Web Search API 是一个还在 beta（试用，接口以后可能改）的搜索接口。你的 AI 应用或 Agent 可以用它去搜现在的网页，给回答找依据，而不是猜一个网址，或只靠模型训练时见过的旧资料。上线时可选三家搜索服务：Ceramic.ai、Exa、Linkup。请求经过 Cloudflare 的 AI Gateway（他们的调用记录和扣费入口）：会出现在网关日志里，按各家自己的标价扣 AI Gateway 额度，Cloudflare 称不加价；也可以改用你自己存在网关上的那一家密钥。需要 Cloudflare 账号和 API token。这是一条工具笔记：本库没有发出过任何搜索请求。
cases.summaryEn: Cloudflare Web Search API is a search API still in beta (a trial; the interface may change). Your AI app or agent can use it to search the live web and base the answer on those pages, instead of guessing a URL or relying only on what the model saw before its training cutoff. At launch you can pick three search providers: Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Requests go through Cloudflare AI Gateway (their log and billing front door): they show up in the gateway logs and are billed to AI Gateway credits at each provider’s list price. Cloudflare says it adds no markup. You can also use your own provider key stored on the gateway. You need a Cloudflare account and an API token. This is a tool tip: this library did not send any search request.
cases.hook: 给 Agent 一个搜实时网页的接口，回答有出处。
cases.hookEn: An API so agents search the live web instead of guessing links.
cases.qualityNote: changelog 写明上线供应商为 Ceramic.ai、Exa、Linkup，三家都支持经 Cloudflare 的 Zero Data Retention（零数据保留：对方称请求做完后不留下你的搜索内容），并承诺遵守 Cloudflare 的 verified bot 抓取标准。用法文档写明：provider 只能是 ceramic、exa、linkup，不填则默认 ceramic；limit 为 1 到 10，默认 10；query 最长 1024 字符。Workers 是 env.AI.websearch({ gatewayId, query, provider, limit })。每个账号有一个名叫 default 的网关。收录理由：Agent 要搜现在的网页时，这是官方刚公开的接口。和本库已有的 Cloudflare Clef 决策模型不是同一件事。边界：beta；要账号、额度和 token；按各家标价扣费。本库未创建 token、未发出任何搜索请求。未改 models.json。
cases.qualityNoteEn: The changelog says the launch providers are Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup, that all three support Zero Data Retention for requests made through Cloudflare (they say the search text is not kept after the request), and that they committed to Cloudflare’s verified-bot crawling standards. The how-to says provider must be ceramic, exa, or linkup, and defaults to ceramic; limit is 1 to 10, default 10; query max length is 1024 characters. The token needs Account → Workers AI → Read and Account → AI Gateway → Read. Workers is env.AI.websearch({ gatewayId, query, provider, limit }). Every account has a gateway named default. Why: an official, just-published way for an agent to search the live web. It is not the same product as Cloudflare Clef, the decision model already in this library. Boundary: beta; needs an account, credits, and a token; billed at each provider’s list price. This library did not create a token and did not send a search. Unrated. models.json was not edited.
cases.approvalBoundary: 创建 API token，或发出会扣 AI Gateway 额度的搜索之前，自己确认。本库没有代为调用。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before creating an API token or sending a search that spends AI Gateway credits. This library did not call it.

landing.what: 这是 Cloudflare 在 2026-10-02 写进更新日志的一个搜索接口，目前标成 beta。它要解决的问题很具体：Agent 回答「现在网上怎么说」时，不要自己编一个链接，也不要只靠训练截止日之前的记忆。你选一家搜索服务（Ceramic.ai、Exa 或 Linkup），把问题交过去，拿回搜索结果。请求都经过 AI Gateway：网关是 Cloudflare 放在调用前面的一层，负责记日志和扣费。changelog 写费用按各家标价走，Cloudflare 不加价；你也可以把那一家的密钥存在网关上自己付。用法有两条：任何后端发 REST 请求，或者在 Cloudflare Worker 里调用 env.AI.websearch。它和本库已经收录的 Clef 不是同一个产品——Clef 是一个给选项打分的决策模型，这个接口是去搜网页。
landing.whatEn: This is a search API Cloudflare added to the changelog on 2026-10-02. It is marked beta. The job is specific: when an agent answers “what does the web say right now,” it should not invent a link or rely only on memory from before the training cutoff. You pick a search provider (Ceramic.ai, Exa, or Linkup), send the question, and get results back. Every request goes through AI Gateway, the layer Cloudflare puts in front of the call to keep logs and handle billing. The changelog says you pay each provider’s list price with no Cloudflare markup, or you store your own provider key on the gateway. There are two ways to call it: a REST request from any backend, or env.AI.websearch inside a Cloudflare Worker. It is not the Clef model already in this library. Clef scores allowed answers. This API searches the web.

cases.title: 发帖用图片 / GIF / 梗图素材站（子砚 @0xCzyan）

cases.summary: 子砚（@0xCzyan）2026-10-04 发帖 https://x.com/0xCzyan/status/2106663001164247100 ，整理了六类发帖常用素材站：Know Your Meme（梗图）、Imgur（国外热图/GIF）、Giphy（动图表情包）、Unsplash（高清摄影）、Pexels（免费图片/视频）、Wallhaven（高清壁纸）。帖文是社区收藏向清单，不是某个新产品发布，也不是 Grok Bot 用法。本条收成 Cases「内容资源」笔记，方便做图、发推、做落地页预览时找图；各站授权与署名规则不同，用之前自己看许可。本库未代下素材、未代发帖。
cases.summaryEn: Ziyan (@0xCzyan) posted https://x.com/0xCzyan/status/2106663001164247100 on 2026-10-04 with six common source sites for posting: Know Your Meme (memes), Imgur (hot images/GIFs), Giphy (animated stickers), Unsplash (high-res photos), Pexels (free photos/video), and Wallhaven (wallpapers). It is a community bookmark list, not a product launch and not a Grok Bot workflow. Listed here as a Cases content-resource tip for finding assets when making images, posts, or landing previews; license and attribution rules differ by site — check before use. This library did not download assets or post on your behalf.

Why: finding posting assets is a common need for this site’s readers, and the list is short with clickable links. Boundary: not an AI tool, not an official endorsement; licenses and commercial terms differ by site; image rights stay with authors/platforms.
