cases.title: Main Bot 主动找活、帮你分派给其他 Bot
cases.titleEn: a Main Bot that offers help first and routes work to your other Bots
cases.summary: 官方 @bot 2026-10-01T17:35Z（约 10-02 01:35 CST）发帖 https://x.com/bot/status/2105713240701538538：Grok Bot 现在会不等你开口就提出能帮你做的事；同串补充说由你的主 Bot（primary Bot）发现可接手的活并主动提出，分批推送，建议本身不计用量。官方 changelog v0.66.0（2026-10-02）https://x.ai/changelog/bot 写明：可以指定一个带星标的 Main Bot，它会主动来问进度，并协调你其他 Bot 的工作，需要 Grok Bot 0.59.0 及以上。怎么用：把最常找的那只 Bot 设为 Main Bot，以后杂事都丢给它，由它转给负责的专门 Bot；它提出的建议先看再点头。二手报道（Grokati）提到员工 @mattyp 的例子：改签航班后 Bot 提醒他 Uber 预约没跟着改，本库未单独核对该帖。
cases.summaryEn: Official @bot post at 2026-10-01T17:35Z (about 01:35 CST on 10-02), https://x.com/bot/status/2105713240701538538: Grok Bot can now suggest ways to help without being asked; the thread adds that your primary Bot spots work it can take off your plate and offers to handle it, rolling out gradually, with suggestions not counting against usage. The official changelog v0.66.0 (2026-10-02) at https://x.ai/changelog/bot says you can choose a primary Bot, marked Main Bot with a star, that checks in proactively and coordinates your other Bots; it needs Grok Bot 0.59.0 or later. How to use it: make the Bot you talk to most your Main Bot, hand it loose requests, and let it pass them to the right specialist Bot; review its suggestions before saying yes. A secondary report (Grokati) mentions staff member @mattyp’s example where Bot noticed an Uber booking wasn’t updated after a flight change; that post wasn’t checked separately here.
cases.qualityNote: 主源是官方 @bot 推文（fxtwitter 早间 200）与 x.ai/changelog/bot v0.66.0 条目。收录理由：改变日常用法——从「你去找对的 Bot」变成「交给 Main Bot 分派」，并且会主动提出可接的活。边界：分批推送，不保证每个账号已有；怎么判断该建议什么、能动哪些已连接应用，官方没细说；@mattyp 航班例子来自二手报道。本库未实测。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Primary sources are the official @bot post (fxtwitter 200 this morning) and the x.ai/changelog/bot v0.66.0 entry. Listing rationale: it changes everyday use, from picking the right Bot yourself to handing work to a Main Bot that routes it and offers tasks first. Boundary: gradual rollout, not on every account yet; how it decides what to suggest and which connected apps it may touch isn’t spelled out; the @mattyp flight example comes from a secondary report. Not tested here.
cases.approvalBoundary: 建议可以随便看；它提出要发消息、改预约、花钱或删除东西时，仍要你点头。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Reading suggestions is free; anything that sends messages, changes bookings, spends money, or deletes still needs your yes.
cases.hook: 设一个主 Bot，让它主动找活、替你分派。
cases.hookEn: Pick a Main Bot that finds work and routes it for you.

cases.title: Television — 给个人 Agent 用的开源可视化工作台
cases.titleEn: Television — open-source visual workspace for personal agents
cases.summary: Television 是 Telepath 开源的「个人 Agent GUI」：你照常在 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、OpenClaw、Pi、OpenCode 等 harness 里聊天，Agent 可以把文档、看板、日历、甚至可交互小应用做成 artifact，放到一台「电视」屏幕上持续改。仓库 telepath-computer/television，许可 MIT；产品页 television.run。macOS 有官方客户端（Apple Silicon，页面写 macOS 12+）；非 Mac 可让 Agent 按 install 指南装 CLI/服务，再用浏览器打开（仓库写明浏览器有限制）。本条是工具笔记：未代装客户端、未登录 Discord、也未在本机跑完整 artifact 流程。
cases.summaryEn: Television is Telepath’s open-source GUI for personal agents: you keep chatting in Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Pi, OpenCode, or similar harnesses, and the agent can pin documents, boards, calendars, or interactive mini-apps as artifacts on a persistent “TV” screen. Repo telepath-computer/television, MIT; product page television.run. There is a macOS client (Apple Silicon; the page says macOS 12+). Off Mac, you can have the agent follow the install guide for the CLI/server and open the browser UI (the repo notes browser limits). This is a tool tip: the client was not installed here, Discord was not joined, and a full artifact workflow was not run on this machine.
cases.hook: 给个人 Agent 加一块可视化屏幕，artifact 不埋在聊天里。
cases.hookEn: A visual screen for your personal agent so artifacts leave the chat scroll.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：作者称今日刚把仓库公开；与本站 Agent 产物 / HTML artifact 兴趣相邻，又不是又一个聊天框。边界：Agent 需跑在 Linux / macOS；Windows harness 官方写暂不支持；macOS 客户端下载链指向 todesktop；浏览器模式有限制；contrib 仍走内部 spec 流程。本库未代装、未接真实 harness、未核 Discord。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Why: the authors say the repo just opened to the public; it sits next to this site’s interest in agent artifacts / HTML without being another chat box. Boundary: the agent must run on Linux / macOS; Windows harnesses are officially unsupported for now; the macOS client download goes through todesktop; browser mode has limits; outside contributions still use an internal spec process. Not installed here, not wired to a real harness, Discord not checked.
cases.approvalBoundary: 安装 macOS 客户端或让 Agent 按 install.md 在本机装 CLI/服务、并把真实工作文件放上 TV 之前自己确认。浏览器模式有限制；不要把密钥或未脱敏材料默认摊在屏幕上。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before installing the macOS client or letting an agent follow install.md to put the CLI/server on your machine and pin real work files to the TV. Browser mode has limits; do not default to leaving secrets or unredacted material on the screen.

landing.what: Television 是 Telepath 做的开源「个人 Agent 可视化工作台」。产品页叫它 missing GUI for personal agents：你还在原来的 harness 里聊天，Agent 通过 skill 把文档、看板、日历、可交互页面做成 artifact，钉在一台可主题化的「电视」上继续改。仓库 telepath-computer/television，README 标 MIT；安装分 macOS 客户端与非 Mac 的 Agent 引导装机（浏览器访问）。本站收成 Cases 工具笔记，因为今天刚公开仓库，适合想离开无限滚动聊天的人试。
landing.whatEn: Television is Telepath’s open-source visual workspace for personal agents. The product page calls it the missing GUI for personal agents: you keep chatting in your existing harness while the agent uses skills to pin documents, boards, calendars, or interactive pages as artifacts on a themeable “TV” and keep editing them. Repo telepath-computer/television; README says MIT. Install is a macOS client, or an agent-guided setup off Mac that opens in the browser. Listed here as a Cases tool tip because the repo just went public — for people who want less infinite chat scroll.

cases.titleEn: DeepSeek Harness Desktop — official macOS / Windows app
cases.summary: DeepSeek Harness 是官方开源的 Agent harness，产品页写明现已全球公开预览。它沿 Cordis「everything is a plugin」把工具、技能和界面做成可组合插件，可以装成桌面应用，也可以从命令行打开 Web UI。桌面端提供 macOS（Apple silicon）与 Windows（64-bit）安装包；Web 入口是 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`。页面把 Agent teams、Auto approval review、Scheduled tasks、Voice input 标成 Experimental，并演示用对话安装插件、预览文档 / 表格 / 代码，以及按日程跑任务。仓库 deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness，许可 MIT。这是一条工具笔记：不代装桌面端、不登录，也不转述第三方博客里的充值或赠金。
cases.summaryEn: DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek’s official open-source Agent harness. The product page says it is in public preview worldwide. It follows Cordis’s “everything is a plugin” idea: tools, skills, and the interface are composable plugins. You can install a desktop app or open the Web UI from the command line. Desktop builds are macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows (64-bit); the web path is `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. The page labels Agent teams, Auto approval review, Scheduled tasks, and Voice input as Experimental, and it shows installing a plugin from chat, previewing docs / spreadsheets / code, and running work on a schedule. Repo deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, MIT. This is a tool tip: it does not install the desktop app, log in, or repeat cash-credit promos from third-party blogs.
cases.qualityNote: 边界：公开预览；Experimental 以页面标签为准；本库未安装桌面端、未登录、未核第三方促销。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Why: an official desktop harness. Boundary: public preview; Experimental means the page’s label; this site did not install the desktop app, log in, or check third-party promos.
cases.approvalBoundary: 安装桌面端、运行 npx、登录账号，或把本机文件夹 / 自动批准交给 Harness 之前自己确认。标成 Experimental 的插件不要当成稳定默认。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before installing the desktop app, running npx, signing in, or giving Harness a local folder or auto-approval. Plugins labeled Experimental are not a stable default.

landing.whatEn: DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek’s own open-source Agent shell. The repo is deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness and the product page is deepseek.com/en/harness. The on-page introduction says it is built on Cordis’s “everything is a plugin”: tools, skills, and the interface can be plugins, including ones created in chat via Creator mode. Two entries: a desktop download (macOS Apple silicon dmg, Windows 64-bit exe), or `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` after Node is installed. The page shows organizing documents, analyzing spreadsheets, editing code, inspecting traces, and recurring work via Scheduled tasks. Agent teams, Auto approval review, Scheduled tasks, and Voice input are labeled Experimental on the page. Listed here as a Cases tool tip for an official desktop harness — not Grok Bot itself.

cases.title: Pi 1.0 — 可自改的极简 coding agent 底座（附 Pi Durable）
cases.titleEn: Pi 1.0 — minimal, make-it-yours coding agent harness (plus Pi Durable)
cases.summary: HN 首页 https://earendil.com/posts/pi-1-0/ —— Earendil 发布 Pi 1.0：MIT 极简可扩展 agent harness（TUI / print / RPC / SDK）。文内新增 Codemode（原生 MCP 与非 LLM 模型如 Jev / 图像模型）、虚拟模型扩展、延迟加载工具、Anthropic cache warming、对话中途 system message、新 TUI 主题与默认全屏。同日实验包 Pi Durable 面向长会话 / 多表面。安装：`curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh` 或 npm `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`。本站 Cases 已收 Magnitude 写可一键接 Pi——本条补官方 1.0 节点。工具笔记，不替你安装或代跑。
cases.summaryEn: The post adds Codemode (native MCP plus non-LLM models such as Jev / image models), virtual-model extensions, deferred tool loading, Anthropic cache warming, mid-conversation system messages, a new TUI theme, and full-screen by default. Same-day experimental Pi Durable targets long-running / multi-surface use. Install: `curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh` or npm `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`. Cases already lists Magnitude as one-clickable into Pi — this tip adds the official 1.0 node. Tool tip only; does not install or run it for you.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：本机 coding agent 底座是真实痛点，且与已收 Magnitude「一键接 Pi」相邻。边界：1.0 功能清单与「hundreds of thousands」用量是厂商文案；Pi Durable 标 experimental；本库未代装、未复跑 benchmark。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listing rationale: a local coding-agent harness is a real pain point, and it sits next to catalogued Magnitude’s “one-click Pi” claim. Boundary: the 1.0 feature list and “hundreds of thousands” usage are vendor copy; Pi Durable is marked experimental; this site did not install it or re-run benches.
cases.approvalBoundary: 跑安装脚本、接 API key / OAuth、或把本机仓库与密钥交给 Pi 之前自己确认。扩展与第三方 Pi package 仍要你审权限。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before running the install script, connecting API keys / OAuth, or giving Pi access to local repos and secrets. Extensions and third-party Pi packages still need your permission review.

landing.what: Pi 是 Earendil 的 MIT 开源极简 agent harness（仓库 earendil-works/pi，站点 pi.dev）。定位是「底座你来改」：交互 TUI、print/JSON、RPC、SDK 四种模式；扩展 / skills / prompt 模板 / 主题可打包成 Pi package（npm 或 git）。2026-10-01 的 Pi 1.0 公告写明新增 Codemode（原生 MCP + 非 LLM 模型如 Jev / 图像模型）、虚拟模型扩展、延迟加载工具、Anthropic cache warming、对话中途 system message、新 TUI 主题与默认全屏。同日实验包 Pi Durable 面向长会话与多表面，而不是把这些塞进核心。安装入口在 pi.dev（curl / PowerShell / npm 等）。HN item 49926069（首页）与 49925969（Pi Durable）。本站收成 Cases「工具笔记」：补 Magnitude 文案里「一键接 Pi」对应的官方 1.0 节点，不是 Grok Bot 本体。
landing.whatEn: Pi is Earendil’s MIT-licensed minimal agent harness (repo earendil-works/pi, site pi.dev). The pitch is “make the harness yours”: interactive TUI, print/JSON, RPC, and SDK modes; extensions / skills / prompt templates / themes can ship as Pi packages (npm or git). The 2026-10-01 Pi 1.0 announce adds Codemode (native MCP plus non-LLM models such as Jev / image models), virtual-model extensions, deferred tool loading, Anthropic cache warming, mid-conversation system messages, a new TUI theme, and full-screen by default. Same-day experimental Pi Durable covers long-running / multi-surface work without bloating the core. Install paths live on pi.dev (curl / PowerShell / npm, etc.). HN items 49926069 (front page) and 49925969 (Pi Durable). Listed here as a Cases tool tip next to Magnitude’s “one-click Pi” claim — not Grok Bot itself.

cases.title: Magnitude — 为本机 Agent 自调优的开源推理引擎
cases.titleEn: Magnitude — open-source self-tuning inference engine for local agents
cases.summary: Launch HN https://github.com/magnitudedev/magnitude — Apache-2.0：面向本机 Agent 的推理引擎，在目标硬件上编译并调参 kernel，官网称相对 llama.cpp 最高约 2×（示例：M4 Pro Metal decode 30→57 tok/s；DGX Spark CUDA decode 49→58 tok/s，Qwen 3.6 35B A3B 4-bit / 64k / 无投机解码）。桌面端可一键接 Pi / OpenCode / Hermes / Codex / Claude Code 等，也提供 OpenAI 兼容接口；按需起停模型，会话间共享前缀缓存。晨间 changelog 把它与 Ledge 等一并标为「偏应用」跳过；晚间按「具体有用的 AI 工具」进 Cases 工具笔记。本条不替你下载模型或代跑推理。
cases.summaryEn: The site claims up to about 2× vs llama.cpp (example: M4 Pro Metal decode 30→57 tok/s; DGX Spark CUDA decode 49→58 tok/s, Qwen 3.6 35B A3B 4-bit / 64k / no speculative decoding). Desktop app one-clicks Pi / OpenCode / Hermes / Codex / Claude Code and more, plus an OpenAI-compatible API; models start on demand and stop after idle; sessions share prefix caches. Morning changelog skipped it as app-shaped; this evening wave files it as a concrete AI-tool tip in Cases. This tip does not download models or run inference for you.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：本机跑 Agent 时推理引擎是真实痛点，且与 Pi/Codex/Claude Code 等已常见栈可对接。边界：官网/Launch HN 基准是厂商自测口径（HN 评论对 M5+/MLX 对比有异议）；本库未复跑；多 GPU / 部分机型检测仍有 issue。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Listing rationale: local-agent inference engines are a real pain point, and it plugs into stacks people already run (Pi/Codex/Claude Code). Boundary: site/Launch HN benches are vendor self-tests (HN comments dispute M5+/MLX comparisons); not re-run here; multi-GPU / some hardware detection still has open issues.
cases.approvalBoundary: 下载桌面端、拉模型权重、把本地文件/密钥接到 Agent 之前自己确认。基准数字以你机器实测为准；不要只靠厂商对比表选型。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Confirm before installing the desktop app, pulling model weights, or wiring local files/secrets into an agent. Treat vendor comparison tables as claims until you measure on your machine.

landing.what: Magnitude 是 Apache-2.0 开源的本机推理引擎（仓库 magnitudedev/magnitude，站点 magnitude.dev）。面向「已经在跑 coding / 桌面 Agent、想把模型留在本机」的人：在你的 Mac / Linux / Windows 硬件上编译并调参 kernel，再按需起停模型。官网写可一键接 Pi、OpenCode、Hermes、Codex、Claude Code 等，也提供 OpenAI 兼容接口；会话之间共享前缀缓存，闲置后关掉模型。Launch HN item 49911995。本站收成 Cases「工具笔记」：补晨间跳过的具体有用工具，不是 Grok Bot 本体，也不是又一个通用聊天客户端。
landing.whatEn: Magnitude is an Apache-2.0 local inference engine (repo magnitudedev/magnitude, site magnitude.dev). It targets people already running coding / desktop agents who want models to stay on-device: compile and tune kernels on your Mac / Linux / Windows hardware, then start and stop models on demand. The site says one-click connects Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, Codex, Claude Code, and more, plus an OpenAI-compatible API; sessions share prefix caches and idle models shut down. Launch HN item 49911995. Listed here as a Cases tool tip filling a concrete gap the morning wave skipped — not Grok Bot itself, and not another generic chat client.

cases.title: Weave Router — 给 coding agent 的开源模型路由
cases.titleEn: Weave Router — open-source model router for coding agents
cases.summary: Weave Router 是给 coding agent 用的开源模型路由。README 的快路径是 `npx @weave-os/router`，可接到 Claude Code、Codex、opencode 或 pi；加上 `--local` 则在本机 8080 端口自托管，提供商密钥留在你的机器上。产品页仍展示兼容包名 `npx @workweave/router`。它按每次上游请求挑模型：难的步骤留给前沿模型，简单的步骤换到更便宜的模型。产品页用 Terminal-Bench 和 SWE-Atlas 对比 GPT-6 Astra 的通过率、耗时和花费，那些数字是厂商自述，本库没有复跑。README 写的是按 action 路由，不是按一整轮对话路由。这是一条工具笔记：不改你的 Agent 配置，也不代付订阅。
cases.summaryEn: Weave Router is an open-source model router for coding agents. The README quickstart is `npx @weave-os/router` for Claude Code, Codex, opencode, or pi; `--local` self-hosts on port 8080 and keeps provider keys on your machine. The product page still shows the compatibility package `npx @workweave/router`. It picks a model per upstream request: harder steps stay on a frontier model, easier steps move to a cheaper one. The product page compares pass rate, time, and cost with GPT-6 Astra on Terminal-Bench and SWE-Atlas. Those figures are vendor claims and were not re-run here. The README says routing is per action, not per whole conversation turn. This is a tool tip: it does not rewrite your agent config or pay for a subscription.
cases.qualityNote: 边界：Terminal-Bench 4.0 / SWE-Atlas 相对 GPT-6 Astra 的 pass@2、耗时与美元是产品页自述；英雄区 “Astra Level Quality / 2.3× / 51% of the cost” 同样是页面文案，不与两张表合成新指标。本库未复跑、未代跑 npx。

landing.whatEn: Weave Router is Weave’s open-source proxy. The repo is weave-os/router (Apache-2.0) and the product page is weaveos.com/products/router. The README describes a drop-in proxy for Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints: a small on-box embedder scores each action and picks a model from the providers you enabled. The fast path is `npx @weave-os/router`, with `--claude`, `--codex`, `--opencode`, or `--pi`; `--local` uses localhost:8080 instead. The README says the npm name is `@weave-os/router` and the old `@workweave/router` remains a compatibility alias, which is why that command still appears on the product page. When self-hosted, keys stay on your machine and requests go from the router to the provider you configured. Listed here as a Cases tool tip the morning note deferred — not another chat client, and not Grok Bot.

cases.title: 美区 PayPal 绑国内 Visa — AI / Apple 订阅旁路
cases.titleEn: US PayPal with a China-issued Visa — AI / Apple subscription side path
cases.summary: 何居上（@hejushang8）2026-09-23 短帖：他的美区 PayPal 绑的是招商银行 Visa（截图尾号 2852），再挂到美区 Apple ID，用来付 App 订阅和线上购物。帖子引用同日长文《美区 PayPal 解决 99% 海外支付问题，注册及养号防封指南》。长文只讲个人账户付款：作者称可用于 AI 订阅、VPS、美区 Apple ID；收款和商业功能要 EIN / ITIN 等美国税务号，作者写明不涉及。准备项按作者清单：稳定美国节点（作者称机房 IP 也可以，在意的是登录地点别跳）、Visa 或万事达（中国发卡行也可以）、真实美国住宅账单地址、美国 +1 号（作者提到 Saily，约 1 美元）。顺序也是作者写的：paypal.com/us 开 Personal，+1 短信，姓名与卡一致，美国地址手动填（举例免税州俄勒冈），先跳过绑卡并验证邮箱，大约等一周再用同一美国节点确认正常，然后在 Wallet 绑国内 Visa / 万事达或 U 卡（作者举例 Bybit、P1、kast），账单地址用注册时那个美国地址。防封按作者经验：登录 IP 保持美国且稳定；没做 SSN / ITIN 就只当付款账户；可选 Wise 美国银行账户和验证器 2FA。本条是旁路工具笔记，完整步骤在作者长文。
cases.summaryEn: He Jushang (@hejushang8), 23 Sept 2026: his US PayPal is linked to a China Merchants Bank Visa (screenshot ending 2852) and then to a US Apple ID, for app subscriptions and online checkout. The post quotes his same-day article on registering a US PayPal and keeping it from being frozen. The article stays on a personal account used to pay: the author says it covers AI subscriptions, VPS, and a US Apple ID; receiving money and business features need a US tax ID such as an EIN or ITIN, which he leaves out. Prep, in his list: a stable US node (he says a datacenter IP was enough for him; what matters is not hopping countries), a Visa or Mastercard (a Chinese issuer is fine, he writes), a real US residential billing address, and a US +1 number (he mentions Saily at about $1). His order: open Personal at paypal.com/us, verify by +1 SMS, use a legal name that matches the card, add the US address manually (he cites tax-free Oregon), skip the card and verify email, wait about a week while signing in from the same US node, then bind a China-issued Visa / Mastercard or a U-card (he names Bybit, P1, kast) in Wallet, with the signup US address as billing. His anti-freeze notes: keep the login IP in the US and stable; without SSN / ITIN, treat the account as pay-only; optional Wise US bank account and authenticator 2FA. An adjacent tool note — the full steps are in his article.
cases.qualityNote: 作者自述。主源是 2026-09-23 短帖；2026-09-24（Asia/Shanghai）用 fxtwitter 镜像核对了正文和两张图：PayPal 钱包里招商银行 Visa 尾号 2852，以及美区 Apple ID 付款方式页。副源是同日长文（article 2102588711330590720）和引用帖 2102602033488634298。机房 IP、约一周再绑卡、Saily 约 1 美元、已用约 4 个月、能付 AI / VPS，都是作者自己的说法和截图。本站没有开设 PayPal 账户，也没有绑定任何银行卡。价格和优惠码与本条无关，不转载、不复核（Saily 另见 saily-us-number-esim）。有封号风险：作者写明账号可能被冻，卡若已经绑上且账号进不去，这张卡可能解不下来。完整步骤见作者长文。不构成购买建议，也不构成金融或法律建议；PayPal 官方页面优先。预览是作者短帖两张截图拼成 3:2。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Author self-report. Primary source is the 23 Sept 2026 post; on 24 Sept 2026 (Asia/Shanghai) the fxtwitter mirror was checked for the text and both images: a PayPal wallet with a China Merchants Bank Visa ending 2852, and a US Apple ID payment-method screen. Secondary sources are the same-day article (2102588711330590720) and quote post 2102602033488634298. Datacenter IP, waiting about a week before adding a card, Saily at about $1, roughly four months of use, and paying for AI / VPS are the author’s own claims and screenshots. This site did not open a PayPal account or bind any card. Prices and promo codes are unrelated to this entry and are neither copied nor re-checked (Saily is catalogued separately as saily-us-number-esim). Freeze risk: the author writes that the account can be locked, and a card already linked to an account he can no longer open may be stuck there. Full steps are in the author’s article. Not purchase advice and not financial or legal advice; PayPal’s own pages win.
cases.approvalBoundary: 开户、绑卡、扣款和可能的封号由读者自己承担。这是作者经验，不是金融或法律建议；PayPal 官方规则优先。没核对官方页面之前，不要把银行卡或 Apple ID 绑上去。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: The reader owns signup, card linking, charges, and a possible freeze. This is the author’s experience, not financial or legal advice; PayPal’s own rules win. Do not link a bank card or an Apple ID before checking the official pages.

landing.what: 这是一条办海外账号时用得上的工具笔记，记何居上公开写的用法：美区 PayPal 个人账户，绑一张国内发行的 Visa 或万事达，再作为美区 Apple ID 的付款方式。短帖上的两张图是他自己的钱包和 Apple ID 付款页，招商银行 Visa 尾号 2852。长文把范围收在「能付款」：作者称用来订 AI、买 VPS、给美区 Apple ID 付款。收款、商业账户，以及要 EIN、ITIN 的功能，他写明不讲。本站按 Saily 美国号码那条的口径收录：相邻的实用工具，方便以后注册 AI 或 App 订阅时查阅。页面上的步骤是长文顺序的压缩，点击细节以作者文章为准。
landing.whatEn: A tool note for overseas-account setup, recording the flow He Jushang published: a US PayPal personal account, a China-issued Visa or Mastercard on it, then that PayPal as the payment method on a US Apple ID. The two images on the short post are his own wallet and Apple ID payment screen, China Merchants Bank Visa ending 2852. The article stays on “able to pay”: he says he uses it for AI subscriptions, VPS, and a US Apple ID. Receiving money, a business account, and features that need an EIN or ITIN are out of scope in his piece. This library lists it the same way as the Saily US-number note: an adjacent utility to look up when an AI or app subscription needs a payment method. The steps below compress his order; the click-by-click version is his article.

contrast.caption: 左列只写短帖和长文里对得上的句子。右列写本站为什么这样记，避免把作者经验写成已经替读者跑通的路径。
contrast.captionEn: The left column is only what the short post and the article actually say. The right column is why this library records it that way, so the author’s experience is not written up as a path this site has already run.

rows.left: 个人账户，用来付款。作者称 AI 订阅、VPS、美区 Apple ID 都可以。短帖补了 App 订阅和线上购物。长文标题里的「99%」是作者的说法。他同时写：美区最难注册、风控最严，开出来的是只能付款的版本。
rows.leftEn: A personal account, used to pay. The author says AI subscriptions, VPS, and a US Apple ID all work for him. The short post adds app subscriptions and online shopping. The “99%” in the article title is his wording. He also writes that the US region is the hardest to open and the strictest on risk, and that what he ended up with is a pay-only account.
rows.right: 收录口径停在付款旁路。收款、理财、借记卡、加密交易和商业账户，作者自己标成需要美国税务号，本条不展开，也不把标题里的比例当成测量结果。
rows.rightEn: The listing stops at a pay-side path. Receiving, savings, debit, crypto, and a business account are what the author himself ties to a US tax ID, so this entry leaves them out and does not treat the percentage in the title as a measured result.

rows.left: 短帖截图是招商银行 Visa，尾号 2852，持卡人 HE JU SHANG，账单地址在俄勒冈。长文写：中国发行的 Visa / 万事达可以，Bybit、P1、kast 等 U 卡他称也能绑上；账单地址填注册时用的那个美国住宅地址，不要用 PayPal 弹出的、可能跑出免税州的候选。
rows.leftEn: The short-post screenshot is a China Merchants Bank Visa ending 2852, cardholder HE JU SHANG, billing address in Oregon. The article says a China-issued Visa / Mastercard can be used, and that U-cards such as Bybit, P1, and kast bound for him; billing is the US residential address from signup, not a PayPal suggestion that may leave the tax-free state.
rows.right: 尾号、银行和俄勒冈地址都来自作者自己贴出的截图。本站没有登录 PayPal，没有绑卡，也没有向 Apple 付过款。卡组织或 PayPal 当日是否仍接受这种绑法，以官方页面为准。
rows.rightEn: The last four digits, the bank, and the Oregon address come from screenshots the author posted. This site did not sign in to PayPal, bind a card, or pay Apple. Whether the card network or PayPal still accepts that link is a question for the official pages.

rows.left: 美国节点打开 paypal.com/us，选 Personal。人机验证后填邮箱，作者建议 Google 或微软邮箱。接着 +1 短信、密码、与卡一致的真实姓名、手动添加的美国地址（他举例俄勒冈），然后 Agree and Create Account。创建后先选 Not now，跳过绑卡，再去设置里验证邮箱。大约一周内用同一个美国节点，浏览器和 App 都登录几次，没有异常提示再进 Wallet 绑卡。
rows.leftEn: Open paypal.com/us on a US node and choose Personal. After the human check, enter an email; he suggests Google or Microsoft. Then +1 SMS, a password, a legal name that matches the card, and a US address added manually (he cites Oregon), then Agree and Create Account. After creation, choose Not now and skip the card, then verify email in settings. For about a week, sign in a few times from the same US node in both the browser and the app; open Wallet and add the card only if nothing looks wrong.
rows.right: 这里只留顺序，方便和长文对照。逐步点击、地址怎么手动加，都在作者文章里。本站没有走完注册。作者把「先别绑卡」说得很具体：号如果被封且进不去，已绑的卡可能解不下来，以后也绑不到新的 PayPal。
rows.rightEn: Only the order is kept here, so it can be checked against the article. The clicks, including how to add the address manually, are in his piece. This site did not finish a signup. He is specific about waiting: if the account is frozen and he cannot get back in, a card already linked may be stuck and unusable on a new PayPal.

rows.left: 作者称头几个月最容易出问题，登录 IP 不要在国家之间跳，尽量跟注册时同一个美国节点。身份验证会要 SSN，或非美国人的 ITIN；没有这些，账户做不了全部功能，他建议只用来付款。可选两步：用 Wise 开一个美国银行账户（他称自己已绑上），以及在 Settings → Security 里把两步验证换成验证器 App。他称这套账号已稳定用了约 4 个月。文末声明是个人记录，规则以 PayPal 官方页面为准。
rows.leftEn: He says the first months are the fragile ones: do not hop the login IP between countries; stay on a US node, ideally the one used at signup. Identity verification asks for an SSN, or an ITIN for someone who is not a US person; without those, the account cannot do every feature, and he says to use it only to pay. Two optional steps: open a US bank account in Wise (he says his is linked) and, under Settings → Security, switch 2-step verification to an authenticator app. He says this account has been steady for about four months. The article ends by calling itself a personal log, with PayPal’s pages as the rules that count.
rows.right: 「约 4 个月」「机房 IP 也能注册」是作者自述，本站没有复现，也不把它写成成功率。封号、卡解不下来、商店拒付，都算读者自己的支付和 KYC 风险。Wise 和 Saily 只是作者顺带提到的准备项，价格不在本条里复核。
rows.rightEn: “About four months” and “a datacenter IP was enough to register” are the author’s own report. This site did not reproduce them and does not turn them into a success rate. A freeze, a card that cannot be unlinked, and a store that declines the payment are the reader’s payment and KYC risk. Wise and Saily are prep items he mentions in passing; prices are not re-checked on this entry.

steps.title: 先读作者长文和短帖
steps.titleEn: Read the article and the short post
steps.body: 完整的注册、养号和防封写在 2026-09-23 的 X Article。短帖是结果：钱包里的招商 Visa，以及这张 PayPal 出现在美区 Apple ID 的付款方式里。本页只压缩顺序，不代替那篇文章。作者站点 hejushang8.com 是他的教程索引，本条不逐篇收录。
steps.bodyEn: The full signup, aging, and anti-freeze write-up is the 23 Sept 2026 X Article. The short post is the result: the China Merchants Visa in the wallet, and that PayPal showing up as a payment method on a US Apple ID. This page only compresses the order. hejushang8.com is his tutorial index; this entry does not catalog every piece on it.

steps.title: 对照他列的四样准备
steps.titleEn: Check the four things he lists
steps.body: 作者要求：稳定的美国节点（他写自己用机房 IP 注册，在意的是之后还用美国节点登录）、一张 Visa 或万事达（中国发卡行也可以）、一个真实的美国住宅账单地址、一个 +1 号码。+1 他指向 Saily，并写大约 1 美元。本站另有一条 Saily 工具笔记，价格和优惠码以那条里的作者自述为准，这里不转载。
steps.bodyEn: He asks for a stable US node (he says he registered on a datacenter IP, and cares that later logins stay on a US node), a Visa or Mastercard (a Chinese issuer is fine, he writes), a real US residential billing address, and a +1 number. For the +1 he points at Saily and writes about $1. This library already has a Saily tool note; prices and promo codes stay with the claims on that entry and are not copied here.

steps.title: 按长文开个人账户，先别绑卡
steps.titleEn: Open the personal account, and skip the card
steps.body: 作者的顺序：Personal，+1 短信，姓名与将要绑定的卡一致，美国地址用 Add address manually 手填（他举例俄勒冈，避免候选列表带出别的州），创建后点 Not now 跳过绑卡，再验证邮箱。然后大约观察一周，同一个美国节点在浏览器和 App 里登录几次。他给的理由是：号被封又进不去时，已绑的卡可能解不下来。
steps.bodyEn: His order: Personal, +1 SMS, a name that matches the card you will add, a US address entered with Add address manually (he cites Oregon so a suggested address does not land in another state), Not now to skip the card, then verify email. Then watch for about a week, signing in a few times from the same US node in the browser and the app. His reason: if the account is frozen and he cannot get in, a card already linked may be stuck.

steps.title: 再看短帖里的绑卡和 Apple ID
steps.titleEn: Then the card link and the Apple ID in the short post
steps.body: 确认没有异常提示之后，作者写从首页 Wallet 手动绑卡：中国 Visa / 万事达，或他举例的 U 卡，账单地址用注册时的美国地址。短帖是他绑完的样子，以及美区 Apple ID 付款方式里同时出现 PayPal 和那张招商 Visa。文末他写：这是自己的操作记录，不构成金融或法律建议。
steps.bodyEn: After nothing looks wrong, he says to add the card manually from Wallet on the home screen: a Chinese Visa / Mastercard, or a U-card of the kind he names, with the signup US address as billing. The short post is what that looked like for him, plus a US Apple ID payment screen that shows both PayPal and that China Merchants Visa. He closes by calling it his own log, not financial or legal advice.

boundaries.textEn: The author’s experience. This site did not open PayPal, bind a card, or pay Apple or any AI vendor. The last four digits, the bank, and the Apple ID screen are images he posted.

boundaries.text: 封号和卡被占住的风险，作者已经写明。账单地址、手机号、KYC、卡组织拒付，由读者自己负责。没做 SSN / ITIN 时，作者自己的用法也只是付款，不要把这篇理解成绕过身份验证的办法。
boundaries.textEn: The author already states the freeze risk and the risk of a card stuck on a locked account. Billing address, phone number, KYC, and a decline from the card network are the reader’s. Without an SSN / ITIN, his own use is pay-only; do not read this as a way around identity checks.

boundaries.textEn: No Skill, no Routine, and no multi-agent setup. The link to Grok Bot is only that a payment method can matter when some overseas AI tools are billed.

cases.title: Errand：开源「每席一电脑」Grok Bot / Muse 相邻桌面（Runta）
cases.titleEn: Errand: open-source Grok Bot / Muse-style desktop (Runta)
cases.summary: Apache-2.0 桌面壳 Errand（runerrand.dev）：每个队友一台 Runta 云电脑（shell / 浏览器 / 文件）。用来对照 Grok Bot「每席一电脑」，不是官方替代品。
cases.summaryEn: Apache-2.0 desktop shell Errand (runerrand.dev): each teammate gets a Runta cloud computer (shell / browser / files). Listed beside Grok Bot’s per-seat computer — not an official replacement.
cases.qualityNote: Apache-2.0（GitHub license API，2026-09-23）。预览裁自长文界面图 conversation-and-computer.webp，3:2 自托管。依赖 Runta；不当官方替代品。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Apache-2.0 (GitHub license API, 2026-09-23). Depends on Runta; not marketed as an official replacement.
cases.approvalBoundary: Runta 账号、密钥与云电脑上的对外动作由读者自己负责；未审流程不要直接上生产。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: The reader owns the Runta account, keys, and outbound actions on the cloud computer; do not put an unreviewed flow straight into production.

landing.what: Errand 是开源 macOS 桌面客户端，许可证 Apache-2.0（仓库 LICENSE；GitHub license API 于 2026-09-23 仍为 Apache-2.0）。官网写明由 Runta Cloud Agents 驱动：每个队友有自己的对话，以及一台带着文件和工具的云电脑。关掉本地 App 不会删掉队友、对话或文件——App 只是看云端工作区的窗口。作者 Shiqi Mei 的 2026-09-22 长文，以及 HN item 49803044 的标题，把它说成 Grok Bot / Muse 的开源相邻做法。本站按这个口径收录：可复现的相邻栈，不是官方 Grok Bot 或 Muse 的替代品。
landing.whatEn: Errand is an open-source macOS desktop client under Apache-2.0 (repo LICENSE; the GitHub license API still reported Apache-2.0 on 2026-09-23). The site says it is powered by Runta Cloud Agents: each teammate has a conversation and a cloud computer with files and tools. Closing the local app does not delete teammates, conversations, or files — the app is a window onto the cloud workspace. Shiqi Mei’s 2026-09-22 write-up, and the title of HN item 49803044, frame it as an open-source take on Grok Bot / Muse. This library lists it on that basis: a reproducible adjacent stack, not an official Grok Bot or Muse replacement.

contrast.caption: 左列是 Errand 在长文、仓库和官网上对得上的事实。右列只说明它为什么被拿来对照 Grok Bot「每席一电脑」，不补写本库没核过的官方操作。
contrast.captionEn: The left column is what the write-up, repo, and site actually say about Errand. The right column only says why it sits next to Grok Bot’s per-seat computer — it does not fill in official behavior this library has not checked.
contrast.rightLabel: 对照 Grok Bot「每席一电脑」

rows.left: 每个队友一台 Runta runtime：独立的 shell、浏览器和文件系统，跨任务还在。作者写明这台电脑在云上，点按发生在 runtime 里，不在你的笔记本上。
rows.leftEn: Each teammate gets a Runta runtime: its own shell, browser, and filesystem that stick around between tasks. The write-up says that computer is in the cloud — clicks happen on the runtime, not on your laptop.
rows.right: 同一类问题：一席一台电脑。这里不比较 Grok Bot 的具体实现。
rows.rightEn: Same class of idea: one computer per seat. This row does not compare Grok Bot’s implementation.

rows.left: 执行在 Runta，Errand 是客户端。退出 App 不会停掉正在跑的任务；再打开时按对话拉回 runs 和产物。官网 FAQ：关掉 App 不会删除队友、对话或文件。
rows.leftEn: Execution lives on Runta; Errand is the client. Quitting the app does not stop a run in progress; reopening fetches runs and artifacts per conversation. The site FAQ says closing the app does not delete teammates, conversations, or files.
rows.right: 用来对照「交办之后可以离开」。官方 Grok Bot 是否同样离开，以 xAI 文档为准。
rows.rightEn: Useful as a comparison for handing work off and leaving. Whether official Grok Bot behaves the same way is a question for the xAI docs.

rows.left: 可以从 Errand 打开队友的屏幕。作者写这是连到 runtime 的 VNC，用 noVNC 画在界面里，可以看，也可以接管。2026-09-23 仓库里 src/ui/components/VncDesktop.tsx 为 72 行，与长文一致。
rows.leftEn: You can open a teammate’s screen from Errand. The author describes a VNC session to the runtime, drawn with noVNC, for watching or taking over. On 2026-09-23, src/ui/components/VncDesktop.tsx in the repo is 72 lines, matching the write-up.
rows.right: 只记录 Errand 怎么看云桌面，不把这套 VNC 说成 Grok Bot 的做法。
rows.rightEn: This records how Errand shows the cloud desktop. It does not claim Grok Bot uses this VNC path.

rows.left: 作者称桌面大约 4,000 行 TypeScript，因为 runtime、computer-use、agent loop 和持久化已经在 Runta，所以一个人大约一周做出壳。本库没有重数整个仓库的行数。
rows.leftEn: The author says the desktop app is about 4,000 lines of TypeScript, because the runtime, computer-use, agent loop, and persistence already lived in Runta — so one person shipped the shell in about a week. This library did not re-count the repo.
rows.right: 对照的是「专席电脑 + 可离开」可以落在一层薄客户端上，前提是 runtime 已经存在。不是从零复刻的官方产品。
rows.rightEn: The comparison is that a per-seat computer you can leave can sit on a thin client when the runtime already exists. It is not a from-scratch official product.

steps.title: 打开官网
steps.titleEn: Open the site
steps.body: 先看 runerrand.dev 上的产品说明。页面里的对话是示例，不连接真实 Agent，也不会把消息发出去。系统要求以 FAQ 当日文字为准：Apple Silicon、macOS 13+、Runta 账号，以及为 Agent 配好的模型。
steps.bodyEn: Start with the product page on runerrand.dev. The conversations on that page are samples: they do not connect to a real agent or send messages out. System requirements follow the FAQ as written that day: Apple Silicon, macOS 13+, a Runta account, and a model configured for the agents.

steps.title: 读仓库再在本机跑
steps.titleEn: Read the repo, then run it locally
steps.body: 仓库是 runta-dev/errand，Apache-2.0。README 的 Quick start 是 clone 之后 npm ci、npm run dev（macOS 13+、Apple Silicon、Node.js 22–26）。本地桌面仍连接 Runta Cloud Agents，需要 Runta 账号和模型权限。
steps.bodyEn: The repo is runta-dev/errand, Apache-2.0. The README quick start is clone, then npm ci and npm run dev (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon, Node.js 22–26). The local desktop still connects to Runta Cloud Agents, so you need a Runta account and model access.

steps.title: 看 HN 和作者长文
steps.titleEn: Read HN and the author write-up
steps.body: HN item 49803044（2026-09-22）的标题把 Errand 称为一周做出的开源 Grok Bot / Muse alternative。Shiqi Mei 的长文解释壳为什么薄、关 App 为什么不停，并附有真实界面截图。
steps.bodyEn: HN item 49803044 (2026-09-22) titles Errand as an open-source Grok Bot / Muse alternative built in a week. Shiqi Mei’s write-up explains why the shell is thin, why quitting the app does not stop the work, and includes real UI screenshots.

boundaries.text: 依赖 Runta。官网和 README：云 runtime 与模型用量另计；需要 Runta 账号，并为 Agent 配好模型。作者称目前仅 macOS，模型和控制框架都可以换，并在做把 runtime 放到读者自己账号里的选项。
boundaries.textEn: Depends on Runta. The site and README say cloud runtime and model usage are billed separately; you need a Runta account and a model configured for the agents. The author says it is macOS-only for now, the model and harness are swappable, and a bring-your-own-cloud option is in progress so the runtime can sit in the reader’s account.

boundaries.text: Runta 账号、密钥，以及云电脑上的对外动作（打开网页、点按、把内容发出去）由读者自己负责。没有审过的流程不要直接当成生产。
boundaries.textEn: The Runta account, keys, and outbound actions on the cloud computer (opening pages, clicking, sending anything out) are the reader’s responsibility. Do not put an unreviewed flow straight into production.

boundaries.text: 不要把它宣传成官方 Grok Bot 或 Muse 的替代品。仓库描述和 HN 标题是作者或提交者的说法；本站只把它当作可复现的相邻栈。
boundaries.textEn: Do not market it as an official substitute for Grok Bot or Muse. The repo description and the HN title are the author or submitter’s framing; this library lists it as a reproducible adjacent stack.

cases.title: 用多席 Grok Bot 向越南面料厂询价出样
cases.titleEn: multi-Bot fabric sourcing to Vietnam suppliers
cases.summary: 来自 HN「Grok Bot」帖 下 jjcm 的可复现流程：按领域拆 Bot（各自 Routine/上下文/电脑），异步跑；面料 Bot 先联约 5 家越南供应商，无回再扩 5 家，再人工推到约 40 家（多走 WhatsApp）；与原型 Bot 协作生成带 logo 的随机花纹并导出.ai 发给供应商。强调域隔离比堆一个全能 Bot 更稳，但也提醒常驻 Agent 会显著烧 token。
cases.summaryEn: From the HN “Grok Bot” thread, jjcm’s reproducible flow: split Bots by domain (each with its own routines, context, and computer) for async work; a fabric Bot first reaches ~5 Vietnam suppliers, expands by 5 when silent, then is pushed to ~40 (often via WhatsApp); it collaborates with a prototyper Bot to generate a logo-based random pattern and send a.ai file. Domain isolation beats one mega-Bot, but always-on Agents burn tokens hard.
cases.qualityNote: 流程可复述：WhatsApp 询价、样本、与原型 Bot 协作出 .ai；本库不当 KPI，也不鼓励滥发询价。

cases.summary: 官方 Merch Fulfillment Operator：对合适的潜客做周边触达，盯兑换表，在聊天里让你批准/拒绝提交，再给供应商发每日订单，告诉他们何时何地发货。发货与对外消息必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色，审批点写进文案（chat 里批准/拒绝）。现有 29 条没有周边履约。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不批准兑换、不向供应商下单、不对外发周边；只返回待批提交与每日订单草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Merch Fulfillment Operator: runs outreach, watches the redemption form, pings you in chat to approve/reject submissions, and sends the swag vendor a daily order form so they know when and where to dispatch. Shipping and outbound messages need a human.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role with the approval gate written in (approve/reject in chat). None of the 29 cover merch fulfillment.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not approve redemptions, place vendor orders, or ship merch; return pending submissions and a daily order-form draft.
cases.hook: 兑换先等你点头，再给供应商发当天的发货单。
cases.hookEn: Waits for your yes on each redemption, then sends the vendor that day's order.

cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not accept or reject applicants, and do not send DMs; return the screen, triage queue, and nurture drafts.

cases.title: 关键事件监测：有真实由头才建议互动
cases.titleEn: Compelling Events Monitor
cases.summary: 官方 Compelling Events Monitor：盯管理层动态里的获奖、发布与招聘信号，交出一份可互动帖子短摘要，并按你的声音起草评论或引用转发。不自行发帖。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有付费监控/竞争情报不覆盖「领导层由头→待互动摘要」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发帖、不评论、不引用转发；只返回由头摘要与待审互动草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Compelling Events Monitor: watches leadership posts for awards, launches, and hiring signals, then sends a short digest of posts to engage with, plus comments or quote-reposts in your voice. Does not post on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Paid-media monitor and competitive intel do not cover a leadership-trigger engagement digest.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not post, comment, or quote-repost; return the trigger digest and draft engagements only.
cases.hook: 有真实由头才建议互动，评论先起草，不自己发。
cases.hookEn: Suggests a reply only when there is a real reason, and does not post it.

cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send replies, close tickets, or issue refunds; return triage and drafts only.

cases.title: Slack 触发的复现 / 升级例行
cases.titleEn: Slack-Triggered Repro / Escalation Routine
cases.summary: 窄事件规则：当 #customer-escalations 出现工单链接 +「needs repro」时，Bot 打开工单、在预发复现、在对话中贴复现包——未经批准不回帖到 Slack。避免「每条新消息」监听。
cases.qualityNote: 事件触发设计金标准：窄匹配、审批、失败策略。
cases.summaryEn: A narrow event rule: when #customer-escalations has a ticket link + “needs repro,” the Bot opens the ticket, reproduces on staging, and posts the repro pack in the thread — does not reply in Slack without approval. Avoid listening to “every new message.”
cases.qualityNoteEn: Gold standard for event-trigger design: narrow match, approval, failure policy.
cases.hook: 看到需要复现才动手，未经批准不回帖。
cases.hookEn: Acts only when a thread asks for a reproduction, and does not reply until you approve.

cases.title: 演示教学：把浏览器流程存成 Skill
cases.titleEn: Teach a Task: Demo a Browser Workflow into a Skill
cases.summary: 官方 Skills / Routines 文档给出的可执行模式：在一对一对话打开电脑视图，选 Teach a task，演示最多约 10 分钟的浏览器流程，Bot 生成草稿 Skill。补上决策规则、失败处理和审批边界后再用 Test run，最后才做成例行。不录音频，演示中不要暴露密钥，凭证走安全交接。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「先一次性任务 → Skill → Routine」闭环，和现有业务角色案例互补，可直接照文档操作。
cases.approvalBoundary: 写操作与外发保持审批；演示时不暴露密钥
cases.summaryEn: The executable pattern from the official Skills / Routines docs: open computer view in a 1:1, choose Teach a task, demo a browser flow of about 10 minutes max, and the Bot drafts a Skill. Add decision rules, failure handling, and approval bounds, then Test run, and only then turn it into a routine. No audio recording; do not expose secrets during the demo; hand credentials over securely.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The official “one-off task → Skill → Routine” loop. Complements the business-role cases and can be followed from the docs.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Keep writes and outbound behind approval; do not expose secrets during the demo
cases.hook: 演示一遍浏览器流程，Bot 先写成草稿技能。
cases.hookEn: Demo a browser flow once, and the Bot writes it up as a draft skill.

cases.title: 把几十条访谈视频收成一条可看的成片
cases.titleEn: Research, transcribe, and cut a science video brief
cases.summary: KanekoaTheGreat 用自然语言让 Grok Bot 找出 Dr. Roger Seheult 谈阳光、红光、红外与线粒体的全部相关视频（含 MedCram，以及与 Huberman、Eric Berg、Steven Bartlett 等的访谈）。几分钟后交出：38 条视频转写合成一份 Word、精选 13 段科学讲解并剪成 19:35 成片、以及带原片时间戳的 Markdown 摘要。无脚本、无代码。
cases.qualityNote: 社区真人工作流：非程序员用一句话把「搜片—转写—精选—剪辑—摘要」一次做完。适合作为研究/内容 Bot 的示范，外发成片前仍建议人审。
cases.approvalBoundary: 成片与对外发布前需人审；注明素材来源与时间戳，不把转写当最终引用。
cases.summaryEn: KanekoaTheGreat asked Grok Bot in natural language to find every Dr. Roger Seheult video on sunlight, red light, infrared, and mitochondria (including MedCram and talks with Huberman, Eric Berg, Steven Bartlett, and others). Minutes later it returned: a Word file of 38 video transcripts, 13 science segments cut into a 19:35 film, and a Markdown brief with source timestamps. No script, no code.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A real community workflow: a non-programmer finished “find–transcribe–select–edit–summarize” in one sentence. A good research/content Bot demo; still review before publishing the cut.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Human review before the cut goes public; cite sources and timestamps, and do not treat transcripts as final quotes.
cases.hook: 把一批访谈收成一份文稿和一条可看的成片。
cases.hookEn: Gathers a set of interviews into one transcript and a cut you can watch.

cases.title: 数字断舍离：邮箱、网盘与订阅审计
cases.titleEn: Digital Declutterer
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖里的 Digital declutterer：全天候审计邮箱、Drive 和付费订阅，整理出可取消清单（金额、最近使用）。只有你点头才丢弃或退订。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」新角色，审批边界非常清晰：只审计、列清单，退订必须人审。适合作为第一个生活向 Routine。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不丢弃文件、不退订、不删除账号；只返回审计清单。
cases.summaryEn: Digital declutterer from the official expansion post: around-the-clock audit of email, Drive, and paid subscriptions, producing a cancel list (amount, last used). It discards or unsubscribes only after you nod.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A new official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role. The approval bound is very clear: audit and list only; canceling needs a human. A good first life-admin Routine.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not discard files, unsubscribe, or delete accounts; return only the audit list.
cases.hook: 审计邮箱、网盘和订阅，取消之前先等你点头。
cases.hookEn: Audits mail, files, and subscriptions, and cancels only after you say yes.

cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Joining and sending the summary need human review; do not make commitments or change the calendar.
cases.hook: 你去不了时由它入会，回来带一份摘要。

cases.title: 建站 Bot：做站、买域名、部署上线
cases.titleEn: Website Builder
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Website builder：搭建站点、购买域名并部署最终版本，协助配置插件、交出可访问 URL，并加上跳转规则。与「多 Bot 上线小组」互补，这是单 Bot 端到端交付。
cases.qualityNote: 官方点名会买域名和部署，属于高后果动作。适合先在草稿环境做站，域名购买与 DNS/跳转必须审批。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不购买域名、不改 DNS、不部署到生产；先交出预览站与清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Website builder: build the site, buy a domain, and deploy the final version, help configure plugins, hand over a reachable URL, and add redirect rules. Complements the multi-bot launch group; this is one Bot delivering end to end.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Officially named as buying domains and deploying — high-consequence actions. Build in a draft environment first; domain purchase and DNS/redirects must be approved.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not buy a domain, change DNS, or deploy to production; hand over a preview site and a checklist first.
cases.hook: 做站、买域名并部署，交出可访问的地址。
cases.hookEn: Builds the site, buys the domain, deploys it, and hands over an address you can open.

cases.title: 游戏美术 Bot：按方向产出管线资产
cases.titleEn: Game Artist
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖里的 Game artist：进入现有美术管线，按你的创作方向制作定制资产，再把游戏真正需要的东西交回来。适合先在草稿目录出图，入库与覆盖正式资源必须人审。
cases.summaryEn: Game artist from the official expansion post: visits the art pipeline, makes custom assets according to your creative direction, and comes back with what the game needs. Draft in a scratch folder first; promoting or overwriting production assets needs a human.
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」里尚未入库的角色：有明确管线入口和交付物，但不写「直接覆盖生产美术」。适合当内容向 Skill 的示范。
cases.qualityNoteEn: An official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role not yet listed: a clear pipeline in and a deliverable out, without claiming it should overwrite production art. A good content-side Skill demo.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不覆盖正式美术目录、不提交到发行分支、不对外发布；只交草稿资产与清单。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not overwrite the production art tree, commit to a release branch, or publish; hand over draft assets and a list only.
cases.hook: 按你的方向出游戏素材，入库之前要人审。
cases.hookEn: Makes game art in the direction you set, and waits for a person before it ships.

cases.title: 办公室经理：工单、排班与门户代劳
cases.titleEn: Office Manager
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Office manager：接收工单、规划产能，并在 Gmail、Slack、ServiceTitan、Quo 和客户门户之间代为点选。让店主不必同时活在六个工具里。预约、改价、对外消息默认停在审批。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Office manager: intakes work orders, plans capacity, and does the browser work across Gmail, Slack, ServiceTitan, Quo, and the client portal so a shop owner does not have to live in six tools. Booking, price changes, and outbound messages stop for approval by default.
cases.qualityNote: 官方点名的多门户代劳角色，和已有的收件箱分拣不同：对象是工单与排班，而不是邮件归档。高后果动作（下单、改预约）必须人审。
cases.qualityNoteEn: An official multi-portal operator role, distinct from inbox triage: it owns work orders and capacity, not mail filing. High-consequence actions (booking, changing appointments) need a human.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不确认预约、不改价、不向客户发送消息；只整理工单队列与建议排班。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not confirm bookings, change prices, or message customers; return a work-order queue and a suggested schedule only.
cases.hook: 在几个门户之间代点工单和排班，对外消息先等人批。

cases.title: 客服退款 Bot：政策内退款先拟后批
cases.titleEn: Customer Support · in-policy refunds
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Customer support：阅读支持邮件并接入支付服务商，处理政策内的常规退款。Gergely Orosz 在 2026-08-19 公开过同一形态：Grok Bot 连接支持邮箱与 Stripe API，每笔先在 Bot 界面确认再打款。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Customer support: reads support mail, connects to the payments provider, and handles routine in-policy refunds. Gergely Orosz published the same shape on 2026-08-19: Grok Bot on support email plus the Stripe API, confirming each refund in the Bot UI before money moves.
cases.qualityNote: 官方角色 + 社区真人跑通：政策内退款是钱，必须先拟草稿、人点头。和已有的收件箱分拣不同，这条连到支付 API。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official role plus a real community run: in-policy refunds are money, so draft first and wait for a nod. Distinct from inbox triage because it talks to the payments API.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发起退款、不改支付方式、不自动回复顾客；先提交订单号、金额、政策对照与待批草稿。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not issue a refund, change the payment method, or auto-reply to the customer; first return order id, amount, policy check, and a draft for approval.
cases.hook: 政策内的退款先拟好，打款前在界面里等你确认。
cases.hookEn: Drafts in-policy refunds and waits on screen for you to confirm the payment.

cases.title: 边推婴儿车边用语音买菜
cases.titleEn: Voice grocery shopping on a walk
cases.summary: Debbie O'Brien 在手机上用语音让 Grok Bot 往 Alcampo 购物车加东西：截图核对品牌、按照片认零食、查肉饼含肉比例，验证码自己过，付款她最终点头。之后还让 Bot 比了别家超市的同品牌价格。她把这件事从幕僚长里拆成独立的 Shopping Bot，以免上下文被购物填满。
cases.summaryEn: Debbie O'Brien used voice on her phone so Grok Bot could add to an Alcampo cart: screenshot the brands, identify snacks from a photo, check meat percentage on burgers, she cleared captchas herself, and she gave the final okay on payment. Afterwards the Bot compared named-brand prices at other delivery supermarkets. She split this off the chief of staff into a dedicated Shopping Bot so shopping would not fill the context window.

Tools cover device listing, app install/launch/terminate, tap/swipe/type, hardware buttons, deep links, screen recording, logcat and crash reports. cases.title: Claude 官方转的 6 个作品：山火地图、涂鸦象棋、手写字体、电磁场、冠脉造影 3D、俳句动画
cases.titleEn: Six projects Claude reposted: wildfire map, doodle chess, handwriting font, EM field, 3D angiogram trainer, haiku animations
cases.hook: 六个用 Claude 做出来的小作品，看别人把它用在哪。
cases.hookEn: Six small things people built with Claude, and what they used it for.
cases.summary: @claudeai 2026-10-17 发帖，挑了最近几周 6 个用 Claude 做的作品，每条转的是作者原帖视频：1）山火分析原型，按时间显示火势蔓延、跟踪热点，作者 @DilumSanjaya 说还能用无人机追热点、看扑救进度（Opus 5.5）；2）画在笔记本纸上的涂鸦风象棋，@kevin_t_ngo（Sonnet 5.5）；3）把 120 页手写笔记变成自己笔迹的字体，@2ntotal（Opus 5.5）；4）能看见、能用手拖动的电磁场可视化，@thebuggeddev（Opus 5.5）；5）心内科专培医生 @AnnasRahmanMD 做的 AngioView，3D 模拟不同 C 臂角度下的冠脉造影，帮学员学读片；6）Haiku 5.5 写了 20 首俳句，每一帧画面都用 JavaScript 画，@kevin_t_ngo。适合找灵感：数据可视化、教学工具、手写字体、生成式动画都有。
cases.summaryEn: On 2026-10-17 @claudeai picked six recent projects made with Claude, each linking the creator's own video: 1) a wildfire analysis prototype that maps spread over time and tracks hot spots; creator @DilumSanjaya says it also tracks hot spots with drones and monitors firefighting (Opus 5.5); 2) chess drawn as doodles on notebook paper by @kevin_t_ngo (Sonnet 5.5); 3) 120 handwritten pages turned into a font of the author's own handwriting by @2ntotal (Opus 5.5); 4) an electromagnetic field you can see and push around by @thebuggeddev (Opus 5.5); 5) AngioView by cardiology fellow @AnnasRahmanMD, a 3D simulator of coronary angiograms at any C-arm angle for trainees; 6) Haiku 5.5 wrote 20 haiku and every frame was drawn in JavaScript, by @kevin_t_ngo. Good for ideas across data viz, teaching tools, handwriting fonts and generative animation.
cases.qualityNote: 收录理由：官方挑的真实作品，类型分散，适合找「拿 Claude 做点什么」的灵感。除 AngioView 有公开网站外，其余 5 个只有作者帖子里的视频，没有找到可直接打开的成品或仓库。所用模型、耗时、费用都是作者自述。本库没有复现任何一个。AngioView 页面写明是教学模拟，不能用于临床。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Why it is listed: real projects picked by Claude's account across very different fields, useful for ideas. Apart from AngioView, which has a public site, the other five exist only as videos in the creators' posts; no openable build or repo found. Models, time and cost are the creators' claims. This library reproduced none of them. AngioView says it is an educational simulation, not for clinical use.
cases.approvalBoundary: 只作参考；AngioView 是教学模拟，不要拿来做临床判断。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Reference only; AngioView is an educational simulation, not for clinical decisions.
